Pet Changes
Web Shop Reorganization:
As part of our ongoing effort to improve the Web Shop and provide fairer monetization, this month we’re relocating pets, updating prices, and more!
The following pets and pet packages will be removed from the Web Shop:Adelie PenguinAlaskan HuskyBlack Cotton OstrichBlack Mud CrabBlack SealBlack WolfBlack and White Ferret PackageBlue ElephantBorder CollieBrown FoxClover GnuClover PigCoral CobraDalmatianDapple Thunder SpanielDesert CobraEagle OwlEmperor PenguinFalconGoldfinchGray WolfGreen GeckoGuardian SpiderHaflingerHamsterHimalayanJapanese BobtailJungle Scout ImpKangaroo RatKingfisherLabrador RetrieverLaghodessaLava Walker ImpLime SpriteMagic CarpetMalamuteMini BearOak Magic BroomOrange PixiePersianPittaPolar BearRed PandaRed Rock CrabShort Horned LizardSiameseSilver FoxSnowy OwlWhite ElephantWhite Flame SpiderWhite JindoWhite SealWhite Sheep CowWhite Thunder SpanielWhite Tiger CubWooden MimicYellow JindoYellow Tiger CubThe following pets will have their prices adjusted and will be re-added to the Web Shop permanently:Scooter ImpOld Price: 14,900 NXNew Price: 12,700 NXFlying Food Truck

Shamala will be opening her own shop for Milletians to purchase old pets that have been sold in the past.All pets sold will be in the form of a Pet Whistle and purchasable with Pon.Pon is available for purchase through the Web Shop.The following pets and their prices are as follows:[table][tr][th]Pet[/th][th]Price (Pon)[/th][/tr][tr][td]Adelie Penguin[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Albino King Snake[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Beyaya[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bluebird[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Cow[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Desert Cobra[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Golden Retriever[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Goldfinch[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Gray Wolf[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Green Gecko[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Himalayan[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Kangaroo Rat[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Pitta[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Reindeer[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Hedgehog[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Jindo[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bengal[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Blue Elephant[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bombay[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bull[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Crow[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Falcon[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ghost Crab[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Laghodessa[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lime Sprite[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Silver Fox[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Tiger Cub[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Seal[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Albino Tiger[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Brown Ostrich[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Cheetah[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Griffin[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lesser Panda[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Magic Carpet[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Mini Skeleton[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Monkey[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rainbow Sprite[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Shire[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][/table]
Fantasy Life Changes
Unvisited Mana Tunnels and Moon Gates will be semi-transparent until visited for the first time.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/hrajw0az/mana-tunnel-map-merged.png
Right-clicking an item will now list options to search and list the item on the Auction House.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/zqoas4m3/right-click-menu.png
When searching the Auction House: Pet Adoption Medals, Blacksmith Manuals, and Sewing Patterns will contain the full name.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/g0pf5luw/auction-house-improvement.png
Preset Character Models have been refreshed for new accounts and premium character cards during character creation.The pop-up box will no longer appear when attempting to enter a dungeon room where a battle is active.When changing channels, you can now double-click the channel name in the list to move.Two new functions have been added to items when the Inventory Magnifying Glass window is open:
You can preview weapons, clothing/armor, and chairs.
You can search items directly that are listable on the Auction House.The Auction House has added security measures to assist with your daily trading and shopping:
The warning message has been enhanced to give more notice when attempting to purchase or sell an item 90+% higher or lower than the average price.Warning messages have been added when attempting to purchase non-repairable items that have 20% or less durability/use.Options for Hair Styles, Eye Shapes, Faces, and Mouths have been revised in the Dressing Room so the most recent additions will appear at the top.Sick of having to go outdoors to warp? We are too… so we’ve addressed that! You can now warp indoors when using the following warp functions:
The Arcana Room via your Character UI Menu.Festia via your Character UI Menu.Doki Doki Island via the Soulmate UI Menu.The Star Citadel via skill use.Guild Hall via the Guild Hall UI Menu.Event NPCs through the Event UI Menu.Feedback heard! We’ve updated the Astral Reave Dan Tests to be slightly less difficult. You will now receive 35 points instead of 30 when attacking an enemy with Astral Reave.Additional search fields have had their case sensitivity removed:Guild UI MenuPoint InventoryParty BoardProduction Crafting ListsBard BulletinWhen picking up equipment from the ground, the logic has been modified so it will no longer be equipped to the character’s style tab automatically.
The equipment can still be automatically slotted into the character’s equipment tab as normal if the equipment tab slot is empty.The following appearance scrolls have been renamed to indicate that they are applied onto two-handed axes, not scythes, despite visually being scythes:
Moonshadow Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll -> Moonshadow Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll (2H Axe)Duskveil Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll -> Duskveil Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll (2H Axe)Frost Great Scythe Appearance Scroll -> Frost Great Scythe Appearance Scroll (2H Axe)Following the Magic Attack Changes in July, adjustments to ease the difficulty have been made to most RP missions where the Magic Talent is a focus.[Element] Alchemy skills have been properly unified in name, matching the format of the current Earth Alchemy Mastery skill: 
Fire Alchemy -> Fire Alchemy MasteryWind Alchemy -> Wind Alchemy MasteryWater Alchemy -> Water Alchemy MasteryBug Fixes
We’ve been continuing to address G27 via several fixes throughout the month. Thanks for all the reports - we very much appreciate these, and we hope that you’re enjoying the story!
Zap-happy Dark Diviners with Thunderblight and specific timing could accidentally destroy the enemies during one of the G27 cutscenes, creating a time paradox where nothing further would happen! ...Until you left and tried again, that is. The enemies have been adjusted to no longer be defeated during the cutscene. Fixed an issue causing the game to close when previewing one of the following chairs: 
Kanna Tanning ChairEirlys Tanning ChairElsie Tanning ChairDai Tanning ChairKaour Tanning ChairLogan Tanning ChairShuan Tanning ChairChristmas Dessert TableElegant Afternoon Tea TableThrough your reports, we found and fixed a few more Sewing Patterns where the pattern had gone mysteriously blank.

Bugs fixed during the August 28th Maintenance
Addressed the channel lag by adding new channels and redistributing channel population capacities. See the August 28th Maintenance Patch Notes for the full details! More text fixes added for Generation 27. We're still working on our polish for this Generation based on our own playthroughs and your reports, and we're still eternally grateful! More is yet to come as this giant-sized generation is brought to heel!As accidentally (we swear!) showcased by GM Quuku and GM Hongenjo during the Brí Leith stream, the hard cap on Protection was not set, allowing damage reduction to increase up to 100% instead of capping at 90%. This hard cap will be put in properly with this update, though this requires very high values that can be difficult or impossible for players to reach.In rare circumstances crafting recipes using the Destructive Crest that are expected to be 99.9% completion in one tap would incorrectly finish at less than this. Robes that were crafted in this incorrect way have been corrected automatically. The following armor pieces have been renamed to match their materials:Saint Guardian's Leather Armor [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Breastplate [M/F]Saint Guardian's Leather Helmet [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Battle Helmet [M/F]In order to properly reflect the multiple weapons that come with it, the following weapons have been renamed:
[Dual Guns]
Nightbringer Vanquisher -> Nightbringer Vanquishers
[Control Bars]Nightbringer Trickster -> Nightbringer Tricksters
Perseus Conflict Control Bar -> Perseus Conflict Control Bars
[Knuckles]Nightbringer Vagabond -> Nightbringer Vagabonds
Perseus Tormented Knuckle -> Perseus Tormented KnucklesAdditionally in a future patch, based on feedback from the Soul Liberator weapons, we will be looking to rename the Nightbringer weapons to include the Weapon Type (ie. Nightbringer Warlord Greatsword).
Bugs fixed during the August 21st Maintenance
Fixed some Generation 27 typos as reported by our Milletians.Known Bugshttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.pngAn e-2 error is occasionally causing in-game Player Reports to fail to send. In the meanwhile, if you need to submit a report we ask that you use our Player Support website.There are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.

Hello Milletians!

We'll be having a mid-cycle patch with a few upcoming changes.

Table of Contents:
Return of the Over the Rainbow EventChannel Increase and ReductionBug Fixes
Return of the Over the Rainbow Event
In our previous announcement, we shared about the various issues that were discovered and needed to be addressed to ensure the gameplay was fair for all Milletians. The biggest issue was the efficiency in which Milletians could acquire rewards through Leprechauns, particularly Dapper. To prevent high-valued rewards from being flooded into the game's economy and ensure that the rewards still have value after the event, the following adjustments have been made:
A weekly Leprechaun Encounter Limit will be added to Uladh Hard Mode Advanced, Tech Duinn, and Crom Bás Dungeons.Crom Bás: 10 EncountersTech Duinn: 15 EncountersUladh Hard Mode Advanced: 15 EncountersThis limit functions separately from the dungeon reward limit.The weekly encounter limit will reset on Thursdays at 7:00 AM PDT.With the addition of this limit, the encounter rate for higher-grade Leprechauns has been slightly increased for both Tech Duinn and Crom Bás.Leprechauns will no longer spawn in the Tech Duinn - Seven Nightmares mission. Initially, a Leprechaun would spawn when Cethlenn would reach 20% health, but would cause the Leprechaun to despawn if Cethlenn was defeated.Due to the nature of this bug and to ensure a timely return of the event, this particular Tech Duinn mission has been excluded.[table noborder=1][tr][td]The Over the Rainbow Event will resume this Thursday after maintenance and will be extended for 2 weeks after its original end date, with the new end date being October 30th (Before Maintenance).[/td][td width=40%]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/doto52nn/otr-ticket.png[/td][/tr][/table]
We greatly apologize for the inconvenience that the temporary suspension and adjustment of the event has caused. As compensation, the following rewards will be provided via a Hotday Event for all accounts from August 28th to September 11th:
Service Error Compensation Box (Expires in 30 Days)5x Unlimited Dungeon Pass Boxes (Expires in 7 Days)Each Box contains 3x Unlimited Dungeon Passes (Expires in 7 Days)3x Holy Water of Murias (No Expiration)Applying this item to equipment can grant a powerful random effect.Once applied, the equipment will be untradeable and cannot be stored in the Dressing Room unless removed.Please refer to our Generation 27: The Garden of Solace Update Notes for more details and information.1x Mabinogi Combination VIP Service (14 Days) (No Expiration)All items received are untradeable and can only be claimed once per account.
Channel Increase and Reduction
With the Summer Festival in full swing, we have noticed a significant increase in Milletians both joining for the first time and returning to Erinn! As mentioned previously, we are aware that these growing pains are not without issues, particularly lag amongst all channels. 

In this upcoming maintenance, our first update aimed at addressing the recent performance will be taking place:
3 new channels will be added to the server, for a total of 13 channels.Channel 11Channel 12Channel 13Adjusting the channel population to be uniform for all channels.
While these adjustments are just an initial step, we will continue to share about the changes made to the game. In the weeks following we will be monitoring these changes and these new channels for stability and overall improvements. Following changes to be made include improvements to the server hardware, the inclusion of more channels as needed, and more as our changes uncover other issues or point us towards areas of greater focus. 

Thank you for your patience as we continue to make further adjustments as necessary to bring you the best Mabinogi.

Bug Fixes
More text fixes added for Generation 27. We're still working on our polish for this Generation based on our own playthroughs and your reports, and we're still eternally grateful! More is yet to come as this giant-sized generation is brought to heel!As accidentally (we swear!) showcased by GM Quuku and GM Hongenjo during the Brí Leith stream, the hard cap on Protection was not set, allowing damage reduction to increase up to 100% instead of capping at 90%. This hard cap will be put in properly with this update, though this requires very high values that can be difficult or impossible for players to reach.In rare circumstances crafting recipes using the Destructive Crest that are expected to be 99.9% completion in one tap would incorrectly finish at less than this. This issue has been corrected, and any players who encountered this issue are encouraged to contact Player Support to have their robe corrected.The following armor pieces have been renamed to match their materials:Saint Guardian's Leather Armor [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Breastplate [M/F]Saint Guardian's Leather Helmet [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Battle Helmet [M/F]In order to properly reflect the multiple weapons that come with it, the following weapons have been renamed:[Dual Guns]Nightbringer Vanquisher -> Nightbringer Vanquishers[Control Bars]Nightbringer Trickster -> Nightbringer TrickstersPerseus Conflict Control Bar -> Perseus Conflict Control Bars[Knuckles]Nightbringer Vagabond -> Nightbringer VagabondsPerseus Tormented Knuckle -> Perseus Tormented KnucklesAdditionally in a future patch, based on feedback from the Soul Liberator weapons, we will be looking to rename the Nightbringer weapons to include the Weapon Type.

- The Mabinogi Team

Generation 27: The Garden of Solace

Retry & Checkpoints
RetryDuring battle, the party has the option to restart the current battle from the beginning by pressing the [RETRY] button at the top right of the screen.All players in the party must press the button to restart.CheckpointAllows the party to continue where they left off in the dungeon.After defeating a boss, a checkpoint save menu will appear, allowing you to save your status in the dungeon and re-enter at a later time.The checkpoint save will last until you’ve completed the next boss/cleared the dungeon, or canceled it outside at the gate.A new Dungeon Pass is required when exiting and re-entering the dungeon where you left off.When entering the dungeon through a checkpoint, ALL party members must be at the same checkpoint.
Revival Restrictions
Party members can be revived once per battle stage.Harmonic Saint’s Steadfast Soul ability can bypass this limit, allowing for a second revival for themselves.The limit is reset upon retrying or winning the battle.If all party members are incapacitated, the battle will automatically restart, regardless of the number of revivals the party has remaining.
Time Limit
Each stage of the dungeon has a set time limit.Should the fight exceed the time limit, the current battle will end and automatically be retried.
Reward Distribution
After defeating each stage of the dungeon, the party will be rewarded with one treasure chest.See Brí Leith Dungeon Reward Details section for more details on the rewards themselves.At first, the treasure chest can only be opened by the party leader.If the party leader does not open it after 30 seconds, anyone in the party can open the treasure chest.Upon opening the treasure chest, a special reward distribution UI will appear listing all the rewards that can be distributed to all party members currently in the dungeon.If a party member happens to re-enter the dungeon after the chest has been opened, they will be ineligible for reward distribution.Each eligible party member will roll the dice (1 to 100) for each item. The party member with the highest roll will win that item.If two or more winning party members rolled the same number on an item, a second tie-breaker roll will be initiated to break the tie.If you move to another location or exit the dungeon during the reward distribution, all items except for the ones you’ve already won will be automatically “passed over”.If a solo party opens the treasure chest, a reward choice UI will appear, allowing the player to select which items they’d like to discard/keep rather than the party reward distribution UI.
Other
A cooldown period of 30 seconds is applied when consuming a potion in the dungeon.Party members can only re-enter the dungeon when the party is not currently fighting a boss.

The delay when using the Thunder Skill has been reduced significantly further.Before/After ComparisonWith the release of Generation 27, Veteran Mercenary Fedelm has added two new items to her Master Plan Event Main Shop. These rare relics are only available upon completing Generation 27 during this Master Plan Event, so don’t delay!Homestead Murias Apple TreeHomestead Murias Ground Floor Small ArchEnhanced Mana Bullet has been added for Dual Guns.This new powerful bullet can be crafted through Magic Crafting.Attack +50Maximum Stack Size: 5000The tooltip has been updated to show the RBG values of item pouches.In order to encompass the new Murias Relics, texts that previously indicated Falias Relics as the category name, such as the Auction House category, have been renamed to Divine Relics.In order to better indicate that they are magically replenishing, the infinite-use Arrow items have been renamed to include a pluralization. With the inclusion of the infinite use Soul Liberator Eternal Bolts, one Bolt has also been renamed:Demolition Breaker Arrow → Demolition Breaker ArrowsArrow of Ruination → Arrows of RuinationPerseus Voiceless Arrow→ Perseus Voiceless ArrowsHandmade Bolts → Handmade BoltThe item descriptions for the various Mana Bullets have had their format unified.The following items have been renamed:Melodic Metal Board → Melodic Metal PlateFalias Rain Drop → Falias Raindrops
Web Shop Improvements
Over the next few months, we’ll be overhauling the Web Shop to better suit Milletian needs and desires per all your wonderful feedback in our survey earlier this year. Starting this month, the following changes have been made:
[table noborder=1][tr][td]The following items have been added to the Web Shop:Rainbow Name/Chat Color Change Box2x Skill Training Potion Selection BoxOpen to select a [Talent] Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Age Potion Selection BoxOpen to select an Age Potion (Ages 9 to 19)The following items have been removed from the Web Shop:Crusader Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Chain Slash 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Ninja Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Puppeteer Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Music Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Fighter Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Dual Gun Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Alchemy Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Magic Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Combat Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Life Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Age Potion - Age 10Age Potion - Age 11Age Potion - Age 12Age Potion - Age 13Age Potion - Age 14Age Potion - Age 15Age Potion - Age 16Age Potion - Age 17Age Potion - Age 18[/td][td width=35%]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5xonndnz/aug-shop-items.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Bug Fixes
This is a fix-heavy patch, with some unmentioned smaller text fixes, as we continue to polish Mabinogi to a shine. There is a lot of text in this update (like last month!), and while we hope as ever that there aren't any issues, we aim to fix any that do get reported by you with expedience! ♥
Adjusted the song answers for Musical Math Dungeon to match the proper song titles.Under certain specifications, an issue was causing Gold-Leaf Pine Cones to stack in values less than 1000 when registering them in the Handicraft menu.When creating an Elite Shadow Mission party via the Shadow Mission Board with an invalid name, the Shadow Mission pass would be lost to the shadow realm. A ward has been put in place to prevent your passes from being lost.On relevant weapons, the item attribute for "Piercing Can Be Added" was missing a proper line break and was running cozy with the line before it. It should now respect the boundaries of others.Fixed several display issues with the following outfits:(Special) Moonlit Howls Outfit (M) & Moonlit Howls Gloves (M)(Special) Astraea Stella Wear (F) & Astraea Stella Heels (F)(Special) Royal Brawler Outfit (M)(Special) Royal Brawler Outfit (F) & Royal Brawler Heels (F)Neon Blossom Shinobi Gloves (F) (for giants)(Special) Winter Fairy Long Outfit (F) (with Demigod)Cowenna's Outfit (M) & Cowenna's Gloves (M)Moonlight Hunter's Hat (M) (for giants)Ravenscall HaloEochaid's Outfit (F) & Eochaid's Shoes (F)(Special) Blue Dragon's Chosen Robe (F) & Blue Dragon's Chosen Wristguards (F)Simple Autumn Wear (M) & Chic Autumn Wear (M)Helionic Chariot Halo & Selenian Chariot Halo(Special) Sunbather's Paradise Wear (F) & (Special) Sunbather's Bliss Wear (F)(Special) Sunbather's Paradise Wear (M)Soldier's Combat RaincoatQueen of Hearts StaffSpecial Neon Blossom Shinobi Wear (F) (during the motion)Celtic Control Bar (for giants)(Special) Eternal Resistance Outfit (M) & Eternal Resistance Shoes (M)Folamh's Set (all pieces)Midnight Investigator (F) (all pieces, when Resting)(Special) Crocus High School Warm-Weather Uniform (M) (for giants)Improved the texture on Homestead Timepiece Mechanism A.Fixed a rigging error when equipped with Lightning Two-handed Sword Appearance Scroll and Eternal Resistance Replica Sniper Rifle Two-Handed Blunt Weapon Appearance Scroll.Corrected some overlapping textures on the Cwn Annwn pets.Fixed an issue causing the Naraka Inferno wings to be unable to be picked up from the ground unless Alt was held.The Dark Erg spilling forth from Crom Bas was causing Brielle's body to warp during the Crom Bas storyline missions. Nothing our brave sundrop couldn't handle--she has dispelled the effect and once again looks just like the picture on her archaeologist's license.Behold! The magical "Pig Cooking Pot" and "Antique Cooking Pot"! See how they cook food, despite not having any flame beneath them whatsoever! Yours for the low pri- no! The flame has come back?!The following Homestead Props were difficult to select, and have been adjusted to make them easier to move:
Homestead Halloween Flagstone (Partial)Homestead Halloween Flagstone (Whole)Homestead Halloween Pumpkin Flagstone (Whole)Adjusted the menu present when right-clicking items to better fit some rarer text options. Lookin' at you, Classic Spirit Weapons.A vile and insidious curse befell elves holding the Royal Mage Cane- their footsteps would fall silent, as if their existence was denied! Thankfully, in the whisper of the night, they have returned, as if nothing had happened.The visual effect for the Eclipse 2nd title was appearing incorrectly under certain animations and has been corrected.The visual effect for the Ruler of the Stage of Trials 2nd title will no longer render incorrectly when equipped by giants.During G2's Paladin Training Courses cutscene, the ground texture was previously not visible. A rendering error, or a possible preview of a later storyline- you decide!Some Sewing Patterns for Bonita Plumed Ankle Boots were showing as blank. They have been restored to the correct functionality.The weapon upgrades that were named "Break [weapon name] Seal", or similar names, have been unified to "[weapon name] Unsealing". 
Before example: Break Infinite Bow SealAfter example: Infinite Bow UnsealingAn unused setting was present in the hotkey menu and has been removed.
Bugs fixed during the July 24th Maintenance
In addition to the below list, we've also included fixes for several smaller typos (such as a missing space after your character name in the Arcana questlines) and text display errors from the July patch. There was a high word count in this update (same for next month! exciting times for Mabinogi~), so we are thankful for the quick reports to allow us to make quicker fixes.The Talent icons for the Arcanas were slightly misaligned. Laoire was informed and he has since brought them back in line.The notification text when using a Memory of a Story book has been adjusted to show in full.The ranking list shown when viewing the Previous Guild Point Rank Info has had the test guilds removed, and will now display the proper rankings.
Congrats to Goodmorning for having the most Guild Points earned prior to the Guild Renewal!The Duration text for Divine Retribution was incorrect and has been adjusted. This is a text only error; no gameplay has been adjusted.
At Rank 1:
Before: Equal to the Shield skill with the longest duration + 6 sec.After: Equal to the Shield skill with the longest durationThe additional duration time was a holdover from a previous version of the skill that had a much longer cooldown, and no behavior that could reduce the cooldown.The Little Morning Star Homestead Figures (from the Flying High Event) were incorrectly able to be placed in the Relic equipment slots. As these are not proper Relics, we have fixed these items to no longer be equippable. We have unequipped these Figures from characters that had them equipped, and placed them back into your inventory.
Known Bugs
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.pngThere are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.
The Mabinogi Team has been working hard to investigate fixes for the lag issues that have been occurring of late. With the many new Milletians entering Erinn, we love to see Mabinogi growing and flourishing, though we recognize this hasn’t been without issues. In the future, we will send a letter about our plans to address and improve the network latency. We apologize again for the impacted gameplay, and thank you for your patience as we determine the causes.

notes.title: Guild Renewal Update
notes.notes:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/aonb2vws/250526-wgc-2054-mb-guildrenewal-1400x300.jpg
[hr][/hr]
Active Events/Sales/Promotions
[table][tr][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/yc5jvkgv/250527_summerfestivalevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/td][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/grwk4o3n/250530_southseasailorbox_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/td][/tr][tr][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1694/250303-wgc-1841-mb-panscheckinevent-940x290.jpg[/td][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/kdwjfugb/250523-wgc-2063-mb-outfitpakagesale-940x290.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/rurdjmvc/250403-erinnpassevent_940x290.jpg[/td][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/tamjcquk/250519_mb_ravenscallbox_wgc-2006_940x290-1.jpg[/td][/tr][tr][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ylxh1ugg/260529_mb_glennbearnaevent_wgc-2057.jpg[/td][td] [/td][/tr][/table]
(Click the banners to go to that event/sales/promotion webpage)
Guild Renewal
Guilds have been a cornerstone of Erinn since Mabinogi first released! While the strengths and bonds between Guild Members is unique for each guild, the system to help foster those bonds had been severely neglected. We hope that this massive renewal of the Guild System will continue fostering new bonds between Guildmates that cannot be found anywhere else.
A new Guild Home UI has been created and added to the game to house most guild-related things.A new Guild Menu button has been added to the bottom of the screen to open the Guild Home.The Guild Home and Guild List buttons at the bottom of the friends messenger window have been removed.All Guild Stones will be removed with the update. The following features have been added to the Guild Home UI:Guild Search
You will be able to search by Guild Name and/or Guild Master.Tag Filtering is now possible to find the guild that suits your playstyle best.Guild Recommendation
When not in a guild, opening the Guild Menu will open the “Recommended Guilds” tab.Guilds that have a healthy activity record will have priority in the displayed list.Guild Member Play Rankings
Guild Members will be able to compete against other members of their guild to be displayed on a Leaderboard for certain activities.Guild Portrait
Guild Portraits allow Guild Members to be displayed on the Guild Home screen.Spend Guild Points or Gold to unlock new locations, the number of members that can be displayed, and more.Guild Guide
Will guide you to the official web Guild Guide.A new NPC, Siobhan, has been added to take over the duties of Eavan and Sinead.Talk to Siobhan outside the Guild Hall to start the first quest.Siobhan is normally located inside the Guild Hall.Three (3) new Guide Quests titled [Guild] A Guild-ed Opportunity have been added to introduce the changes to the Guild System.Talk to Siobhan outside the Guild Hall to start the 1st quest.After completing A Guild-ed Opportunity (1), Siobhan will open the Guild Shop for Guild Members, and be in charge of handling changes made to the Guild Banner, Guild Robe, and when available, Guild Title.Guild Leveling and perks have been added.Guilds can now level up, earning perks with each level.The types of Perks a guild has unlocked or yet to unlock can be viewed through the “Perks” tab in the Guild Menu.Leveling will require a set amount of Guild Points (GP) and Guild Gold (GG), contributed by members of the guild.Members can still donate GP if the guild is at the cap to earn Guild Coins, but the GP will not be credited to the guild.All Guild Points prior to the update will be reset. The maximum amount of GP a Guild Member can now hold is 2,000.The maximum amount of GP a guild can now have is equal to the amount required for leveling up.Members can still donate GP if the guild is at the cap to earn Guild Coins, but the GP will not be credited to the guild.Donations of GP will reward the donor with Guild Coins.Guild Coins are a new currency, allowing Guild Members to purchase items from the new Guild Shop through the Guild Assistant Siobhan.Guild Missions have been added.Two different types of Guild Missions have been added:Guild Field Missions - band with your Guildmates to defeat a Field Boss and earn GP.Guild Life Mission - deliver materials per the NPC's request to earn GP based on your score.Each Guild Member can earn GP from both Field and Life Missions up to 3 times per week.A Guild Shop has been added.The new Guild Shop is available for all Guild Members starting at Guild Level 1 through Siobhan in the Guild Hall.The Guild Shop only accepts Guild Coin (GC) and all items are subject to a weekly purchase limit per character.A guild can level up the shop by reaching Guild Level to access the “Guild Shop Level 2” tab containing more powerful items.[table noborder=1][tr][td]Guilds can now create Guild Banners.The ability to create Guild Banners is unlocked when a guild reaches Level 6.Creation of a Guild Banner will cost the guild 25,000 Guild Points and 10,000,000 Gold.Guild Banners can be crafted through Siobhan in the Guild Hall.A Guild Banner will apply the same emblem, embroidery, and border used in the Guild Robe.Guild Banners can only be wielded by the Guild Master.Guild Banners can be planted when a guild Reaches Level 9.Planting a banner will create an interactable banner, and will remain for 10 minutes or until the Guild Master leaves the map.[/td][td width=30%]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ex4hsiej/guild-banners.png[/td][/tr][/table]Additional Guild Changes:All web functionality of guilds has been removed.The "Guilds" tab will be removed from the Mabinogi Website.Member requirement for creating a guild has been reduced from 5 players to 2.The Guild Hall is now available immediately upon creation of a guild.Guild Leaders can now assign up to 3 Guild Officers.Functionality of duties between Guild Leader, Guild Officers, and Members/Senior Members has been updated.Guild Leaders can now withdraw up to 100 million gold per day from the Guild Treasury.The requirements of disbanding a guild have been updated to require only the Guild Leader to remain in the guild.The cooldown time for leaving and joining another guild has been reduced from 1 week to 24 hours after joining the previous guild.An “Immediate Join” option has been added, allowing players to instantly join a guild without waiting for approval, if the guild allows it.Guild Quests sold by Eavan have been removed.The method for obtaining Guild Points have changed:
Before: 1 GP per 10 minutes; 5 GP per level up.After: 1 GP per minute; available through Guild Missions.The Guild Points requirement for the Guardian Guild Tournaments has been reduced from 15,000 GP to 1,000 GP.
Read more in-depth about guilds and all the new changes in the dedicated Guild Guide!
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5uifjiey/guildguide-1400x300.jpg
Tutorial Improvements
Arcana Achievement Missions
Arcana Achievement Missions have been added for Milletians that have yet to acquire an Arcana on any character of their account.Accounts that have an Arcana unlocked on any of their characters are not eligible for this questline.Only one character can progress through the questline.Upon completing the Third Memoir of Blannid’s Brave Boost questline, you’ll receive a Guide Quest to talk to Eavan in Dunbarton to register for the questline.You can confirm the progress of the questline by going to Guides → Arcana Achievement Mission in your bottom menu bar.Alternatively, you can select “View Arcana Achievement Mission” by opening your Quest Log.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/n2cnfvgd/arcana-achievement-missions.pngThe Arcana Achievement Mission UI will provide you with information on what your next Cumulative Point Rewards are, what the next step in your current quest is, and additional details for better understanding.Only one quest is given each real life day (17 quests in total)The next quest after completing one will be delivered at 7:00 AM Server Time the next day.When completing objectives, you will receive Arcana Achievement Mission Points as a reward.Upon accumulating enough Arcana Achievement Mission Points, you’ll receive the current Cumulative Point Rewards listed.Tutorial Improvements ft. Blaanid
The introductory tutorial quests have been improved.
The quests [Tutorial] Battle in Erinn, [Tutorial] Basics of Battle, and [Tutorial] To The Outside World have been removed.Milletians that were actively on the quests can proceed naturally.The removed quest rewards can be obtained from previous quests.When creating a new character, some guidance messages have been added to the upper right corner of the screen.When entering the Soul Stream in certain situations, the following UI will now be hidden:Skill slotsChatNotificationsEvent windowsSome of the specifications of the tutorial zone have been changed.Some chats and notifications in the UI will be hidden in the tutorial zone.Some of Nao’s dialogue has been adjusted to account for the various tutorial changes.[Tutorial] Item Equipping and Usage will no longer provide Lorna's Stadium Horn.After completing the revamped Tutorial, Milletians will receive the books “Traveler’s Guide Life Edition” and “Traveler’s Guide Combat Edition”.These books can also be purchased from Aeira in Dunbarton.Some of the contents of the "Traveler's Guide" book when creating a new character has been changed to improve readability."Practical Course - Talent Experience" has been added to the courses that can be ordered on the Beginner's Combat Course bulletin board.By taking this course, you can experience various talent skills.When a beginner rebirths, they can obtain the beginner title of the Talent they selected, and the beginner title will not be removed.In addition, some of the title descriptions have been changed due to the specification change.Blannid’s Memory Book
The introductory quests have been improved.
The tutorial quest [Tutorial] Rebirth and Talent has been removed.As a result, a Milletian's first guided Rebirth will be led by Blaanid.Milletians that were actively on the quests can proceed naturally.The Chain Slash questline has been removed from Blaanid’s Memoir quests.Throughout Blaanid’s quests, various visual glowing indicators have been placed at objectives to help Milletians find their way.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/4uwafqib/blaanid-ooooh-shinyyyyy.pngWhen Blaanid’s Memory Book is in progress, a button will appear at the bottom of the quest window.If you have not purchased any items upon Rebirthing, the purchase confirmation pop-up window will not appear.
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/qkhgsmve/blaanid-brave-boost-quest-mark.png
Other Fantasy Life ChangesThe Auto-Pathing function has been improved.Teleport fees are waived if your cumulative level is below 10,000 or if you have an active Basic VIP Membership.If you are on the same continent and not in a restricted area, you also have the option to Go on Foot without spending any Gold.When viewing Quest Info, you can now teleport to the nearest Moon Gate.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ovgoivyj/auto-pathing-june-update.gifStack Sizes for certain items have been increased.We know that carrying several of the same item can be cumbersome, so we’ve now made the following items stackable and/or had their stack limits increased to 100!Rebirth PotionForgetful PotionTendering PotionSpecial Tendering Potion (S, SS, and SSS)Likability PotionChat Color Change PotionName/Chat Color Change PotionEnchant Protection PotionEnchant Extraction Protection PotionTrade Unlock PotionHeight PotionAge Potion - Age 9 ~ 19Partner Age Potion - 9 ~ 19Partner Age Potion - Max AgePet Age Potion - Age 1 ~ 5Combat 2x EXP PotionLadeca Combat 4x EXP PotionPet EXP PotionLife Skill 2x EXP PotionCombat Skill 2x EXP PotionMagic Skill 2x EXP PotionAlchemy Skill 2x EXP PotionMartial Arts Skill 2x EXP PotionMusic Skill 2x EXP PotionPuppetry 2x EXP PotionDual Gun 2x EXP PotionNinja 2x EXP PotionSpeed Walk Potion (30%)Speed Walk Potion (40%)Complete Skill EXP PotionRoyal Complete EXP PotionMonster Drop Booster PotionFishing Booster PotionDragon Knight’s PotionMagic Power PotionMagic Speed PotionPhysical Power PotionAll [Skill Name] Training PotionsE.g. Fury of Connous Training PotionAll [Skill Name] Production Boost PotionsAll [Skill Name] Quality Increase PotionsAll Restorative Potions (HP, MP, Stamina, Wound), including:
SERELiquidsCrystalsBeginnerBuffComprehensiveFull RecoveryBase PotionChildlike Green PerfumeChildlike Yellow PerfumeChildlike Pink PerfumeYouthful Black PerfumeMature Red PerfumeHoly Water of LymilarkMassive Holy Water of LymilarkDiet Potion UDiet Potion LDiet Potion FFlintWe’ve also increased the following item stack limits to 200!
Light Magic Power PotionLight Magic Speed PotionLight Physical Power Potion
*Note: The stack improvements will also apply for various items with suffix tags, such as (Event), (Untradable), (Can be Traded Once), (30 min), (1 Day), etc.
The following Phoenix pets have been renamed:
White Phoenix -> Mistborn PhoenixBlue Phoenix -> Cerulean PhoenixThe following items have been renamed:
Special Eluned Classic Maid Dress (M) -> Eluned Special Classic Maid Dress (M)Special Eluned Classic Butler Outfit (F) -> Eluned Special Classic Butler Outfit (F)Baseball Bat -> Baseball Bat (M)Pom Poms -> Pom Poms (F)Water Spirit Ankle Straps -> Water Spirit Ankle Straps (F)Water Spirit Sandals -> Water Spirit Sandals (M)The training method for Rain Casting requiring one to "Produce something under a cloud" has been expanded to make the action more clear- "Successfully perform the finishing steps of production under a cloud".The required method itself has not changed, only the description.We have truncated the text tags on Commerce Mounts within the Commerce Trading menu, to allow more of the name to be visible.
[Partner] -> [P][Guild] -> [G]Commerce Alban Heruin Season 1
[table noborder=1][tr][td]Seasonal Commerce Alban Heruin Season 1 will begin at 7:00 AM PDT on July 3rd 2025 and run until November 6th, 2025 7:00 AM PST.[Claim Previous Seasonal Ranking Rewards] and [View Previous Seasonal Ranking] buttons will be deactivated during the reset time, and re-activated when you open commerce UI after the previous season's ranking is compiled.Alban Heruin Season 1 will conclude on November 6th, 2025 7:00 AM PST.Viewing the season rankings and claiming previous season’s rewards will be disabled for 30 minutes after the season is changed to ensure that the ranking compilation can be completed before rankings and rewards are distributed.Purchase limits within Trade Merchant’s shops and Sayiv’s shop will be reset.The following items have been added to the Erinn Merchants' Guild Souvenir Box.Cone Hat Balloon Pony WhistleFestival Troublemaker Alo WhistleThe Alban Heruin Season 1 Challenger Box will be available, containing the following items:**NEW** Alban Heruin Season 1 Challenger 2nd TitleMovement Speed +3%Mistborn Phoenix Whistle
20x Precise Reforging Tools (Expire after 30 Days)[/td][td width=40%]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/twwi1xt1/alban-heruin-season-1-challenger-2nd-title.gif[/td][/tr][/table]
Bug Fixes
A few fixes in this auspicious update, with some typical typo fixes alongside them. We like telling you that we're still fixing these typos, and hearing your wonderful reports, we just don't always feel these smaller items are worth highlighting individually as they're typically uninteresting!
The icon for the status effect Support Shot was missing and has been added.A few otherwise fine folk in Erinn were sporting an overly bald look, appearing as if they had no hair or skull! Spooky! We asked them to don their hair proper, and they will be showing correctly moving forward.A fix for the recent issue causing audio to behave unexpectedly, such as overlapping BGM, has been added and the issues should be quelled.Small modeling fixes have been made to improve the display of the Shadow Reaper (F) set.The following Weapon Appearance Scrolls were displaying the incorrect name when applied, and will now show their correct name:
Ravenscall Hunter's Shotgun CrossbowRavenscall Shotgun CrossbowMorpho Dreamwood Long BowMorpho Dreamwood Two-Handed SwordThe description for Clairvoyant Wings Orb was updated to properly indicate that it grants Placid Shining Forest Wings instead of Placid Folded Shining Forest Wings.Slight corrections to the following Enchants, to better reflect the actual skill names:
Alchemist'sDazedGalacticTiltedWitch

[hr][/hr]Improvements
Partners
Several changes to Partners have been made.
Partner Card purchases will now appear in your inventory as an in-game item.Using the card from the inventory will create a Partner Card on the character creation menu.Partner Cards are tradeable with other players.The following Partners and their Mounts are now permanent items on the Cash Shop:MaidButlerCommercePartner’s Magical BroomPartner’s Noble CarriagePartner’s Long BoatPartner Mount PackageEquipment items equipped by Partners are no longer bound and can be retrieved by the player without the use of a Partner Trade Unlock Potion.
All remaining Partner Trade Unlock Potions have been removed as a result.Partner Trade Unlock Potions that have been purchased from the Cash Shop since April 1st, 2024 and unused will be refunded the amount purchased in NX.Partner Trade Unlock Potions sold on the Auction House, but the funds are still unclaimed, will be claimed with the gold being delivered via mailbox.A Style Tab has been added for Partners.
Tail and Facewear Slots have been added.Newly created Laighlinne Partners will now have 5x Partner Stat Training Kits in their inventory.
Players who previously had a Laighlinne Partner created before the update will receive 5x Partner Stat Training Kits in the mailbox on their highest-leveled character.The Gift function has been improved.
The maximum number of daily gifts you can give to your Partner has been increased.
Before: 5After: 10A Partner’s favorability now increases further when gifting an item.
Before: 2After: 5Partners will now only accept a certain type of gift.
Maid: HerbsButler: FishLaighlinne: InstrumentsCommerce/William/Rem/Ram: GemsPartners have been given a “Partner Exclusive” tab in their shop containing Partner Age Potions and Homestead Partner Basic Motion Card Boxes.
Partner Age Potions do not reset on Saturdays.You can now change most Partners' body type and height.
A Partner’s weight, upper body, and lower body can be modified similar to a player’s body through the use of Hot Springs and feeding them food.A Partner’s height can be modified through the use of Partner Age Potions.William and Commerce Partners cannot have their body type or height modified.Multi-person chairs can now be used with Partners.
A Partner can only be seated on a multi-person chair placed by the Milletian who summoned them.After sitting on the multi-person chair, you can change the seat that your summoned Partner occupies through right-clicking your Partner and selecting “Sit Together”.Some Partners' dialogue and lines have been updated.A “Disable Basic Interaction” button has been added in the menu options when right-clicking a Partner.
Toggling this option will hide all speech bubbles and dialogue, as well as motions by the Partner.
Party System
The Party Creation Menu UI has been updated.
Regular Parties and Dungeon Parties have been merged.
The ability to restrict parties by Skill Level has been removed as of a result.The maximum length of a party name has been increased to 50 characters.Leaving a party name blank will auto-populate with "[Character Name]’s Party."
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/muzdwpk2/before-after-party-creation-ui.png
The Party Menu UI has been updated.
The “Wanted” button has been renamed to “Recruit Locally”.
The Recruitment Notice above your character will no longer expire.The [Wanted] party recruitment messages will no longer appear in the party chat.The width of the UI has been expanded for better visibility of text.Added new functionality buttons:
Recruit on Party Board - adds/removes your party from the Party Bulletin Board.Move to Destination - teleports you to the pre-determined location.Recruit via Bugle - allows you to send a bugle with the party information.The Party Bulletin Board UI has been updated.
All parties, regardless of objective, will be displayed as a default view.You can now search via party name directly (case-sensitive).The ability to move parties to a preset destination has been added.
When creating a Normal Party, the following locations have been added as destinations to teleport to:
Glenn BearnaCrom BásTech DuinnMag MellAvalon PurificationSidhe FinnachaidAlban KnightsTaillteann Shadow MissionTara Shadow MissionHard Mode Alby Advanced DungeonRabbie PhantasmAbyss Peaca Advanced DungeonHard Mode Rundal Advanced DungeonA 30-second cooldown has also been added to prevent teleport spamming.You can now right click → Invite to Join Party.If not in a party, this will create the party and send an invite to the player.This option is available through the Player, Friends List, and Guild List.This can be done across channels / maps.Added a Bugle Recruitment Feature.
When a destination is determined in a party, the “Recruit via Bugle” option will be available in the Party Menu UI.A ‘Horn Bugle - World’ item is required and consumed when used.
The Horn Bugle - World with the shortest expiration timer will be consumed first.Using the feature will display a clickable message with the party information in the message log, allowing other players to join with ease.
The bugle message will begin with a # symbol and have an outline around the message.Players joining the party via clicking the bugle message will be prompted to change channels (if necessary) and move to the destination.The bugle link is valid for up to 3 minutes.
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/d0bps5lr/bugle-party-message.png
Emblems
A new UI has been added for synthesizing Alban Knight and Commander emblems.Right-click an Alban Knight or Commander emblem and select "Synthesize" to open the synthesis UI.It is no longer possible to combine emblems through the "drag and drop" method.A "Training Camp" tab has been added to Shaun's shop in the Alban Knights Training Camp with the following items:Unadorned Alban Knights EmblemRune of BodyRune of MindRune of SharpnessRune of IngenuityRune of Mana*New* Alban Knights Rune BoxThis box will contain a random chance at an Unadorned Emblem or any of the 5 Runes.A "Commander" tab has been added to the Royal Quartermaster's shop in the Tech Duinn Lobby with the following items:Unadorned Commander's EmblemRune of Command: Phantasmal SightRune of Command: FateweaverRune of Command: Tenacious TauntRune of Command: Zone of RenewalRune of Command: Unified Might*New* Rune of Command BoxThis box will contain a random chance at an Unadorned Emblem or any of the 5 Runes.
Auction House
You can now preview Hair Dyes and Chairs through the Auction House.An “All” category has been added to the top of the Category list.
Categories can now be expanded/collapsed with a single click rather than double click.The following items can now be sold/purchased via the Auction House: 
Clothing/Outfits:Aladdin ShoesBadoura CostumeCat ArmorCat Armor (Giant)Cheerleader BootsChina 7th Anniversary Headdress (F)China 7th Anniversary Headdress (M)China 7th Anniversary Outfit (F)China 7th Anniversary Outfit (M)China 7th Anniversary Ring    China 7th Anniversary Shoes (F)China 7th Anniversary Shoes (M)Clover Pig Costume (F)Clover Pig Costume (M)Dorren's RobeGoggle ShadesGreat Goggle ShadesHeart EyepatchLollipop Heart EyepatchMabinogi School ShoesOrnamented CrownPop Star BraceletPop Star DressPop Star EarringsPop Star ShoesStyle SunglassesTaoist BraceletTaoist CostumeTaoist HeaddressTaoist ShoesWeapons:Carpinus Healing WandChef's Passion  Metal Ice WandMetal Lightning WandPanacea Healing WandPop Star Conductor BatonRuyuefeixue's Butterfly FanScythe that Reaps DarknessChairs:Double SunbedSingle SunbedMisc. Items:Ballista Bolt (Merchant Group)Ruined Bonita Twin Tail RibbonsBonita Twin Tail Ribbons Repair KitBroken Ruyuefeixue's Butterfly FanRuyuefeixue's Butterfly Fan Repair Kit  Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon Mirror World PassReceiver of Nao's Blessing Title CouponTotem Reset Coupon
[hr][/hr]Patch Notes
Fantasy Life Changes
Keyword Highlights have been added to the Chat Menu Options.When an added word/phrase is said in chat, it will be highlighted to draw your attention.You may add up top 10 words/phrases, with a maximum of 20 characters per entry.Management of this system is located in Options → Social → Chat → Manage Highlighted Keywords 
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/k2ufgwht/image-22.png
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/dhanq0x4/image-23.png
Your chat log history will not reset upon changing channels.It will still reset upon logging in/out of the game however. Clicking a player's name on the Message Log will now bring up the Report User window. The in-game Cash Shop has received an update:The window will now load directly in your Mabinogi client, rather than as an external window.The specifications and security have been updated.The calculations performed when production crafting have been modified to capture the state when starting the craft. This will prevent situations where the display showed 100%, but it was still possible to fail, even when successfully clearing the crafting mini-game.The setting to hide the visibility of your Support Puppet will now be saved when swapping to different Extra Equipment Slots.Shadow Missions that previously required you to be in a party to progress, such as The Secret of Scathach Caverns, will now allow those not in a party to progress when speaking with the NPCs.It's dangerous to go alone, but you got this!You no longer need to meet the requirements to teleport to the entrance of Sidhe Finnachaid when using the Dungeon Guide.Expanding/Collapsing a Group in your friends list now only requires a single-click instead of double-click.In line with our rename change to Fragarach, we have also renamed the G25 sword from Luminous Cross-hilt Sword to The Answerer.Combo Card Slot Change Coupons have been modified to allow them to be destroyed via the Trash Can.Character Card purchases will now appear in your inventory as an in-game item.Using the card from the inventory will create a Character Card on the character creation menu.Character Cards are tradeable with other players.With this change, Hero and Elite Character cards have been removed from the Cash Shop.
Bug Fixes
Smaller text fixes this month for some of the Shop related dialogue with NPCs, some C7 NPC text polish, more changes to the Party and Partner related texts, and unification of some of the Lance item descriptions to better convey the gameplay. Thank you for your eyes with each update. We're glad we can continue to make this game clean.Improvements have been made to the newly added Pet Parade action that allow it to perform better under higher latencies.The (old) Doki Doki Island quest Natural Dye Event has been cleared from all accounts. Apologies for the confusion!Doll Bag Storage Chests will once again show the contents that are stored within the chest.Shopkeeping Milletians of Dunbarton and elsewhere (though mostly Dunbarton…) - you will once again be able to check the set price of your wares when reviewing your merchandise.
Belvast Merchants where ya be? 😭The range of Smokescreen was increased to 15m with the Battle Astrologer update. The associated skill text has been updated to reflect this change.With the update to the in-game Cash Shop browser, the zoom level has been corrected and the page will now display as expected when opening.The button redirects for opening specific Cash Shop pages have been updated to better direct you towards the relevant item(s).Fixed an issue where the status effect from a Carpentry Quality Increase Potion was not properly removing itself when failing a crafting attempt.
Changes during the March 20th Maintenance
As mentioned in our April Update, the following mythological sword and accompanying technique have been renamed, and all accompanying text (such as from the storyline) has been replaced:Pragarah -> FragarachSeal: Pragarah -> Seal: Fragarach[table][tr][td]【 Localization Note 】
The Localization Team has wanted to correct "Pragarah" for several years now, re-localizing it to its proper mythological name "Fragarach" (which, in Gaelic, translates to "The Answerer"). After all, just as one would never expect to see "Excalibur" rendered otherwise in a game based on Arthurian legend, Fragarach ought to hold a similar status when one discusses the tales of Ireland. With the recent updates to the Seal: Fragarach skill, we finally had the opportunity to make the change to this odd artifact of legacy localization. The Mabinogi Team hopes that this small yet meaningful change will help foster a deeper connection with the Celtic lore that serves as the inspiration for so many characters, places, and events within the world of Erinn.[/td][/tr][/table]
Bug Fixes during the March 20th Maintenance
An issue was causing the Def/MDef/Prot/MProt reduced via Brionac and Seal: Fragarach to be lower than expected. This has been fixed, and both should be reducing the values in the same way to the appropriate amounts.The description of this year's Lovely Doki Doki Commemorative Box has been updated to reflect the proper outfit.The Life Exploration Tools now correctly line break in the Item Attribute field.DJ Romantic will be coming back from his "judging competition" on April 17th instead of April 24th. He wrote the wrong date in his calendar, it seems.Reserve Attack settings will now save upon logging out/changing channels.Fixed an issue where an untranslated message was showing when a Trade Unlock Letter of Guarantee when applied on an item.The family name of Zeder was retranslated from Shiarpe to Scharp.
Known Bugshttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.pngThere are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.

notes.title: 17th Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1570/17thanni-news-940x290.jpg
[hr][/hr]Simplenogi
Options Menu
 The Options Menu has been overhauled and updated to better assist Milletians with their settings.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1686/options-menu-before-after.png
Tabs/Categories in the Options have been re-labeled and reorganized.All customizable options have been rearranged to fit the updated tab/category.Many options now have hover text to further explain their functionality.The following customization options have been removed and are permanently activated:
DitheringSky RenderingRendering SpecularShadow BlurringEnable HotkeysQuick EquipHighlight New ItemsGiant / Nascent Divinity Camera Height Adj.The following customization options have been removed and will be permanently disabled:Reserve AttackAuto-Attack is not being removed and has been relocated to the Gameplay tab.The following customization options were removed due to the option not working as intended:Use NPC Theme MusicUsing 3D SoundNew customizable settings have been added to the Options Menu:Horn Bugle - World Prem.Located under Gameplay → System → View Announcements.Unchecking this box will prevent all text from World Premium Bugles from appearing. Regular Bugles will still appear as normal in the Horn Channel.Video VolumeLocated under Sound → Video.You can now adjust the volume of video cutscenes.
Allow Astral ImagingLocated under Gameplay → Social → Community.Toggle this option for All players, Party members, or Guildmates only.The following customization options have been added to the Gameplay → Display → Show/Hide section to help increase visibility of the world of Erinn.Talent Title and Icon2nd Title IconMonster Fynni Gem IconGuild Name (Self)Guild Name (Others)Doll BagsPet/Partner NamesMonster Names (Non-Boss)Damage Skin (Others)Erg Effects (Self)Erg Effects (Others)Special Upgrade (Self)Special Upgrade (Others)Pet Fynn Sync Effect
For all above customization options, unchecking the box will remove the display of said effects.All options are checked by default.
When entering Dunbarton square, the Simplified Display Options pop-up window will appear.Clicking “Apply” will apply the recommended “Simplenogi” settings.You can still fine-tune your preferences through the Options menu.Clicking “Do not show again” will prevent the pop-up from appearing again.

NPC Shop Menu
The UI of NPC Shops has been changed to a “list” format, allowing for better visibility on items, such as cost, inventory size, and more.You can alternate between the two styles by clicking on “Switch to Bag” / “View as List” in the top right corner of the Shop Menu.A search function has been added.The shop search function is case sensitive.You can now sell up to 14 items at once when selling to an NPC.The repurchase limit from an NPC shop has been increased from 10 to 30.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1687/shop-menu-before-after.png
Title Menu
Title Menu UI has been revamped.Improved search functionality to now include effects from titles.i.e. searching “Speed” will bring up “the Busy” title.The title search function is not case sensitive.Expanded the window for easier viewing of all titles.Added a “Favorites” button to have your favorite titles be automatically listed at the top.You can still right-click a title to add/remove from the favorites’ list.A “Preview Effects” window has been added, allowing for visibility of 2nd Title Visual Effects.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1688/title-menu-before-after.png
Other Simplenogi Changes:
Talent Title icons and 2nd Title icons will now be vertically centered based on all tags displayed in the name area (Guild, Talent, Name, etc.)Spirit Transformation Liqueur (Invisible) is now available in Berched’s shop in Taillteann.When applied, all visual effects from the Spirit Weapon will be invisible.When defeating (most) non-boss monsters, the name will now be hidden and its body will turn transparent before disappearing.The Combat Log will no longer list when you’ve made a critical hit on an enemy.Auto-pathingAuto-pathing has now been added to the game as an improvement to the auto-navigation system for Milletians and their Pets.When clicking a location on the mini-map, a set route will automatically appear, allowing your character to run or ride all the way to its destination without making a 2nd marker.Auto-pathing is only available in the overworld and is not available in some areas or conditions such as:CommercingDungeonsShadow MissionsStellar CitadelAny Doki Doki FlightAuto-pathing will remember your pathing when on a mount and alternating between ground and sky.The auto-pathing must be set before taking flight.Patch Notes
Fantasy Life Changes
The Library of Secrets has been added as a Deluxe Background for Astral Imprinting.The name for the visual-only halo for Blaanid's Blessing has been renamed from Blessing Effect to Halo Effect. As this drop-down selection was always visual-only, not the strength of Blaanid's Blessing received, we hope that this better communicates as such.The death-defying technique and Cwn Annwn skill, Defiance and Veil of Mystique, have had their priorities altered. When the conditions are met, Defiance will now activate before Veil of Mystique.All non-gold currency will no longer be able to be stored in your bank.Note: Any non-gold currency currently stored in your bank account will be automatically moved to the character based on the tab the currency is stored in.These include currency such as:Dungeon Vouchers (1st Voucher, 2nd Voucher, etc.)Adventure SealsGold-Leaf Pine Cones
Bug Fixes
Thank you all for your continued reports! A lot of smaller text fixes here and there with this patch, notably updating the descriptions for Upgrade Stones to better indicate their use, polishing up text for Fate Astrologer, shortening some of the lengthier buff-related ticker messages, and correcting the necessary book for rank 3 Rest's upgrade. Also, a new description for Cilantro's favorite food!While we were updating the UIs, several text boxes have been updated to better fit the text inside the field.An issue has been fixed that was causing the Set Effect Bash Enhancement +1 Scrolls and Set Effect Windmill Enhancement +1 Scrolls to not work on the following items:Set Effect Bash Enhancement +1 ScrollPerseus Brutal War HammerNightbringer EnforcerSet Effect Windmill Enhancement +1 ScrollPerseus Steeled SwordPerseus Brutal War HammerPerseus Vigilant ShieldNightbringer AssaultNightbringer EnforcerNightbringer VanguardBow-wielding Humans of Erinn, your time has come. The issue causing Arrow Revolver to lock characters in place when the burst fire was cast in extreme rapid succession with other attacks has been fixed. Nock your arrows, fire them well!Under rare circumstances, players could find themselves with two Homestead Houses. The issue has been fixed, allowing players to remove the faulty house.Despite this sounding affluent, this would lock them out from doing most things relating to the House.Effie found a few boxes of clothes in the back of her shop- these items have returned back for purchase in her Shop.Although he's a star, the Treasure Hunter Ace Talent was unintentionally giving 2x Skill Training to Fate Astrologer skills. This has been corrected.Corrected the listed Collection Categories on the Black Moon Commanders Compact Doll Bag Box. The Bag is unchanged.
2/13 Maintenance
The issue causing Astral Frames to display incorrectly (missing subjects/stickers/etc) has been fixed. The issue has occurred one last time with this week's maintenance as we corrected the root of the issue; Astral Frames will stop resetting starting next week. Frames that are currently displaying incorrectly cannot be automatically fixed, and we apologize for the inconvenience.
2/27 Maintenance 
The Black Rose Wig (F) from Tolly's Fashion event was not properly removed- we snatched your wig in this maintenance.
Known Bugs:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.pngFor those truly dedicated to Commerce and keeping Erinn stocked up- when reaching over 4.3 billion ducats, the inventory window will incorrectly return the value to 0.This is a display only issue- if you obtained another 1 billion ducats after this, the display would show 1b but you would correctly have 5.3b.The props used for Special Idle Motions are currently showing incorrectly at the start of animation cycles. There are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.

Additional following changes have been made to the game:

Commerce Baltane Season 3
Seasonal Commerce Baltane Season 3 will begin at 7:00 AM PST on March 6th, 2025 and run until June 6th, 2025 7:00 AM PDT.
Baltane Season 2 will conclude on March 6th, 6:59 AM PST.Viewing the season rankings and claiming previous season’s rewards will be disabled for 30 minutes after the season is changed to ensure that the ranking compilation can be completed before rankings and rewards are distributed.
[Claim Previous Seasonal Ranking Rewards] and [View Previous Seasonal Ranking] buttons will be deactivated during the reset time, and re-activated when you open commerce UI after the previous season's ranking is compiled.Purchase limits within Trade Merchant’s shops and Sayiv’s shop will be reset.The following items will be available in Sayiv’s Limited (Seasonally) shop tab, and have been added to the Erinn Merchants' Guild Souvenir Box.Sturdy Angler's Creel Coupon - 1,000,000 Seasonal Ducats*NEW* Erinn Flower Merchant's Knapsack - 10,000,000 Seasonal Ducats[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td]The Baltane Season 3 Challenger Box will be available, containing the following items:*NEW* Baltane Season 3 Challenger 2nd Title: https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1087/baltane-s2-title.png
(See right for visual effect)
Movement Speed +3%20x Precise Reforging ToolsThe Seasonal Commerce Guide will be updated with Baltane Season 3, and Baltane Season 2 information will be archived.The stock for Bartering and Merchant Group Commerce won't reset.Commerce that has been completed while the season is changing will be refunded, however, please note that the purchase count won't be restored.Additional updates to Commerce are as follows:Added two [Mercantile] quests available after reaching Commerce Rank Silver 5 as a guide quest for the Barter Trading system.[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1396/anaphora-v2.gif[/td][/tr][/table]
Other Changes
Updated the skill description of Fate Foretold to indicate that its damage scales off unique cards drawn, rather than counting any card drawn (example: 5x Wheel of Fortune cards drawn would only count as 1x). This is a text only change.Although technically correct, the best kind of correct, to better differentiate them as well as represent more asterisms we have renamed the seven star version of Ursa Major that appears when Constellation Casting to Big Dipper. We did think about naming it "Ursa Mid" though.
The following bugs have been fixed:
Some text was appearing incorrectly in the Metal Conversion and Fragmentation UIs. The text enjoyed its brief sojourn, and is now back in its proper place.Alchemic Sharpshooter's Arcana Link Level 6 was previously not displaying Archery Talent Weapon Max Damage +100 in the Arcana menu. This was a text only error, and it has been corrected.The "Open with Inventory" option for the Inventory Search window will once again properly save between channel changes and relogs.Corrected an issue where the Grade 20 Chariot Card on was giving less movement speed than expected.The following Title Coupons have been renamed to correct a mismatch. Note that the 2nd Titles themselves are unchanged, and are only listed here to help convey which title you would receive when using the renamed coupon.Beautiful Starlight (Yellow effect)Mysterious Starlight 2nd Title Coupon > Beautiful Starlight 2nd Title CouponMysterious Starlight (Purple effect)Beautiful Starlight 2nd Title Coupon > Mysterious Starlight 2nd Title CouponEnchanting Starlight (Blue effect)Energetic Starlight 2nd Title Coupon > Enchanting Starlight 2nd Title Coupon
The following item has been renamed to properly reflect the skill name.Bullet Storm Mastery Effect Change Card (Dazzling Shower) > Bullet Storm Effect Change Card (Dazzling Shower)The Christmas Tree in Dunbarton has been finally taken down. The resident who was previously responsible for seeing to its removal, whose identity will be kept hidden for her own sake, was previously heard saying "We can just keep it up for another 10 months and it will be correct again. Look, I have books to sell!".Fixed an issue where gold may disappear when unregistering items from the Auction House.Quest Markers will now appear correctly when riding an Antique Mimic Pet. No need to ask random Milletians for directions!Corrected an issue where the trade limit was reset when using an exchange coupon when in possession of specific bags.
The following bugs have been fixed during the January 23rd Maintenance:
Items dropped on the ground will now properly clear from the ground when picked up.Production Boost Potions can no longer be used in Fragmentation.Hey, wait, come back! Fixed an issue where the Raft would escape without you during the G17 Raft Escape quest.
The following are known bugs:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.pngUnder periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.Astral Frames are not saving properly following weekly maintenance, leading to Milletian and other Cards to not appear as expected.There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be purchased on the Web Shop.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.
