notes.title: Astrologer Part 2: Stellar Reunion Update
notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1024/250108_decemberastrologerpart-2_newsarticleheader_940x290.png
[hr][/hr]Update Details
Astrologer Part 1: Written in the Stars

Read the full update details here. The movements of the stars tell stories about our past, present, and even the future. Astrologers study star patterns and make predictions about what the future may hold. People with this special talent can see a multitude of possibilities hidden in the stars. Meet Neal and Delaney, witness the Stellar Citadel, and reach for the stars as you gain new talents and skills, wielding powerful weapons in the new Astrologer update!

Astrologer Part 2: Stellar Reunion

Study your constellations and gain new life skills as the Astrologer update continues! Join Delaney and Neal in the rest of their story after the end of their long journey, and learn the ways of Fate Astrology. Master of many life skills, this type of Astrologer can view fates, catch stars, craft materials, and more!
[hr][/hr]Fate Astrologer[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td]A new Fate Astrologer Talent and 5 new Fate Astrologer skills have been added to the [Astrology] skill tab.Fate Astrologer related items, titles, journal achievements and Grandmaster Quests have been introduced.Additional details for Fate Astrologer can be viewed on the dedicated microsite.[/td][td]          https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1100/fate-astrology-talent.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Astrology Scenario Quests Part 2

Those seeking to craft the stars themselves can begin their journey once they have completed the Astrologer Part 1 Scenario Quests, up to [Astrologer] The Workings of the Stellar Citadel. Begin viewing the possibilities of a Fate Astrologer with Delaney in the Stellar Citadel.New Milletians who choose Fate Astrology for their first talent after rebirthing will be granted ‘the Aspiring Fate Astrologer’ 1st title.Title Effects:Magic Attack +15MP +20HP +20The title is available to you until you reach Level 10,000.Upon visiting Delaney in the Star Citadel, you'll continue the questline with the following quests, rewards, and learned skills:
[Fate Astrology] Wand of Lesser WillpowerComplete the quest to unlock the Constellation Casting skill, 5,000 Gold, 50,000 EXP, a Constellation Rod and 100x Constellation Bait.[Fate Astrology] Pentacle of Good FortuneComplete the quest to unlock the Stellar Handicraft skill, 5,000 Gold, 50,000 EXP, and the materials to craft Constellation Bait.[Fate Astrology] Cup of Overflowing EmotionComplete the quest to unlock the Astral Imaging skill and Astral Imprinting skill, 5,000 Gold, 50,000 EXP, and 20x Astral Sticker Kits.[Fate Astrology] Sword of Fate’s ResolveComplete the quest to unlock the Cartomancy skill, 5,000 Gold, 50,000 EXP, and 10x Conjuration Crystals.Neal and Delaney have been added to the list of NPCs that can be invited through the Spirit Campfire Invitation.Neal: 5x Rigel CrystalDelaney: 1x Neal’s Corn SoupFate Astrologer Skills
General Fate Astrologer Skills
AP Training cannot be used for skills of this talent.When using a skill, a certain amount of mana and stamina will be consumed.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1104/constellation-casting.png Constellation Casting
When the time in Erinn is between 6:00 PM and 6:00 AM, the reflections of the stars are the brightest, and Constellation Casting will be available for use. This is a skill that allows you to obtain Star Reflection fragments, materials used for Stellar Handicraft.Procyon/Polaris/Arcturus/Hadar/Rigel/Canopus/Altair FragmentsProcyon/Polaris/Arcturus/Hadar/Rigel/Canopus/Altair CrystalsThe skill can be used at existing fishing spots.A Constellation Rod and Constellation Bait Box is required to begin casting for the stars' reflection!The Constellation Rod cannot be reforged or upgraded.When fishing manually, you can play a minigame to find constellations. The number of stars you find will be scored, and you can earn Star Reflection fragments depending on the score.After a certain amount of time has passed in the mini-game, stars that are not the correct answer will gradually disappear.If you succeed in matching the stars during the mini-game, a buff effect for the next Constellation Cast will activate an increased biting speed +10.Auto fishing is possible for those that wish to just enjoy the tranquility under the stars.Constellation Casting is not affected by existing Fishing skill related effects.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1105/stellar-handicraft.png Stellar Handicraft
You can create various items used by Astrologers by harnessing the power of Star Reflections paired with the Fatespinner, located in the Stellar Citadel.You can touch the Fatespinner, or use the skill nearby to open the crafting menu.38 new recipes have been added for Stellar Handicraft, including the following items:
AltairAltair CrystalArcturusArcturus CrystalAstral Sticker KitBlank Astral CardCanopusCanopus CrystalConjuration CrystalConstellation BaitConstellation RodCups CardHadarHadar CrystalOracle's PavilionOracle's ToolsPentacles CardPolarisPolaris CrystalProcyonProcyon CrystalRare Cups CardRare Pentacles CardRare Swords CardRare Wands CardRigelRigel CrystalStarter Cups CardStarter Pentacles CardStarter Swords CardStarter Wands CardStellar PowderSwords CardWands CardEntries have been added for Stellar Handicraft in the Crafting Diary.Astrologer Tarot Cards now have Grades from Grade 0 to Grade 30 and can be crafted through Stellar Handicraft.The higher the grade, the better the buff effect from the Tarot Card drawn in Fate Foretold. You can create a Card Pack with Stellar Handicraft.Starter Cards are the lowest grade, with Rare being of the highest grade.When opening a card pack, if a card of the same or lower grade appears, you will obtain an amount of Pollux instead, used to craft new Card Packs.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1101/astral-imagin.png Astral Imaging
Astral Imaging is a skill that can take an image of a Subject, capturing a moment in time.No resources are consumed when using this skill.Capture a subject’s moment by clicking on them. You can capture Milletians (including yourself), NPCs, and monsters.
Transformations, Spirit Weapon Awakenings, and Marionettes cannot be captured.Subjects eligible for Astral Imaging will have an HP gauge displayed above their head when hovering the subject. You cannot capture the subject if it does not have an HP gauge displayed.You can save up to 10 images at one time which will be present in the Astral Imprinting skill menu.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1102/astral-imprinting.png Astral Imprinting
Astral Imprinting is a skill that allows you to decorate your own Tarot Cards using the Subjects captured via Astral Imaging, and various elements including stickers and border designs for your cards.When designing a card via Astral Imprinting, you can add decorations up to 100 points, a cost accumulated when adding elements to the card.
Each decoration element applies the following cost.
Subjects: 8Borders: 2Sticker Shop: 1Extracted Stickers: 2Stickers in the Sticker Shop within the Stickers tab can be selected unlimitedly, each costing 1,000 Gold to place into the design.The cost of the selected stickers will be shown before completing a card.You can create your own stickers by using an Astral Sticker Kit to create stickers using the item icons of items in your inventory.Astral Sticker Kits can be crafted with Stellar Handicraft.When using the kit, you will be able to select which item you would like to create an Astral Sticker Pack for.The kit will be consumed on use. The target item will not be lost.Using the Astral Sticker Pack will add the sticker to your Extracted Stickers within the Stickers tab.Astral Sticker Packs can be traded with others, but cannot be sold on the Auction House.You may also use Astral Sticker Kits by clicking Extract Stickers from the Extracted Stickers menu. When done this way, the Extracted Sticker will be available for immediate use without creating a sticker pack.Using an Astral Sticker Kit on a weapon that has had a Weapon Appearance Scroll applied to it will create a sticker of the transformed weapon.Each extracted sticker may only be used once and will disappear from the Stickers tab after being finalized on a card.Decorative borders are unlocked based on the grade of the Tarot Cards you have acquired, and are unlocked permanently.A variety of card backgrounds are available.You can save the completed decorated cards in Blank Astral Cards, crafted via Stellar Handicraft, and these completed cards can be traded with others.The Astral Frame Homestead prop has been added which can display completed card designs. Astral Frames can be installed on Homesteads and Moonlight Islands using the Astral Frame Homestead item, or 75 Pon through the Construction List.Looking for additional Constellation themed Homestead items? The following Constellations have also been added:Monocerus Constellation (100 Pon)Vulpecula Constellation (75 Pon)Aries Constellation (75 Pon)Cetus Constellation (75 Pon)Completed card designs can be applied as the appearance of a Tarot Card.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1103/cartomancy.png Cartomancy
Cartomancy allows one to consult the cards to receive the guidance of fate, allowing you to either accept it for yourself or share your fate with other Milletians to gain access to the drawn card’s chosen destiny.The guidance of fate will last up to 36 minutes at rank 1.The destiny cannot be overwritten while it is still in effect.Accepting or Sharing will require Conjuration Crystals, an item made using Stellar Handicraft.Each of the 22 tarot cards will have a different effect, shown in the chart below.By Accepting Fate, you will immediately receive the guidance of fate of the drawn card.This will consume 1x Conjuration Crystal, and place the ability on a 36 minute cooldown.The fortune of the reader will be revealed.By Sharing Fate, you grant the guidance of fate to yourself and the allies you have shared the drawn card with.You will be prompted to select how many Milletians to share with, up to 7 at rank 1.The drawn card will be held face down above your head, allowing Milletians to receive the fate alongside you. This will last up to 5 minutes at rank 1.Once all of the shared fates have been foretold, or the reader ends sharing, the drawn card will be received and all players will receive the guidance.This will consume 1x Conjuration Crystal for yourself plus an additional 1x Conjuration Crystal per share (up to 8 Crystals to share with 7 Milletians), and place the ability on a 36 minute cooldown.One may also choose to simply Read Fortune.This will not consume any Conjuration Crystals, but will still place the ability on a 36 minute cooldown. The guidance of fate will not be granted.The fortune of the reader will be revealed. A daily single card reading can give direction to the unknown, or explore possibilities of the future.Oracle’s Tools and Oracle’s Pavilion have been added to allow you to provide readings for others.By using one of these items, the reader will sit, allowing others to take the seat across from them to have their fortunes read.A three-card spread tells of the Past, Present, and Future of a subject.The upright and reversed cards will hold the answers, but we give them meaning.
(Cards drawn in this way will not place the ability on cooldown, and will have no gameplay effect.)

The number of spirits you can contract has been increased by 2, allowing you to contract up to 8 types of Spirit Weapons.Eiry the Ancient Spirit is not included in the maximum contractable quantity.You are now able to search and sort your Point Inventory!You can select your point inventory to display your items in either alphabetical order or by date when you received the item.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1769/point-inventory-search.png

[hr][/hr]
Update Details
Astrologer Part 1: Written in the Stars

The movements of the stars tell stories about our past, present, and even the future. Astrologers study star patterns and make predictions about what the future may hold. People with this special talent can see a multitude of possibilities hidden in the stars. Meet Neal and Delaney, witness the Stellar Citadel, and reach for the stars as you gain new talents and skills, wielding powerful weapons in the new Astrologer update!

Astrologer Part 2 coming early 2025

The Astrologer update continues with the Fate Astrologer talent! 

[hr][/hr]
Battle Astrologer
A new Battle Astrologer Talent and 12 new Battle Astrologer skills have been added.The Astrology tab has been added to the Skill information window.Battle Astrologer related items, titles and journal achievements have been introduced.New Grandmaster quests and Advancement Tests for Battle Astrology have been added.Additional details for Battle Astrologer can be viewed on the dedicated microsite.
Astrology Scenario Quests Part 1[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td]Those seeking to control the stars themselves can begin their journey by starting the quest [Astrologer] A Starlit Summons, which can be obtained via selecting the Battle Astrology Talent when rebirthing, or by selecting the quest from the Receivable Quest Board in any town.Note: You must have rebirthed at least once to receive quests from the Quest Board.[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1735/battle-astrologer-talent.png[/td][/tr][/table]New Milletians who choose Battle Astrology for their first talent after rebirthing will be granted ‘the Aspiring Guide of Starlight’ 1st title.Title Effects:Magic Attack +15MP +20HP +20The title is available to you until you reach Level 10,000.
After completing [Astrologer] A Starlit Summons, you will receive Neal’s Letter. Use his letter to receive the first quest of the scenario, [Astrologer] On the Pilgrim’s Path.
[Astrologer] On the Pilgrim’s PathComplete the quest to unlock the Nova Blast skill, 5,000 Gold, and 50,000 EXP.[Astrologer] The Hall Where Knowledge ShinesComplete the quest to unlock the Stellar Surge skill, 5,000 Gold, and 50,000 EXP.[Astrologer] An Astrological OrientationComplete the quest to unlock the Meridian Sweep skill, 5,000 Gold, and 50,000 EXP.[Astrologer] The Movement of Wind and StarsComplete the quest to unlock the Orbital Pulse skill, 5,000 Gold, and 50,000 EXP.[Astrologer] Faces of the MoonsComplete the quest to unlock the Starlight Veil and Gravity Well skills, 5,000 Gold, and 50,000 EXP.[Astrologer] A Story Writ in StarlightComplete the quest to unlock the Celestial Conjunction and Stellar Citadel skills, 5,000 Gold, and 50,000 EXP.[Astrologer] The Workings of the Stellar CitadelComplete the quest to unlock the Hand of Destiny and Fate Foretold skills, 5,000 Gold, and 50,000 EXP, and the Canopus Orb.
The Stellar Citadel
After completing the quest, [Astrologer] A Story Writ in Starlight, NPC Delaney will be located in the Stellar Citadel.The Dispositor Scythe and Canopus Orb is available in Delaney’s shop.Delaney will provide upgrades for Scythe items. You can receive the Astrologer Collection Book for the Mabinovel from Delaney.
Battle Astrologer Skills
General Battle Astrologer Skills
Skills can only be used while equipped with a Scythe.AP Training cannot be used for skills of this talent.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1724/battle-astrology-mastery.png Battle Astrology Mastery
A passive skill that increases your Astrologer skills through Magic Attack (+100 MA at Rank 1).
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1723/astral-reave.png Astral Reave
This is an active skill that attacks one enemy at a distance (within 10m at Dan 3).
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1730/nova-blast.png Nova Blast
This is an active skill that attacks enemies within a 6m radius at Dan 3.When the star arrives at the target location, it releases all of its energy in a single burst, scathing enemies in a wide radius.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1734/stellar-surge.png Stellar Surge
This is a charging active skill that attacks enemies within a rectangular area with a distance of 14m and a width of 4m at Dan 3.While charging, the area where you can deal 100% damage within the maximum distance increases, and beyond this area, the damage decreases with distance.This attack strikes all enemies in a straight line. The longer the skill's hotkey is held, the greater distance it can cover before its full damage begins to fall off. Enemies beyond that range will still be hit, though for reduced damage.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1729/meridian-sweep.png Meridian Sweep
This is an active skill that moves to a desired location within a 10.5m distance based on Dan 3 and attacks enemies up to 3 times.You can select a location while holding down the skill button, and when you release the skill button, the skill will be cast in the direction and location of the mouse cursor.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1731/orbital-pulse.png Orbital Pulse
An active area of effect skill that targets all foes surrounding you up to a 5.5m radius (based on Rank 1).Successful attacks will stun all enemies within range for up to 4 seconds (based on Rank 1).
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1733/starlight-veil.png Starlight Veil
A powerful area of effect skill that can be placed on the ground, healing your allies' HP by 500 (based on Rank 1) within 6m of the skill's focal point.This skill will also reduce the Min Damage, Max Damage, and Magic Attack of enemies by 8% with the debuff lasting 30 seconds (based on Rank 1).
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1727/gravity-well.png Gravity Well
This skill allows you to harness the power of gravity to quickly move to a new location.The longer you wait with the skill active, the longer you'll be able to leap, with a maximum movement range at 9.5m at 100% (based on Rank 1).Despite utilizing gravity to move, this skill does not damage foes.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1726/fate-foretold.png Fate Foretold
This skill can only be used after activating all the cards you've drawn from Hand of Destiny.Damage increases proportionally depending on the number of cards drawn.This skill will attack a single monster with damage that is equal to 2000% of your Magic Attack (based on Rank 1).The different cards chosen can alter the skill significantly ranging from:Offense: 5% Bonus Damage per cardSupport: Restore 150 HP per card to each party member.Control: Ignore 5 Magic Defense and 3 Magic Protection per card.Fortune: Critical Damage +2% per card.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1732/star-citadel.png Stellar Citadel
This skill allows you to move to the Stellar Citadel, where you can edit the skill effects of Celestial Conjunction and set the tarot cards of Fate Foretold.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1725/celestial-conjunction.png Celestial Conjunction
You can customize each Battle Astrology skill to your needs and apply additional skill effects, further adjusting the Astrology talent skills to your liking.The extra effects are based on the number of stars in each skill's constellation.Ex. Fate Foretold can grant 5 additional effects.A skill's aspect will change according to the type of effect predominantly slotted into the nodes of its constellation chart.
Offense, Support, Control, Fortune
The skills that can be edited are as follows, and the type and number of effects that can be edited is different for each skill. 
Astral Reave, Nova Blast, Stellar Surge, Meridian Sweep, Orbital Pulse, Starlight Veil, Gravity Well, Fate Foretold 
The total number and type of effects that can be applied vary depending on the skill rank, and no separate resources are consumed for applying effects. 
Effect editing is only possible within the Stellar Citadel.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1728/hand-of-destiny.png Hand of Destiny
Allows you to customize buffs and skills to maximize your divine fortune through the power of the tarot cards.You can customize your card hand to create synergy and more bonuses such as:Magic Attack IncreaseMovement Speed IncreaseControl Card Effect Duration IncreaseReduced Draw CountYou can choose up to 5 cards (at Rank 1) that will be utilized as you use other Astrologer Skills.After using a set number of Astrologer Skills (7 skills at Rank 1), you will draw a card, allowing for an additional effect depending on the card drawn. notes.notes:

[hr][/hr]
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, including our Glenn Bearna: Primeval Winter Update!
The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:Meowsterious Village Event: Thursday, November 7th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 5th, Before MaintenanceBerchel Prevail Box: Thursday, November 7th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 5th, Before MaintenanceWorldwide Wanderer Box: Thursday, October 24th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 21st, Before MaintenanceIrusan's Check-In Attendance - Season 6: Thursday, September 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 19th, Before MaintenanceErinn Adventure Pass - Season 1: Thursday, September 5th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 12th, Before MaintenanceGlenn Bearna Dungeon Support: Thursday, July 13th, 2023, After Maintenance - December 31st, 2024
Glenn Bearna: Primeval Winter:
The new hidden difficulty for Glenn Bearna is here! See the full post for more information.A difficulty challenge that is sure to freeze any and all Milletians who dare try.Possible new Enchants, Title, Halo Accessory, and more for those who overcome Winter.Ink up some magical changes with Glyphwriting!Improved Dye Mini-game!And more!
Additional following changes have been made to the game:The option to hide Accessory Visibility has been added to the Extra Equipment Slot menu, allowing the option to be maintained when swapping sets. It is now possible to apply Weapon Appearance Scrolls to the Control Bar of Blossoming Memories. Thanks, Blaanid!We had Nao update the Rebirth Information on your Character Information Window so you know how long (down to the minute!) before you're eligible for a new look and talent via a visit to the Soul Stream.The Weapon Upgrade "Knuckle Empowerment" has been renamed to "Mana Infusion". Merlin gave us a long lecture about this, but we'll spare you the diatribe. The following items have been renamed:Midnight Covenant Marionette Figure > Midnight Covenant MarionetteQueen's Disguise Control Bar Mask > Queen's Disguise Handled MasquePeacock's Visage Control Bar Masque > Peacock's Visage Handled MasqueLittle Ghost Whistle > Little Ghost Alfie WhistleZettai Ryouiki Folk Garb (F) > Classic Couple Short-Sleeved Suit (F)Fancy Folk Garb (M) > Classic Couple Short-Sleeved Suit (M)Folk Shoes > Classic Couple ShoesFolk Garb Box > Classic Couple BoxThe stars are beginning to align- the weapon type "Large Scythe" has been renamed to "Scythe". Fear not, they're still just as large!
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:The 3% cap increase for Enchant Burning was not correctly applied, and has been fixed. It is now possible to hit 91% success rate when using Special Firewood and the Royal Enchanter title. With Samhain over, the popular trend of Ghost Weddings seemed to have lost their popularity and the Wedding Staff and marriage couple-to-be will now be visible to all in attendance.The enchant requirement text for Last Breath and Illusion have been properly updated to indicate that they are Dan 3, not Rank 3. Guardian Soul Stones now protect you when a creature attempts to use Spin Dash (Frostwork Soul, Tathlum, etc.)Fixed an issue where players experienced abnormal movement after using Ignis Plume.We noticed that Cailleach had a way to prevent Bone Dragons and Mir Dragon summon effects from applying. We put a stop to that, so summon your dragons freely!
Bugs fixed during the October 17th maintenance:
Corrected a few miscellaneous typos.The reward text on the Storyline UI for G24 and G25 has been corrected to reflect the proper names.The following items have been renamed:Twilight Midnight Covenant Backpack --> Twilight Midnight Covenant CoffinReverie Midnight Covenant Backpack --> Reverie Midnight Covenant CoffinThe following title has been renamed:Master Storyline Binger --> the Master Storyline BingerMany off-hand Puppetry item names have been consolidated- we have chosen Marionette to better reflect this item type to avoid confusion.
The following Puppetry related items have been renamed and their descriptions updated to reflect it:Mini Dye Ampoule --> Marionette Dye AmpouleFallen Pierrot Figure --> Fallen Pierrot MarionetteMaster Pierrot Mini --> Master Pierrot MarionetteMaster Pierrot Mini Box --> Master Pierrot Marionette BoxAdvanced Pierrot Mini --> Advanced Pierrot MarionetteAdvanced Pierrot Mini Box --> Advanced Pierrot Marionette BoxIntermediate Pierrot Mini --> Intermediate Pierrot MarionetteIntermediate Pierrot Mini Box --> Intermediate Pierrot Marionette BoxBeginner Pierrot Mini --> Beginner Pierrot MarionetteBeginner Pierrot Mini Box --> Beginner Pierrot Marionette BoxStudent Pierrot Mini --> Student Pierrot MarionetteLady Pierrot Mini --> Lady Pierrot MarionetteOld Friend Mini --> Old Friend MarionetteMaster Colossus Mini --> Master Colossus MarionetteMaster Colossus Mini Box --> Master Colossus Marionette BoxAdvanced Colossus Mini --> Advanced Colossus MarionetteAdvanced Colossus Mini Box --> Advanced Colossus Marionette BoxIntermediate Colossus Mini > Intermediate Colossus MarionetteIntermediate Colossus Mini Box > Intermediate Colossus Marionette BoxBeginner Colossus Mini > Beginner Colossus MarionetteBeginner Colossus Mini Box > Beginner Colossus Marionette BoxPrototype Mini > Prototype MarionetteGentleman Colossus Mini > Gentleman Colossus MarionetteIron Man Colossus Mini > Iron Man Colossus MarionetteIn compliance with the Royal Association of Artisan's review policies, Nele and Stewart have improved the copy text on the repeatable Quest Scroll for Massive Elementals.We provide Mabinogi for many regions, and in presenting Mabinogi in a respectful fashion towards all- we have replaced all instances of "Spaz" with "Klutz".Sinead has received the updated numbers from the Royal Messenger and now mentions that there are 150 Royal Alchemists and 80 Royal Artisans.
The following are known bugs:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.pngIrusan's Check-In Attendance Event button seems to be hiding. Don't worry - you are still able to click on the phantom button spot under the "Event" Icon UI to claim your daily stamp!Royal Institution Representative Rankings are displaying incorrectly.There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be purchased on the Web Shop.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.

Glenn Bearna: Primeval WinterA new difficulty setting “Primeval Winter” has been added to Glenn Bearna.This difficulty modifier can be accessed during Glenn Bearna Hardmode.The party will need to burn all their collected Firewood and Embers when prompted to destroy the Barrier in the final phase before the boss.
Your party must have multiple Firewood and Embers for the option to be visible.New Rewards for Primeval Winter difficulty have been added.A new Glenn Bearna: Primeval Winter Journal Achievement has been added.If the party manages to complete the new mode without any member being incapacitated during the fight with The Winter Tyrant, they will be awarded with “the Uniter of Dawn and Dusk” title.

Commerce Baltane Season 2
The Seasonal Commerce reset point will be changed to 7:00 AM PT on the first Thursday of March, July, and November.Baltane Season 2 will run until 7:00 AM PST on Thursday, March 6, 2025.Baltane Season 3 will start after the maintenance on Thursday, March 6, 2025.Seasonal Commerce Baltane Season 2 will begin at 12:00 AM PDT on November 1st, 2024 and run until March 6th, 2025 7:00 AM PST.Baltane Season 1 will conclude on October 31st, 11:59 PM PDT.Viewing the season rankings and claiming previous season’s rewards will be disabled for 30 minutes after the season is changed to ensure that the ranking compilation can be completed before rankings and rewards are distributed.[Claim Previous Seasonal Ranking Rewards] and [View Previous Seasonal Ranking] buttons will be deactivated during the reset time, and re-activated when you open commerce UI after the previous season's ranking is compiled.Starting from Baltane Season 2, in order to claim the rewards from the previous season, you'll need to start the current Commerce season with the appropriate Commerce Goblin NPCs first.Purchase limits within Trade Merchant’s shops and Sayiv’s shop will be reset.The Baltane Season 2 Challenger Box will be available, containing the following items:*NEW* Baltane Season 2 Challenger 2nd Title: https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1087/baltane-s2-title.png
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1088/baltane-s2-title-effect.gif
Movement Speed +3%20x Precise Reforging ToolsThe Seasonal Commerce Guide will be updated with Baltane Season 2, and Baltane Season 1 information will be archived.The stock for Bartering and Merchant Group Commerce won't reset.Commerce that has been completed while the season is changing will be refunded, however, please note that the purchase count won't be restored.
Additional Fantasy Life Changes
The growth guide has been updated to include [Growth Guide] on the quest names for better clarification.Updated the rewards for one of the Growth Guide's Try Fishing and Cooking quests from a Fishing Training Potion to a Skill Training Seal (10)(Not Tradeable)Skill Training Seals will now display the Rank Limit that the seals can be used on through the Tooltip section of the item.When creating a pet obtained through the VIP Service, it will display "(VIP)" next to its name in the Pet/Partner Information window.We’ve moved the “Add/Delete Favorites” buttons to the bottom of the Synthesis UI to avoid accidental clicking when auto-registering items for the selected recipe!Struggling to lure monsters in Saga’s Episode 3 Mission, “Defeat the Guards”? We got ya covered - by adding in extra text to better understand how to proceed through the mission. You got this!Always got a squad member off doing their own thing away from the Emblem Entrance for your Girgashiy Raid? We’ll now give you a notice when a squad member is not near the emblem.Expired Pets can now be deleted through the Pet/Partner Information Menu.When clicking on the Market Board in towns, you will now have the option to choose between the Auction House and Marketplace/Kiosks.The following bug fixes have been made to the game:Need to touch grass? Us too. The grass in Tir Chonaill and the wheat in Dunbarton will now display once more. Ruairi's legacy of streaking may have influenced Islanders in a few Milletians Moonlight Islands these past few months, but no longer!A few older Patterns were incorrectly displaying as blank. They will appear correctly now. Improved the display of the Homestead Construction List. The following titles have been changed:Royal Alchemist --> the Royal AlchemistCharge Ahead --> will Charge AheadDeparting ships will now properly exit players from seated props (pianos, chairs, etc.).Fixed rare situations that would not allow players to be properly revived with Phoenix Feathers.Fireballs now properly display their Effect Change Card VFX when casting via Snap Casting.A few Fairy-type pets were refusing medical care. We've fluffed up the bandages so all pets will accept your First Aid when casting it upon them.Some of the bankers have been found lining their pockets by charging Milletians the maximum stack price when transferring items from Bank to Bank. The price for this will now scale with the amount of items in the stack.Certain Homestead Installations will no longer vibrate wildly when attempting to place them.Corrected the behavior when using Alt+Click when your inventory is full and removing items from your off-hand slot.We've tweaked the ballistae on Air Commerce Ships to better aim during Red Dragon encounters. Additionally, when an Airship fails to defeat a Red Dragon before the time runs out, the damage dealt to the Airship will now be reduced in proportion to the number of hits the Red Dragon has remaining.Added a few more details to a few song titles (Jukebox and MabiNovel). Do you have a favorite track?Fixed a rare issue when using Beauty Coupons that would cause it to fail due to not enough Pon. It will no longer check your Pon, as expected.Fixed an issue where the quest objective would fail to progress if the player's gold limit was exceeded when exchanging gold for the quest item. In rare instances, the Milletian's hair would incorrectly update as well when updating a Partner's hair. An issue causing the critical effects of Harbinger of Thunder and Holy Light Spirit Liqueurs has been fixed. The glow from Support Puppets indicating which orb is correct during dungeons will now consistently display. Shadow Binding will no longer bind the shadows of slain targets, instead properly disappearing once the effect is no longer in use.Fixed an issue that would cause improper item usage when cooking meals involving Dragon Flesh. Get your feast on!The flaming Sword of Elsinore has grown hotter to ensure that you cannot pick it up unless you are wearing Rosemary Gloves.Fixed an issue causing Production skills to fail when interacting with specific Homestead/Moonlight Island props. A message will no longer appear telling you that you are at the maximum level when obtaining Fynni Gems at Exploration level 50.The damage calculations for Meteor Strike and Assault Slash have been altered to correctly calculate Player Defense and Protection. You should expect to see higher damage from the change.Fixed an issue that would cause the client to rarely crash when talking to your Spirit Weapon.Fixed an issue that would cause the Huge Lucky gathering VFX to not display.Fixed a few issues where the client would crash when moving between regions or playing certain cutscenes.We stopped your Partner from taking over your cooking when you're trying to cook something using your own abilities.Improved the UI display when a Continuous Production is interrupted. The proper value will now display. The display of the Knockback Gauge has been corrected to better align between server and client.Fixed a rare issue that would cause Foxyquins to freeze during combat.The following are known bugs:https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.pngThere is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.

notes.title: Royal Association of Artisans Update
notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1046/241003-wgc-1443-oct-royalartisan-940x290.jpg[hr][/hr]
Royal Association of ArtisansThe Royal Association of Artisans has been added. https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1004/raa-symbol.pngSinead in the Tara Rath Royal Castle has been tasked with handling the selection and book-keeping of the Royal Institution including:Applying to the Royal InstitutionThe Selection CriteriaThe official list of Royal Alchemists and ArtisansViewing your Royal Points (when applying/selected)Providing Royal MissionsThe Royal Institution only selects the best Milletians for these positions and the availability of spots is highly limited. In addition to Royal Alchemists, 3 new positions have been added with the following requirements for application:Royal Blacksmith - Dan 3 BlacksmithingRoyal Tailor - Dan 3 TailoringRoyal Enchanter Rank 1 EnchantingEach type of Royal Artisan only allows for 80 spots with the Royal Alchemists having increased their selection pool to 150 across the server of Erinn.You can only hold one type of Royal Artisan or Royal Alchemist position.When applying for a different position in the Royal Institution, you must withdraw any active applications.The Royal Alchemist program has updated their application criteria to ensure the best Alchemists are picked with the following changes:All Alchemy-related Skills Rank 1 (or Dan 3 where applicable)Spirit Cylinder Awakening is excluded.Selection of all positions in the Royal Institution will be determined with Royal Points through the following criteria:Journal Score +  Activity PointsIn cases of a tie in the above criteria, a Milletian’s Cumulative Level will be taken into account, as well as when they applied for the position.Journal Entries have been updated to reflect the new selection process:The following Journal Achievements are not included:Guild War AchievementsTrue BrillianceA Good Day to DyeWho Could Ask FomorCenter of the MaelstromDown But Not OutBecoming a Guardian GuildBecoming a Guardian Guild: FinalsGuardians of Tir ChonaillGuardians of DunbartonTransformation AchievementsChampionInfra BlackLordSageThe Kingdom’s FinestThis Journal Achievement has been renamed from “Elite Alchemist”.Fashionable DivaWhen applying for a position with the Royal Institution, you’ll be provided with a Royal Notebook.The Royal Notebook will allow you to:View your current Royal Points for the application processSee who is currently a Royal Alchemist or ArtisanReceive Royal Missionshttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1002/raa-mission-scroll.pngThe Activity Point system has been revamped.The minimum 60 point threshold previously required for Royal Alchemists has been removed.Activity Points are now earned through Royal Missions via various difficulties: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced.After you’ve applied for a Royal Alchemist or Artisan, you can begin taking on Royal Missions to increase your Royal Point score.Acquiring Royal Missions (from Sinead or your Royal Notebook) will be logged in your quest log under the new “Royal Institution” tab.Over 65 Royal Missions were added that can be received.These quests can range from using a specified skill to delivering an item with a specific enchant depending on the difficulty of the mission.To ensure a candidate of the Royal Institution is well-rounded in their proficiency, point caps have been placed on all levels of missions. Any points earned above the cap are ignored.Beginner - maximum of 600 pointsIntermediate - maximum of 300 pointsAdvanced - maximum of 150 pointsWithdrawing your application from a Royal Institute position will forfeit any Activity Points you’ve acquired for the week so far.You will also be awarded Activity Points for being logged into Erinn.You will receive 2 points every 5 minutes you are online, for a daily total of 120 points.There is a weekly point cap of 450 points for being logged in.Additionally, those who partake in the Royal Banquet on Samhain will receive 5 points per minute during the banquet. You are still beholden to the daily cap.The selection of Royal Alchemists and Artisans are appointed every Lughnasadh (Thursday) at 7:00 AM Server Time.The application deadline ends 10 minutes prior.With the change of Royal Alchemists being moved from Samhain (Saturday) to Lughnasadh (Thursday), all Royal Alchemist applications from October 5th to before maintenance on October 10th will be nullified.An exclusive Stardust Form has been added for Royal Alchemists and Artisans.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1009/stardust.pngExclusive 1st Titles have been added for Royal Artisans:the Royal BlacksmithBlacksmithing Success Rate +3%Blacksmithing Quality +1the Royal TailorTailoring Success Rate +3%Tailoring Quality +1the Royal EnchanterEnchant Success Rate +10%Enchant Burn Success Rate +3%Maximum Success Rate Cap increased.Custom Idle Poses have been added for the Royal Artisans when holding certain items:Royal Blacksmith - Blacksmith HammerRoyal Tailor - Tailoring KitRoyal Enchanter - Magic PowderThe following bonuses are always applied to the Royal Artisans and Alchemists when using Production or Enchantment skills:Party Bonus (increase in Success Rate and Completion %)Royal BlacksmithRoyal TailorWeekday Bonuses (Alban Eiler, Lughnasadh, Samhain)Royal Alchemists Samhain - Synthesis and Fragmentation Success Rate IncreasedRoyal BlacksmithAlban Eiler - Blacksmith Success Rate and Quality IncreasedRoyal TailorAlban Eiler - Tailoring Success Rate and Quality IncreasedRoyal EnchanterLughnasadh - Enchant Success Rate IncreasedWeather Bonuses (Thunder and Lightning)Royal AlchemistSynthesis and Fragmentation Success Rate IncreasedRoyal BlacksmithIncrease in Success Rate, Completion %, and Quality.Royal TailorIncrease in Success Rate, Completion %, and QualityRoyal Alchemist and Artisans have unique speech bubble icons.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1007/royal-speech-bubble-party.pngParty Recruitment Signs by Royal Artisans have been updated and will display a special party recruitment window when recruitment is active.Signatures on Crafted Items by a Royal Blacksmith and Tailor have been updated.Items will be listed as “Royal Blacksmith [Name]’s work” or “Royal Tailor [Name]’s work”The Signature text color will be displayed in orange.
The Entrust System has been updated to include Blacksmithing and Tailoring for Royal Blacksmith and Tailors.Entrust requests can be made in parties where a Royal Blacksmith or Tailor is the party leader.Crafting Bonuses are based on the requested Royal Blacksmith or Tailor in the party.The Requester must provide the required materials and Blacksmith Manual / Sewing Pattern. The Crafter must provide their own crafting tool (Blacksmith Hammer / Tailoring Kit).Items refunded through the Grandmaster Tailoring’s Unique effect will be refunded to the requester.When requesting an entrust to an Enchanter, names of Royal Enchanters will be shown at the top of the list in blue.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1024/royal-artisans-2.png
[hr][/hr]
Fantasy Life Changes
Part-Time Jobs Success
The "Attempts" column has been removed from the Part-Time Job History of your Character Menu.Due to the removal of the Attempts column, the qualification requirements needed for a chance to receive the Master of Part-Time Jobs quest has been changed from 100 Successes to 200 Successes of the same Part-Time Job.
Pointing to the Inventory
A Search Bar has been added to the Point Inventory.When searching your inventory through the Magnifying Glass icon, searches will now include items located in your Point Inventory.
Seeing Stars in the Collection Journal
The Collection Journal will now display star ratings for all items in the Fishing, Cooking, and Taming Journals, even for entries you have yet to acquire.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1063/collection-update-fishing-before-after.png
VIP Forget-Me-Not
For those with VIP Service, the Log-Off Notice Window will now remind you if you have VIP Advanced Items to collect. You wouldn't want to let those Dungeon Passes to go to waste after all!
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1061/vip-reminder.png
Accessories Be Gone! (But still stay!)
Accessories can now be visibly turned on or off, allowing you to only see the Puppets, Balloons, and other delightful accessories you have equipped at your own leisure.Toggling the "Eye" icon on the Accessory Slot will activate or deactivate the accessory item from being visible.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1067/puppet-on.pnghttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1066/puppet-off.png

Curious to know what else was added or which bugs have been fixed?
Be sure to check out the full Patch Notes!

notes.title: September Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1698/240829-wgc-1400-mb-septemberupdate-940x290.png
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1580/ek-icon.png Elemental Knight Skill Changes https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1580/ek-icon.pngThe Link Bonus effect has been improved.At Link Level 10, you can now use all 3 Elemental Instillments simultaneously.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1584/instill-flame.pnghttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1585/instill-frost.pnghttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1586/instill-thunder.png All Instillments
Instillments will deactivate if either your Mana or Stamina are exhausted and will reactivate again when both are above 100.When multiple Elemental Instillments are activated, the consumption rate will increase based on how many Instillments are active.The Minimum and Maximum Damage effects now stack when multiple Elemental Instillments are activated.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1584/instill-flame.png Instill Flame 
The Minimum and Maximum Damage Increases have increased for most skill ranks.Example: Based on various ranks of the Skill:Rank F: +1.1% (0.5% → 1.6%)Rank 2: +0.4% (2.5% → 2.9%)Rank 1: No Change (3% → 3%)
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1585/instill-frost.png Instill Frost 
The Minimum and Maximum Damage Increases have decreased for each skill rank.Example: Based on various ranks of the Skill:Rank F: -0.4% (1.0% → 0.6%)Rank 1: -3.0% (5% → 2%)
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1586/instill-thunder.png Instill Thunder 
The Minimum and Maximum Damage Increases have changed for each skill rank.Example: Based on various ranks of the Skill:Rank F: +2.6% (1% → 3.6%)Rank 1: -1.0% (6% → 5%)
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1574/blazing-assault-slash.png Blazing Assault Slash 
Additional Effects have been added while using Instills.Example: Based on Rank 1:Instill Flame: 400% Additional DamageInstill Frost: Reduce’s target’s Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 20% for 5 seconds.Instill Thunder: Pulls all stricken enemies to the target’s location
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1590/shattering-windmill.png Shattering Windmill 
Damage Calculations have been changed.
Before: Windmill Rank Damage + Base Damage +  Additional Damage after Frozen Effect ends.Example: Based on Rank 1:Windmill Rank Damage + 300% of Base Damage + 1200% After Frozen DamageAfter: Windmill Rank Damage + Increased Base Damage.Example: Based on Rank 1:Windmill Rank Damage + 1500% of Base Damage.Additional Effects have been added while using Instills.Example: Based on Rank 1:Instill Flame: 450% Additional DamageInstill Frost: Attack Radius +2 metersInstill Thunder: 500% Damage to Enemies every 2 seconds for 5 seconds.Cooldown has been reduced from 12 seconds to 10 seconds.Increased the duration of frozen enemies at higher ranks.Example: Based on Rank 5 to 1:Ranks 5-2: 4 secondsRank 1: 5 secondsThe duration of the Frozen Status effect now resets when Shattering Windmill is used again while the target is still frozen.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1578/dynavolt-smash.png Dynavolt Smash 
Additional Effects have been added while using Instills.Example: Based on Rank 1:Instill Flame: 600% Additional DamageInstill Frost: 1200% Additional Damage to Enemies frozen by Shattering WindmillInstill Thunder: Attack Width +2 meters; Attack Length +5 meters【 Developer Comments 】

To create a better play pattern and play experience, the development team decided to allow simultaneous use of Instill Element, granting Elemental Knights the benefits of all three Instillments (Flame, Frost, Thunder) at once. Additionally, the additional effects that each Instillment grants to the primary skills (Blazing Assault Slash, Shattering Windmill, Dynavolt Smash) have been modified to increase the link between skills as well as to provide utility and benefits to individual skills, such as increased attack range and pulling enemies inward.

As we are increasing the power of Instill Element, the upkeep cost (Mana, Stamina) will increase when multiple Instillments are activated. Our intention is that players will consider their situation and increased upkeep cost, selecting which and how many Instillments to use accordingly, rather than having all three elements up at all times. Each additionally applied Instillment will grant further increased damage, so we have adjusted the damage increase granted by each element.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1582/hs-icon.png Harmonic Saint Skill Changes https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1582/hs-icon.pngThe Link Bonus effects have been improved at the following levels:Link Level 6Warmth of Life is now granted to the caster when allies are standing in Pulse of Purification’s area of effect.Link Level 8A new Veil of Life effect is applied when healing an ally or self with Hand of Restoration or Echoes of Salvation.Veil of Life converts healing into a shield at the default healing amount when a player is at full health with no wounds.The Veil of Life condition lasts for 60 seconds or when the shield has been exhausted, whichever comes first.The Veil of Life will reduce incoming damage by 50%.Those under the effect of Veil of Life will be immune to most knockback and stun.Link Level 9Pulse of Purification no longer recovers HP and Wounds for allies within range by 160 upon inflicting damage to enemies.Now grants Warmth of Life at Link Level 6.Grants Music Buff +3Pulse of Purification Radius +3 meters
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1579/echos-of-salvation.png Echoes of Salvation 
Now heals wounds for each skill rank:Example: Based on various ranks of the Skill:Rank F: +100 Wound RecoveryRank 1: +250 Wound RecoveryMP and Stamina recovery are now instantaneous rather than increased recovery speed.Additional MP and Stamina recovery based on the Rank of Enduring Melody’s recovery speed.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1591/voice-of-vitality.png Voice of Vitality 
Voice of Vitality’s Effect will now remain even when incapacitated.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1575/blessing-of-protection.png Blessing of Protection 
If the health of an ally or self is below 10% or in Deadly status, casting Blessing of Protection will now restore health up to 10%.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1589/pulse-of-purification.png Pulse of Purification 
The usage method for the skill has been changed so that you can click the area that you wish to cast the skill.Numerous changes have been made for each rank.Example: Based on Rank 1.Deals 3,000 Magic Damage/second to enemies within the skill’s radius.Restores 200 HP, MP, and Stamina per second.Grants Stun and Knockdown Immunity to allies within the skill’s radius.Deals an additional 10,800 Magic Damage after the skill ends to any enemies remaining in the skill’s radius.Casting Time has been reduced from 2 seconds to 1 second.Cooldown has been drastically reduced from 360 seconds to 60 seconds.Now only consumes Mana upon use.The skill can now be canceled by using the skill again while activated.The skill’s Piercing Effect has been removed.Visibility of the Skill’s Effect has been enhanced.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1588/polyphonic-melody.png Polyphonic Melody 
A new skill acquired upon reaching Level 3 of Harmonic Saint.Provides a chance for the next use of Enduring Melody, March Song, or Harvest Song to stack with other Musical Buffs.Example: Based on various ranks of the Skill:Rank F: 30% Strength of BuffRank 9: 60% Strength of BuffRank 5: 80% Strength of BuffRank 1: 100% Strength of BuffOnly 2 Musical Buffs can be active at the same time.You are unable to stack the same Musical Buff.【 Developer Comments 】

Harmonic Saint has been modified to maintain its role as party support. Some of the less meaningful Arcana Link effects have been adjusted, and a brand new effect Veil of Life has been added into Link Level 8. Hand of Restoration and Echoes of Salvation are powerful heals, but are limited to only healing missing health, so it can be difficult to respond immediately to every situation. With Link Level 8, Veil of Life will activate when healing those with full health, and provide an additional shield proportional to the strength of the heal cast. This effect will allow Harmonic Saints to apply preemptive support.

When considering that higher difficulty dungeons require more active play, the development team decided to allow continuous party support even while using Pulse of Purification. We felt this would allow for a more positive and synergistic experience. Additionally, by reducing the immediate damage output of the skill and supplementing it with a highly reduced cooldown and a party member support effect, Harmonic Saints will be able to leverage Pulse of Purification more often in combat. We hope you enjoy it!

Lastly, a new skill, Polyphonic Melody, has been added to increase the Harmonic Saint's contribution to the party. However, we have found that with Share Music Buffs settings, the best possible buff combination would be different for various talents, and some talents may not be able to fully benefit from such situations or require different combinations from others, causing those talents to be less favored in parties. Thus, we decided to limit the songs that can be activated with the Polyphonic Melody to Enduring Melody, March Song, and Harvest Song to allow each member of the party to benefit from the buff effects while keeping the Harmonic Saint's party contribution ability intact.
Non-Arcana Skill Changes
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1595/smash.png Normal Attack/Smash
Enemies who have Counterattack loaded and are not the intended target will not trigger its use nor be affected by the attack splash.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1593/bash.png Bash
Stacks now decrease by 1 instead of all stacks when the retention timer ends.Fixed an issue where the skill could not be used on enemies in Finish State.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1594/rage-impact.png Rage Impact
Now accounts for sizes of enemies when measuring distance.Enemies hit by Rage Impact now have the debuff applied to them for the entire duration.Debuff duration decreased from 10 seconds to 7 seconds.Melee Attack Bonus Damage has been decreased at all ranks.Example: Based on Rank 1:Reduced from 50% to 15%.Glyphs with the Rage Impact Skill augment have had the Melee Attack Bonus Damage reduced from 1% to 0.3% per level.Imperial Knight Gloves have【 Developer Comments 】

Rage Impact previously would increase the strength of the next melee attack’s damage after it was applied onto a target. However, when factoring in party play, it was very likely that this effect would be consumed unintentionally, making it difficult to fully utilize this damage increase. 

To resolve this, we modified the effect from the skill. Targets affected by Rage Impact will now take increased damage from all melee attacks during its duration. In order to keep this balanced, we have adjusted the duration and damage increase. 

We have also adjusted the Rage Impact enhancement effects to match this change. Like Rage Impact, the damage multiplier for the enhancements have decreased, but will now apply for all melee damage applied during the duration. We expect this to increase synergistic use in combat.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1592/musical-knowledge.png Musical Knowledge
The chances of performing Excellent and Inspiring Performances have been increased at higher ranks.
Fahmes Ruin
After 4 months of renovation, Fahmes Ruin Dungeon is open to Milletians once more!
Fahmes Ruin Dungeon has been added to the Dungeon Guide.New UI has been added to allow you to teleport directly to the Dungeon Entrance.Clicking the Ruin Stone will open Fahmes page in the Dungeon Guide UI.The dungeon is restricted to Milletians level 5,000 or higher.The dungeon consists of 6 Stages with 5 Floors each for a total of 30 Floors.Each floor consists of 3 waves of mobs that can be triggered at any time.You will be given the choice of one “Stage Buff” upon entering the stage.Bonus Damage +15%Movement Speed +30% & Protection/Magic Protection +100%Auto-Revival x3Bachram Speed +500%The ranking system has been reworked for bragging rights only.Monthly Rewards have been updated.The monthly rewards will be reset with the 1st Thursday of each month at 7:00 AM (Server Time).A star reward system has been implemented.You can earn up to 3 stars per floor through the following conditions:Complete the Floor.Complete the Floor in under 3 minutes.Complete the Floor in under 1 minute.You can earn new Journal Achievements and one-time rewards.The Journal Achievements will be awarded to all characters on your account.The star rewards are once per account.**NEW** Rewards include:https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1752/fahmes-ruins-1.pngHomestead Stamina Fahmes Ruin Figure+100 StaminaHomestead MP Fahmes Ruin Figure+100 MPHomestead HP Fahmes Ruin Figure+100 HPHomestead Patience Fahmes Ruin Figure+1 Defense+1 Protection+1 Magic Defense+1 Magic ProtectionHomestead Courage Fahmes Ruin Figurehttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1754/fahmes-ruins-2-v2.png+2 Defense+2 Protection+2 Magic Defense+2 Magic ProtectionHomestead Rage Fahmes Ruin Figure+3 Defense+3 Protection+3 Magic Defense+3 Magic ProtectionFahmes Ruin Copper/Silver/Gold CoinRest Skill Animation Card
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1736/mewlynne-rest.gifChampion of Fahmes Ruin 2nd Title Coupon https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1737/fahmes-champion-2nd-title.png+12 Defense+11 Protection+14 Magic Defense+8 Magic Protection+3% Movement Speedhttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1741/fahmes-champion-title-effect.gif
Fantasy Life Changes
Blacklisting
The Blacklist system has been updated.
The Blacklist system is now separate from the friend list and has been moved to the Options.Settings → Game → Chat → Blacklist SettingBlacklisted players in your Friends list will be moved to the Blacklist Settings list.The Blacklist capacity has been increased from 60 to 300.When a player has been Blacklisted:Their character model will not be visible on screen.Direct Messages and Notes will not be received.Sound Effects are not heard.Their Demigod Form will not be visible.Props and Chairs set up will not be visible on screen.Their PvP requests will be automatically rejected/ignored.It is still possible to be hit by a Blacklisted player in EvG/PvDK however.Their conversation and speech bubbles will not be visible.Marriage Proposals are automatically ignored.Couple Link Effects will not be visible. (i.e. Rose Couples Bracelet)The option to request becoming the player’s Soulmate will not be available (during Doki Doki Event).
 Other Changes
The reward selection panel has been updated.You can now select the quantity.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1744/qol-change-1.png

notes.notes:

[hr][/hr]Winds of Fate
Search for traces of Delga and the Divine Beasts on the continent of Iria. To plot your course, Aine and her companions turn to old, faded writings they've collected to guide them!
Generation 26 - Winds of Fate - Part 2 has been added.Players who have completed Generation 26 Part 1 will automatically receive the quest The Open Door.After completing Generation 26, you can talk to the Researcher next to the Poulnabrone in Dunbarton to receive a copy of the Winds of Fate Collection Book for your Mabinovel.Completing Generation 26 will award the player with one of the following titles based on their choices during the story:who Seeks to Bring Orderwho Strives for a Better Lifewho Dreams of a New WorldThe G26 Winds of Fate Clear Reward Box has been added and is awarded after completion of Generation 26 - Part 2.
Use the item to receive an invitation for Roisin to appear in your Moonlight Island.


https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1266/240802-wgc-1291-mb-moonlight-island-guide-940x290-v2.png
[hr][/hr]Moonlight Island
Moonlight Island has been added.Players who have a Homestead created will receive the quest [Guide] Moonlighting in Island Development upon log-in.The existing Homestead Hotkey (Default: “U”) has been updated to a new menu/UI.Information and Activity regarding both the Milletian’s Moonlight Island and Homestead will be visible through the new menu.Players will be able to enter both their Homestead and Moonlight Island through the new menu.The Weekly Island Spotlight will feature a highly active Milletian’s Moonlight Island and display it for the week.Today’s Islander will randomly select a resident of a random Milletian’s Moonlight Island and display it for the day.Islanders will visit your Moonlight Island!Each day, a new Visitor will visit your island.Islanders can be invited to stay on your island through the use of a Resident Invitation, obtained after completing a Visitor's quest and tasks.Islanders can produce unique materials through various activities and facilities through Moonlight Island.Doing such activities will spend a Islander’s endurance.An Islander’s endurance can be restored by gifting food, certain items, leveling up your Island, or naturally over time.Milletians can help their Residents grow by ranking their skills and abilities.Certain abilities require Resident Journals, which can be obtained from spare Resident Invitations you acquire.Residents can also be removed from the island.Any time, effort, and journals used to rank the resident’s abilities will not be refunded.Milletians may dress their Residents with outfits and weapons.Effects from certain outfits will not trigger (e.g. Patron Wear).Certain Tuatha de Dannan will also visit your Moonlight Island.These noticeable characters will assist you with your Island when visiting through special shops, gifts, or buffs.You will need to complete Generation 26 - Part 2 in order to have them visit.The ability to alter the landscape on Moonlight Island with Terrain Change Mode has been added.A new "Moonlight Island" Tab in Quests (Default: "Q") has been dedicated to all Moonlight Island quests.Read more about Moonlight Island in the dedicated Moonlight Island Guide!

notes.title: Renovation Season 5: Close Combat and Lance Changes
notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1994/renos5-news-940x290.jpg
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1967/grandmaster_close_combat_icon.png Close Combat
Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1968/smash.png Smash
The damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.Example: Based on Rank Dan 3 of the skill:Before: Humans and Elves: 620%, Giants: 720%After: Humans and Elves: 800%, Giants: 900%The cooldown of Smash is reduced at higher ranks.Before:3 seconds at all ranks.After:Rank F ~ Rank A: No ChangeRank 9 ~ Rank 1: 2.5 secondsRank Dan 1: 2.4 secondsRank Dan 2: 2.2 secondsRank Dan 3: 2 seconds
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1966/bash.png Bash
The damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 380% / 400% / 420% / 440% / 460%After: 520% / 540% / 560% / 580% / 600% The cooldown of Bash has been increased to 2 seconds.Bash's attack priority has been adjusted to be higher than normal attacks.When using Bash while dual-wielding, Bash stacks are gained twice as fast. Close Combat Talent Damage increases based on the number of Bash stacks.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill: 2% / 4% / 6% / 8% / 10%Close Combat Talent Damage increase is only applied while wielding a Close Combat Talent weapon.When Bash is at 5 stacks, Close Combat Talent and Elemental Knight Skills will ignore Auto-defense of Heavy Standers below a certain rank.The Bash stack retention time has been reduced to 20 seconds for all ranks.The Bash stacks will remain even when changing weapons.Bash will now automatically strike the enemy from a distance, depending on how close the character is to the enemy.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill: Distance up to 7m This function does not occur if the skill is used by a monster.The issue of intermittent normal attacks when using Bash continuously has been fixed.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2005/counterattack.pngCounterattack
Counterattack has been improved so that the character can move more quickly after a successful counterattack at higher ranks.Before:3 seconds at all ranks.After:Rank F ~ Rank D: No ChangeRank C ~ Rank A: 2.5 secondsRank 9 ~ Rank 6: 2 secondsRank 5 ~ Rank 1: 1.5 secondsRank Dan 1: 1.4 secondsRank Dan 2: 1.2 secondsRank Dan 3: 1 second
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2006/assault_slash.pngAssault Slash
The damage multiplier for all skill ranks have been increased.Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill: Before: 260%After: 350%Assault Slash has been improved so that the character can move more quickly after a successful counterattack.Example:  Based on Rank Dan 3 of the skill:Before: 1.5 secondsAfter:  0.3 secondsThe cooldown of Assault Slash has been reduced.Before: 7 secondsAfter:  5.5 secondsAn issue where the skill could not be used in certain situations on enemies who have been knocked down has been fixed.[table][tr][td]【 Developer Comments 】In order to reduce the inconvenience of Automatic Defense and ensure that Close Combat talent skills can be used meaningfully in battle, we have updated the above skills and adjusted their values. Due to how Close Combat skills work there are often situations where you need to approach your target. Our expectation is that you’ll be able to zip around more in-battle with Bash’s new gap closer and Smash's lower cooldown. As Smash contains higher potential risk, the damage values have been increased so that the skill has a higher payoff when successful.[/td][/tr][/table]
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2012/grandmaster_lance_combat_icon.png Lance Combat
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1993/lance-impact.png NEW! Lance Impact
New Lance-only skill!Knock your target back with a heavy blow, and grants an effect that gives your next Lance Charge increased damage when unmounted!Knocks your opponent back in a straight line, up to 5m. If your opponent cannot be knocked back, you will leap back 5m instead. Grants Lance Charge Mount Bonus (On Foot) upon use, empowering your next Lance Charge. Your next Lance Charge will deal mounted Lance Charge damage.The effect disappears upon use of Lance Charge or after a short duration.  
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2037/lance-impact-eng.gif

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1991/lance-leap.png NEW! Lance Leap
New Lance-only skill!Reposition backwards with deft grace, and empower your next Lance Charge’s unmounted movement speed!Leaps backwards upon use, distance increases with rank, up to 6m at Rank 1. Grants Lance Charge Speed Boost (On Foot) upon use, enhancing your next unmounted Lance Charge. Your next Lance Charge will have increased movement speed while unmounted.The effect disappears upon use of Lance Charge or after a short duration.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2038/lance-leap-eng.gif

Other Lance Weapon Changes
Basic Attacks and Smash can now be used from a closer range. The damage dealt will depend on the distance between you and the target, with the damage being reduced if targets are too close. If the Spirit enhancement skill Ultimate Lance is present, this damage reduction does not apply. The Defense skill can now be used when equipped with a Lance.Lance Counter can now be canceled out of and ignores stun.Corrected the behavior of Lance Charge that was causing it to occasionally fail when used at minimum range.When undertaking the Lance Charge Advancement Test, you can now use Lance Impact and Lance Leap.[table][tr][td]【 Developer Comments 】As is, the Lance talent can be used most optimally when riding a pet, but as a talent it can be difficult when in positions where you cannot use a pet. When entering progressively higher leveled dungeons, it becomes more difficult to make use of your pet. To this we decided that a new skill would be needed to allow for greater use of the Lance Combat talent even in harder content. The development team wanted to add more fun to the player input of the talent while reducing the dependency that the talent has on pets- Lance Impact and Lance Leap were designed with this in mind.[/td][/tr][/table]
Additional Changes
Human Movement Speed
Human movement speed has been increased, and is now equal to Giants.The movement speed bonus gained from Breath of Ladeca has been reduced due to this change. 
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2007/breath_of_ladeca.png Breath of Ladeca
The amount of movement speed granted in the description is now a percentage, rather than a flat value. Altered from ~13% down to its new value of 10%. Removed the 10% bonus damage to Close Combat talent skills when Dual-Wielding.Now adds 5% bonus damage to normal talent skills.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2011/spirit_of_order.png https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2010/soul_of_chaos.pngTransformation Skill https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2009/fury_of_connous.png https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2008/daemon_of_physis.png
Your 1st and 2nd Titles are now maintained when using Paladin, Dark Knight, Beast, and Falcon transformations.Transformation-specific Titles can still be used when transformed.Passive Defense Skills for the transformations, such as Paladin Heavy Stander, will now always be active. 
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2013/shield_mastery.png Shields
The Shield Mastery skill had had the following changes made:The damage reduction rates depending on the size of your shield have been changed.The damage reduction when using Defense increases depending on the size of your shield.The Elemental Knight skill Dauntless Defense accounts for the size of your shield as well as the new “Damage Reduction Rate” effect.The following Shields have had a new “Damage Reduction Rate” effect added:  Frosted Borealis Shield: 14% Divine Shield: 15% Massive Despair Shield: 18% Perseus Vigilant Shield: 20% Nightbringer Vanguard: 30%Using the Defense skill will no longer reduce damage against a skill that cannot be blocked, and your skill will be canceled instead. [table][tr][td]【 Developer Comments 】Previously when wearing a small, medium, or large shield, the damage reduction of the Defense skill could be applied regardless of if the attack was successfully blocked or not, allowing players to maintain the damage reduction at all times. The development team decided to adjust this behavior in order to create more interesting combat scenarios in future content where Defense must be used to block some skills, while other attacks must be avoided entirely as they cannot be blocked. Instead of having an effect based solely on the size of the shield itself, we’ve strengthened the options and tweaked the damage formula so that higher-tiered shields are stronger in the long run.[/td][/tr][/table]
Fantasy Life Changes
Ducat Exchange Daily Limit
Seasonal Ducat exchange for Ducat currency will no longer have a daily limit.Commerce merchant NPC dialogues have been updated to reflect this change.
EXP-Granting Items
Gaining experience by percentage is changed from current level to absolute level for the following values:Item use (eg. Golden Fruit, Magical Piece (Grade n), Pet Golden Experience Fruit, etc.)Shop Sales Bonus (Equipment that has Shop Sales Bonus attribute which you then sell it)Fountain of Blessing in Uladh DungeonsThe experience formula values for the following are subject to change:Battle experience (including pets)Exploration experience (eg. Special Artifact)Spirit experience (eg. Mysterious Spirit Stone)

Be sure to check out the full patch notes!
