Instructions for some missions have been improved to provide clear indicators such as monster deaths (Example: Golems in Awakened Abyssal Lord) or item use requirements (Example: Lava Lump in Seven Nightmares).The Lava Decal spawned when defeating enemies in the Salamander family will now have a casting indicator to warn of the incoming danger. Fixed an issue causing Lava Decals (such as those from Salamanders) to stun Milletians through Iron Will.A timer gauge has been added to show the time remaining until Salamanders "self-destruct" after a certain period of time.Removed the following skills from most non-Boss enemies: Heavy StanderNatural ShieldMana DeflectorBosses will no longer resist the following skills: Final HitMagnum ShotFireboltChain ImpaleThe following enemies will have a cooldown added to their Ice Spear spell: CethlennTathlum Red Lizard WitchBlack Moon FollowerThe following rewards will now have a longer despawn timer when on the floor:Evil Eye SealstoneFunction Geata FragmentRemnants of Illusion
Revived Illusion Changes
A timer to show when the next Salamander will be summoned has been added as a visual gauge above the Red Lizard Witch enemy.The gimmick of Red Lizard Witch reflecting damage from being hit has been removed.

Feth Fiada Changes
The draw distance for Feth Fiada has been slightly increased. The frequency of how often the following enemies teleport in combat has been reduced: Fire SlimeIce SlimeLightning SlimeLightning Slimes and Black Moon Followers will no longer become temporarily immune to all damage upon knockdown, and will instead gain a temporary boost to their Protection and Magic Protection.This change also applies to all Lightning Slimes outside of Feth Fiada.Previously Illusion Zombies and Black Moon Followers would ignore damage below a certain threshold. This has been removed, and their HP values have been increased to compensate.During the Hallway Puzzle, Illusion Zombies will now spawn in the same fixed locations on both Easy and Hard modes.Tathlum's "Spin Dash" skill, which attacks while rolling, has been changed:Cast time of the skill before rolling has been increased.An attack range indicator is displayed during the casting time.The monster can be damaged while using the skill.The attack range has been reduced to a narrower range.The attack duration, which was slightly different between difficulties, has been adjusted to be the same in all difficulties.These changes also apply to the Frostwork Soul monsters in Glenn Bearna.A timer gauge has been added to show the remaining time towards when Black Moon Followers will disappear.When the first Tech Duinn Geata is defeated, the particle indicator will be shown to point towards the location of the next orb.Tech Duinn Geatas will now always spawn in a fixed location on both Easy and Hard modes. The following attacks from Tech Duinn Geata will now display cast indicators, and have had their casting time increased to allow better reaction: Light of AnnihilationLight of DestructionWindmill
Seven Nightmare Changes
During the Salamander puzzle,The "Black Explosion" caused by the Evil Eye Monolith has been removed.Lava Lumps held inside the inventory will now automatically be used against the Evil Eye Monolith every 5 seconds. The Lava Lump can still be manually activated.During the Black Moon Follower Battle puzzle,The radius of the Lava Decals has been decreased, and the amount that appears has been increased.A preview casting indicator has been added for decals that are about to appear. During Cethlenn’s boss fight,Cethlenn's "Summon Reaper" skill indicator now has a higher resolution.The skill indicator has also been changed to better match its range.Cethlenn’s Staff enemies have had the following changes made:Staves will pass through targets, applying a bleed effect on hit.  Their attack speed has been increased.They will no longer cause knockback on hit.The enemy name and health bars will be hidden to reduce noise. 
Awakened Abyssal Lord Changes
During the Golem Puzzle, the moving sacrifice circle has been removed and replaced with a large stationary one in the center.During the Barrier/Bastion Puzzle,A timer to show when the next Barrier Spirits will be summoned has been added as a visual gauge above the Bastion enemy.The maximum number of summoned Barrier Spirits has been changed so that it does not exceed a certain number of summoned monsters.During the Boss fight, the location of the name and health bars of the Soaring Leg enemy have been improved to be visible from the floor

Crom Bás Changes
Defense and Protection of regular Crom Bás monsters has been reduced.When Dark Erg levels are between 71~100, the Protection of regular monsters has been reduced, but their HP has been increased. Removed the following skills from most non-Boss enemies: Heavy StanderNatural ShieldMana DeflectorThe defense-increasing Divine Blessing effect from Frozen Cari and Dark Cari will no longer apply to Frozen Cari and Dark Cari. Stun Immunity has been removed from the following monsters:Dark RonaunDark CariDark LlygadogDark GwallgofDark WynebDark DiscipleThe following monsters have cooldowns added to the listed skills, causing them to be used less:Disciple and Dark Disciple: Shooting RushSlime Wyneb and Dark Wyneb: Ice Spear and ThunderUn Llygadog and Dark Llygadog: Icebolt and ThunderRonaun and Dark Ronaun: Puppet's SnareFrozen Cari and Dark Cari: Icebolt, Ice Spear, and ThunderIrusan: Ice Spear and ThunderExcluding specific phase mechanics, the damage caps for Irusan, Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann have been removed. The additional damage taken by Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann when dazed has been reduced from 230% to 200%.Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's "Erg Black Hole" will now be visible when the ‘Minimize VFX’ option is enabled. The Disciples that spawn during Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's gimmicks had their passive defenses removed, except for when they resist that damage type.The following changes have been made to the fight with Irusan:The summoning rules for regular monsters have been changed, and new gimmicks have been added.Irusan now has an increased delay after using Sharpened Claw.The progression rules for Irusan's Sweet Tea Time (where the cauldron is activated) have been changed.Irusan's Deathly Brand has been changed so that it can be canceled using Hand of Restoration.This status effect icon is also now visible to all party members.Some dialogue about this effect provided by Brielle has been changed.The interval of Dark Lure (Red exploding circles) has been changed:
Dark Erg 0-30: 6~10 secondsDark Erg 31~70: 5~8 secondsDark Erg 71~100: 4~6 secondsThe visibility of Warp Circles in Crom Bas has been improved.[table][tr][td]Green Magic Circle has not been changed.[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1563/green-crom-bas-circle.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Yellow Magic Circle now has an outline without a shade added.[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1591/yellow-crom-bas-circle.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Red Magic Circle now has an outline with a shade added.[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1564/red-crom-bas-circle.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Glenn Bearna Changes
Removed the following skills from most non-Boss enemies: Heavy StanderNatural ShieldMana DeflectorDamage caps have been removed except for certain sections during boss fights.An issue where some monsters behave abnormally when hit by the Flame Burst skill has been fixed.
Miscellaneous Dungeon Changes
G1 Fiodh - Lowered the HP value of the following creatures:Small GolemFlying SwordAdditional Fantasy Life Changes
General
Spring is in the air and there are flowers to be picked! To help with that, we’ve added 2 new items: https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1589/empty-flower-baskets.pngFlower BasketThis item can hold up to 200 Bundles of Flowers.Can be purchased from Del for 350,000 gold.Sturdy Flower Basket*slaps top of basket* This bad boy can fit even more Bundles of Flowers - up to 500!Can be purchased from any Commerce Trading Merchant Imp for 500,000 Ducats.We know that carrying several of the same item can be cumbersome, so we’ve now made the following items stackable and/or had their stack limits increased to 20, including:Bunches of FlowersDye AmpoulesMetal Dye AmpoulesAll Baltane Mission Elite PassesAll Shadow Mission Elite PassesTo better assist our merchants, the Auction House functionality has been enhanced.The UI will no longer close after registering an item for sale.Erinn will now inform you that the item has been successfully listed in the chat log.Items that can be sold on the Auction House will now be highlighted in your inventory and gear slots.The “Claim Rewards” button in the Growth Guide has been renamed to “Completion Rewards” for better clarity.An outline will be added to the VFX which indicates the impact range of Moon Stones in the G24 [Fallen from the Sky] mission.
Quest Polishing
Blaanid is now more concise with her dialogue when helping new Milletians on their path of learning about the world of Erinn. In the Pet Training Skill quest [A Blossoming Embrace], the number of required Bear Fynni Gems has been reduced.Additional text has been added to the Quest Scroll to clarify how to speak to Fynni Fynn.You can no longer remove the Dark Knight Armor in your inventory prior to completing [Eliminating the Dark Knight Armor] Quest.In the G1 Mission [Paradise], you can now talk to Tarlach to receive another Brown Fomor Pass if you happen to lose it.In the final G1 Missions [Tir Na Nog], [Find the Black Orb], and [Final Dance], additional text has been included into the Quest Scroll on how to return to Tir Na Nog.

notes.title: Mini-games + Quality of Life Update - Patch Notes - April 11th
notes.notes:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring April's Mini-game + Quality of Life Update!
The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:Mini-games + Quality of Life Update: Thursday, April 11th, 2024, After Maintenance - PermanentMilletian Got Game Event: Thursday, April 11th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 25th, 2024, Before MaintenanceMilletian Events: Service Error Compensation: Thursday, April 11th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 25th, 2024, Before MaintenanceGalaxy-Brained Study Buddy Event: Thursday, April 11th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 9th, 2024, Before MaintenanceIrusan's Check-in Event Attendance Season 5: Thursday, April 11th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 18th, 2024, Before MaintenanceDigital Destiny Box: Thursday, April 11th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 9th, 2024, Before MaintenanceFlorist Box: Thursday, March 28th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 25th, 2024, Before MaintenanceGlenn Bearna Dungeon Support: Thursday, July 13th, 2023, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeMini-games + Quality of Life update:It's time to relax with some mini-games! Check out all the newest mini-games added to the game as well as some text and title quality of life changes to help improve your fantasy life!Seven new mini-games added to the game to be played anytime, anywhere*You can now choose the text size of Speech Bubbles and Chat Logs.Extra Equipment Slots now allow you to register titles.Vanity Titles have arrived - show off your favorite title in style while still holding the stats of another.The following changes have been made to the game:Monster names of the following families have been made consistent:SahaginBlack Moon FollowerBone Lancer IllusionHeavily Armored Skeleton OgreBone ArcherHellhoundRenamed the following items:Stationary Table > Stationery TableFairytale Gardener's Straw Hat > Fairytale Gardener's Felt BeretThe Stage of Trials Manager has informed us that Milletians will no longer be permitted to use the VIP Remote Shop / Repair / Bank services during the trial.The harps in Musical Math Dungeon are now more sonorous.Added the channel and time to the Fashion Contest Finals Entrance Pass. Come strut your stuff and showcase your favorite styles!The cursor will now be visible after using Chain Sweep and Bachram Explosion.The following bug fixes have been made to the game:Fixed an issue causing Extra Equipment Slots and Jukeboxes to expire even when VIP Services are present. Many typo fixes this update- G13/G14/G24/G25, Glenn Bearna, Tech Duinn, Farming, and Fashion Contest were the major areas covered!The Fashion Contest registration UI has been resized to fit the text.Fixed issues causing Pet Notes to display incorrectly and occasionally disappear.It is no longer possible to request to fly with a character using Soar.Under certain conditions the Shop Repurchase menu would not properly display all the re-purchasable items.Slightly alleviated the game slowdown when a lot of bags are open.When using music buff skills through higher ranks of Song, the durability and proficiency of the equipment in your right hand will no longer be affected unless the equipment is an instrument. Very small Milletians with very large hair/wigs were found to be possessed by a ghost, causing them to float above the ground. With Corentin's help we have banished the spectre. An issue where some outfit meshes may appear broken when changing equipment to the same outfit has been fixed.Both cymbals are now properly sized on Giants when equipped with cymbals and sheet music.The 'Complete Mission' and the 'Close' buttons no longer overlap when opening a G19~G25 Quest window.Fixed an issue where Giants would occasionally fail to hit dungeon marbles after drinking a mini potion. Mini Giants can go back to their regularly scheduled oxymoron.Pets will no longer relentlessly chase after opponents following a PVP match like a cat chasing after catnip.The Pet House UI would occasionally close itself, but this has been fixed.Shrimp Taming Bait and Taillteann Carp Bait will now stack properly.Elemental Removers dropped from monsters and purchased from NPCs will now stack properly.Fixed an issue where Auto Weapon Slot Conversion would not swap to proper equipment when using Party Healing.Gathering Clams in Scuabtuinne was not properly counting towards Hoeing training.Moving a bow to the bank via alt-click will now properly unequip the equipped arrow.Warping via the Moongate / Mana Tunnel will no longer cause outfit motion props to disappear.When equipped with a Control Bar with increased Control Marionette Range, an issue has been fixed where Act 1: Inciting Incident would occasionally fail to work.Fixed an issue where Cello-playing Milletians would fail to properly leave the homestead.A few Talent skills were able to be incorrectly used while riding a pet. This has been corrected.Fixed an issue with the portrait on the Printed Casual Wear displaying incorrectly.Marionettes will be able to move sooner if the target dies during the middle of Act 2: Threshold Cutter.The Preview option in the Dressing Room was not properly displaying when a collaboration appearance was selected.Fixed an issue where Milletians were unable to move upon using Divine Blast or Nova Obliteration.In rare circumstances the client would close upon changing channels. This has been fixed.Silk-Weaving Gloves were incorrectly granting their bonus while at 0 durability. They will now give no bonus in this state.Dorcha Snatch was training improperly when used when Hot-Air Ballooning. Little known fact, Sluagh loves floating through the sky.The Falias Artifact Restoration window will now display above your inventory.Fixed an issue where monster AI would not properly cancel an unused Life Drain.An issue where a previewed appearance in the dressing room was not updating under certain circumstances has been fixed.Specifically timed gestures/blinks/etc will no longer cause Eye VFX to stop displaying.Novice cards were not properly issued to new accounts with a hero card or elite hero card. This has been fixed.Fixed an issue causing remaining duration messages to display incorrectly when changing channels. An issue where the Spread Wings and Crisis Escape skills cannot be used after using a Moongate or Mana Tunnel while riding a pet after using Spread Wings has been fixed.A bug where pet skills are not used when summoning a Kart Rider pet has been fixed.The issue where pets could be summoned in Festia's Clobbermeister mini-game has been fixed.Fixed an issue where Act 1: Inciting Incident would improperly move when cast on a monster outside its range.The cat from the Academy School Uniform's outfit motion would cause characters to move awkwardly when running. This has been fixed.An issue where the body shape is not applied during motion when wearing the Eluned Cherry Blossom Dress (M) as a Giant character has been fixed.Corrected display issues with the following equipment:Blue Dragon's Chosen RobesCircus Performer's OutfitsFestial Jumpsuit (M)Birman Marching Boots on GiantsGuardian BootsBugs fixed during the March 28th Maintenance: Corrected a floor exploit in Fahmes Ruins.Fixed an issue where the Extra Equipment Slot duration was not reflected properly for some characters.Fixed a few Festival of Stars event related typos, and improved the dialogue of a certain raccoon.As grandiose as COMBAT VIP MEMBERSHIP BATTLER'S BOON / LIFE VIP MEMBERSHIP BOUNTIFUL boon are, the full names probably don't need to show on the status effect text. These have been trimmed to VIP Battler's Boon / VIP Bountiful Boon.Made minor adjustments to the Flight Action names to make them consistent.Improved the text on several Cooking Quest scrolls and objectives.Despite it not being visible in-game anymore, we've fixed a decade-old EU Mabinogi typo. Finally the Brioncac has been defeated!Found a few more strings referring to "Premium Service" and replaced them with the proper name.Found a few Homestead items missing the "Homestead" designation on their item names.Homestead Tropical Party PineappleHomestead Tropical Friends PineappleHomestead Christmas WreathHomestead Christmas TreeHomestead RudolphHomestead Old JunkHomestead Giant Stone StatueHomestead Haunted HouseHomestead Red Rose Patch (Full)Homestead Red Rose Patch (Partial)Homestead Pink Rose Patch (Full)Homestead Pink Rose Patch (Partial)Homestead Rose Vine Arch (Urban)Homestead Rose Vine Arch (Rustic)Homestead Hanging Rose ValanceHomestead Hanging Rose BlossomsHomestead Hanging Rose VineHomestead Vine Rose FenceHomestead Wild Rose BushBugs fixed during the March 21st Maintenance: Giants equipped with the new Two-handed Sword Motion Card (Type 2) and Shields were behaving strangely. The sheer magnitude of their power will no longer cause them to sink into the floor.The 16th Anniversary Drawstring Pouch (Doll Bags) was incorrectly targeting Birman Bags. This has been corrected so that the Doll Bag Drawstring Pouch can now be used on Doll Bags, as expected.The following are known bugs:https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1150/bug_catching.pngIn rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.

notes.title: Producer’s Letter: Discussing the January 2024 Update
notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png

Hi Milletians,

With our January 18th update, we have released changes to Mabinogi that we recognize many Milletians have strong feelings about. In particular, we would like to address the changes to Tech Duinn missions and the weekly clear reward limits that have been integrated into these missions. As with Crom Bás or Glenn Bearna dungeons which had weekly clears from the start, Tech Duinn has now been updated to introduce similar weekly clear limits. Along with this change, the mission format has been reorganized, consolidating difficulty levels from four to two (Normal/Hard), improving the ease and intuitiveness of mission puzzles, adjusting dungeon rewards, and improving dungeon drop rates.

Many of these changes represent improvements on the existing system, but the community has expressed considerable uncertainty regarding the weekly clear limits. The team has been reading and digesting the many thoughts and feedback you have. While adding a limit to content that was previously unlimited understandably may not sit well initially, the reasons behind the change have been reviewed and considered deeply by the development team, whose thoughts we will share with you below.

As Mabinogi’s publisher, we will review and scrutinize the many facets of the game’s content, while also placing our trust in the best intentions of our developers. Our goal as a connected team aligns in our desire to do what is best not only for the longevity of the game, but for the enjoyment of our community.

From myself, and on behalf of my team at Nexon America and Nexon Korea, we will continue to put our whole hearts into Mabinogi to provide a service that we can all enjoy.

Sincerely,
GM Mewlynne
Mabinogi Producer
Developer’s Comments: Behind the Change 
The core purpose of dungeon-related updates is to increase the value of dungeons and rewards. Most dungeons in Mabinogi have a lower chance of rewarding the most desirable items. This is by design, to encourage repeated playthroughs. The items given as dungeon rewards are typically also tradable, so the reward probability has to be determined by taking into account repeated play. Our development team believed that this was causing repeated negative experiences in dungeons.

After reviewing the data and play patterns of our Milletians, we decided that it was necessary to make improvements so that you could grow and acquire equipment. However, there were concerns that simply increasing the probability of receiving rewards would increase the supply of materials excessively, decreasing the value of items and ultimately leading to a loss of motivation to play dungeons at all. This is also the reason why the average number of runs required to obtain a desired reward set in general Mabinogi dungeons was not able to be adjusted immediately, even though it might have felt somewhat difficult for Milletians trying their hardest to grow. Our development team has thought deeply about the best choice we could make for Mabinogi’s future, and has significantly increased the probability of rewards while limiting the number of clears so that Milletians, in their quest to grow ever stronger, can enjoy a meaningful challenge in the dungeons they are focusing on.

In preparing for this update, we considered the appropriate direction based on these contents as basic premises. 
[olist] Tech Duinn weekly clear limits 
Tech Duinn is a dungeon with the most direct rewards that Milletians can achieve as intermediate goals in their growth process. If you look at the status of Milletians playing Tech Duinn missions, they are generally receiving “Elite” passes on Feth Fiada Hard difficulty. In the case of Crom Bás, it is possible to enter without obtaining an entry pass to farm the Nightbringer weapon set, so the fact that you needed to separately obtain an Elite pass to acquire the materials for the Perseus weapon set felt like an unnatural part of the growth process. We eventually determined that to be one of the hassles, and thought of the way where you could play them without acquiring passes.

However, as acquiring passes is no longer required and the drop rates for the rewards have been increased, we have concluded that the amount of acquired items could increase too excessively, without the limitation to the entry. As maintaining items’ value is also an important part of the game, we concluded that the entry limit is necessary.

When looking at the play patterns of North American Milletians playing Tech Duinn missions, the dev team found that most Milletians who were playing the Elite missions were clearing them fewer than 10 times per week, and around 80% of Milletians were clearing them fewer than 5 times a week. When considering the now-increased probabilities of receiving many of the rewards, we felt that clearing the mission about 15 times was a reasonable level, providing a better experience in clearing without significantly affecting the value of the rewards obtained.

We have also prepared the methods for Milletians who want to clear missions more by making it possible to clear more than 15 times a week (25 times or more in total) using additional entry passes received through events and Adventurer’s Seal Shop. We are also open to the possibility of gradually easing restrictions when the demand/supply of rewards has stabilized in the future.

We are also listening carefully to your concerns about situations that impede free play. We will continue to think about which values ​​are most important from a long-term perspective and find solutions that offer enjoyable experiences. 

Intention of introducing the Dungeon Re:fine system 

A lot of Milletians have been asking about the details of the Re:fine System and the intention behind it.

Re:fine system is the system where the probability of a certain reward’s appearance remains the same regardless of the party member’s number. In practice, it works as below.

For certain items, the number and the probability of these items appearing in one dungeon run will remain the same regardless of whether it was cleared by one person or multiple people. Once the item’s appearance is decided, who will get the item among the party will be decided by an even probability.

In other words, if the probability of an item is 1%, and an individual clears the dungeon, the item will appear by 1% for them. If the dungeon is cleared by a party of 4, whether the item will appear or not will be decided by 1%, and the item will be given to the 1 of the 4 members by even probability.

The initial purpose of the Re:fine system was to bridge the compensation gap, accounting for multi-client usage. Although this will now be addressed to some extent by blocking the use of multiple clients, we still have to take into account abnormal styles of play. In particular, the higher the expected reward of a dungeon, the more advantageous it is to clear it using multiple computers. We intended to prevent this type of play pattern from being encouraged. With the update, we applied the Re:fine system to certain dungeons while increasing the drop rates of major rewards, to prevent the situation of using multiple clients or computers being advantageous while increasing the level of rewards for playing dungeons.
[/olist]
The purpose of the development explained above is focused on changes for the long-term growth of Mabinogi. However, we believe that the freedom and variety of play styles that can be experienced in Mabinogi are also important values. We will strive to develop Mabinogi through a process of gathering opinions while doing our best to provide a sufficient explanation of our intentions to all Milletians.

Thank you,
Mabinogi Development Team

notes.title: Upcoming Changes: Blocking Multi-Client and Improved Dungeon Drop Rates
notes.notes:
Hi Milletians,

We are announcing in advance that the security for Mabinogi will soon be improved to strengthen the detection and prevention of third-party programs and multi-client use. We recognize there may be some beneficial aspects that client modifications can offer to improve a player’s game experience, although most functionalities are against the intentions of the game and impose unfair capabilities and barriers to players who don’t modify their files. There are also risks that come with modifying the game client and data for the player and the game.

Mabinogi has been steadily improving the playability of the game, adding commonly requested features that were previously mod-only, as well as other features that have improved the stability and performance of the game. While it is important for us to continue to improve the in-game experience, we believe that at this present juncture, we need to further improve the security measures within the game to prevent security vulnerabilities and create a safer Mabinogi.

Blocking Multi-Client and Third-Party Programs
Multi-client use has not been allowed in Mabinogi and it is not possible to run multiple clients through normal means. However, there are many players who have been logging in on multiple clients through unauthorized methods, bypassing the game system to play on multiple accounts at one time. In order to provide a better game experience, we are enhancing the game’s security so that it is no longer possible to bypass the restriction. In the future, if you run two or more game clients on the same device, any instances of the client beyond the first will be automatically shut down. 

Other security improvements made to the game client and account system will terminate the use of third-party programs and launchers along with it. This notice is being posted early so that you can take care to play on a clean game client before the blocking measures begin to take effect. While special mods and third-party launchers may offer small gameplay tweaks or improve the game’s performance for some, there are more risky parts of client modifications that aren’t good for the game’s overall security. This must be addressed to prevent forms of illicit or fraudulent activity, egregious activities, game exploits, hacking, and other types of abuse. There are also cases in which third-party programs can alter the game’s intention too greatly in ways that are considered exploitative and unfair, such as changes to skill cooldowns, skill usage ranges, or skill uptime. Players found abusing the game while using these types of game modifications will be subject to sanctions. 

Further information about which actions are considered violations is outlined in the Terms of Service agreement that has been agreed to when creating a Nexon account.

Addressing the Caravan Joe Problem
Multi-client use is impacting many aspects of the game. In particular, it creates an environment that feels like a gatekeeper to many players of all types. It is not a fair experience to those wanting to play and grow their character when there is such an imbalance between players who are playing multiple accounts and those who are not. The area that has experienced the most significant impact of multi-client use is the supply of gold and rewards. If we take a look at the current dungeon play experience, for example, we have individuals that play and receive one reward chest, while those using multiple clients will receive the reward chest from each of the controlled characters. Milletians who focus on playing with one client are bound to feel like they are at a disadvantage, which we are deeply sorry for.

[table][tr][td]"The Many Cousins of Caravan Joe"

Let's take a look at two different players, Cowenna and Caravan Joe. Both players are looking to receive a Broken Magic Essence (BME) from the Alby Advanced Hard Mode (AAHM) dungeon, and have been farming a while in hopes of getting it.

Each time Cowenna plays, she does a few runs through AAHM. Sometimes by herself, sometimes she invites her friends- Rowan, Eochaid, and Loiscneach. For a successful clear she opens a single chest and takes the loot, as do her friends. One player gets one key to open one chest, or four players get four keys to open four chests.

Each time Caravan Joe plays, he does a few runs as well. He also plays by himself, but with a twist - he invites his cousins, all three of them also named Caravan Joe. For a successful clear each Joe opens a single chest and takes the loot, but after this, each Joe then trades their drops to a single Joe. One player gets four keys to open four chests.

In this scenario, Caravan Joe is four times more likely than Cowenna to receive a Broken Magic Essence. Due to this imbalance, it has been difficult to move forward with Drop Rate increases without accounting for how Caravan Joe and his cousins, aka multi-clienting, would create further imbalances. Cowenna is still doing her AAHM runs hoping to get her BME, but feels that it's unfair that Caravan Joe is getting more drops per run. [/td][/tr][/table]
In other words, this imbalance is not a sustainable way for players to gain resources and this must be addressed to ensure that reward opportunities are available to all players in the game.

Increasing Dungeon Drop Rates and Improving the Reward Experience
A significant change that will be made to Mabinogi will be the addition of improved drop rates to dungeons and missions. This will allow players to play dungeons with more opportunities towards their reward goals. A major impact of this change will be the leveling-out of imbalances that inevitably became the norm due to multi-client use, and the creation of a better experience for those hoping to receive materials and other rewards from their dungeon runs. The drop rates of rewards from major dungeons and missions will be increased significantly to the same level that Mabinogi Korea has right now. We will increase the drop rates of many rewards, with our primary focus being–but not limited to–core high-level rewards such as crafting materials and Enchant Scrolls. For some dungeons, the Dungeon Re:Fine system will be applied with the increase of drop rates. 

We will share a detailed list of the dungeons and rewards affected by this change in a later announcement. Please look forward to the improved dungeon drop rates coming soon, with detailed information regarding the changes provided in the patch notes as usual! 

Another part of the game affected by multi-client use is the in-game events. Several players have been participating in events using multiple clients to get multiple rewards. Therefore, the reality of multi-client use was factored in when the Development team determined the coin shop prices for items in event shops. Oftentimes, there is also the need to pick and choose which rewards to spend coins on versus obtaining all rewards from the shop. This aspect is where players would feel that playing on an alternate account was required in order to earn the rewards, which we want to improve. There are certain events that allow all rewards to be obtained, and the aspect of choice is an integral element of game freedom, so this will still be a factor seen in events. However, to improve the experience after the multi-client block, we will adjust the event shop’s reward prices so that you can get enough rewards by solo playing, without using multi-clients.

Further Improving your Fantasy Life
Even with the many improvements that have been made to Mabinogi in recent years, we recognize that there are still options that many players have requested that may be missing from the game. In addition to these changes mentioned above, we will continue to actively improve the elements that burdened the experience and made multi-client use feel like a significant improvement to the game experience.
We sincerely apologize for allowing the multi-client behavior to impact the game as much as it has and hope these changes will begin to change the experience for the better. We appreciate your understanding as we enter this next chapter of Mabinogi. As this is a very important step for the future, we will do our best to ensure the long-term growth and stable service of the game, rather than focusing on the short-term visible result, such as the number of concurrent players in the game.
Thank you for your continued support, and please look forward to more details about upcoming updates to the game. We will continue to work hard so that Mabinogi can continue to grow steadily for a long time.

Milletians, we also recommend following the tips below to ensure that you are playing on a clean client:
Please ensure that you are launching Mabinogi through the Nexon Launcher or Steam Launcher.Please delete any unofficial files that may be saved in the game installation folder.After removing any precarious files, perform a Repair Installation if using the Nexon Launcher, or Verify the Integrity of the Game Files if using the Steam Launcher. Alternatively, we recommend deleting the entire game installation folder and preparing a full reinstallation of the game to ensure that all files have been directly downloaded from the Nexon Launcher or Steam Launcher.As the Nexon Game Security client will be improved and updated, ensure that your antivirus or firewall trusts and allows the Mabinogi client and related files to run. If you encounter any issues, please contact Player Support.
Thank you, 

- The Mabinogi Team

Arcana Dark Arts Update:
Several quality of life changes have been added to help with your fantasy life! See the full post for more information: Arcana: Dark Arts Update and check out the dedicated microsite!Two new Arcanas have been added - Alchemic Sharpshooter and Dark Diviner. Visit the Arcana Talent Association in Tara Rath Castle to learn more!Special Upgrades have been improved to make your upgrades feel more special!Enchantment has been given a remake! Timers on Enchant Scrolls are now a thing of the past!And more!
The following changes have been made to the game:
Within the Point Inventory (the shopping cart icon), we have renamed "Rearrange" to "Claim". This button has always claimed all of the selected items, which is technically a form of rearranging, but we felt it could be a lot more clear.Renamed "Mana Tunnel in Filia" to "Filia Mana Tunnel" to be consistent with other Mana Tunnels and Moon Gates.Small text improvements have been applied to Jousting and the Tara Banquet.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Due to equal parts of your helpful reports and our love for polishing, we continued to improve the text in November's Beyond content. This took several forms- Mainstory text, Spirit text, Stardust quest information, and several PTJs (especially those involving the Dunbarton Library).(Also, we convinced Stewart to rename the Magazine section to Periodicals.)Corrected the text for the materials needed in the Norman Warrior Armor. Previously this indicated that you needed Common Leather Straps, when the materials used were actually Common Leather.Endelyon will no longer ask you to "일반 아르바이트 완전 수행 성공" for your daily Renown. Hopefully "Earn full credit for the perfect completion of any Part-Time Job" is a little more understandable!The Growth Guide now recognizes your hard work and will award you your Growth Guide Point when you complete "Work a Part-Time Job".The Upgrade Stone Selection Box from the Growth Guide no longer has a unfortunate adjective suggesting that this should be a Protective Stone. The intended rewards are and always have been Red Upgrade Stone (Event) x1 or Blue Upgrade Stone (Event) x1.The Inquisitive Black Friday Package previously stated that it granted only one Golden Experience Fruit (1000%) and 10x Forgetful Potions. This has been corrected to the proper values: Golden Experience Fruit (1000%) x5 and 10x Special Forgetful Potions. This is only an issue with the box text, the items within have always been correct. Although the sale has ended, we feel that it was best to right this in-game as well.The Skill Learn method for Metal Conversion has been referencing older requirements. This has been updated to reflect the actual requirements!If you're still unable to learn the skill through the above methods, we heard nearby rumors that talking to Pierrick might help...
The following bugs were fixed during the course of November:
Corrected an issue causing the Commerce Rankings to not update.Fixed issues with a few Part Time Jobs:Glenis was ignoring Nerys' ring.Fraser was not giving out selected rewards for his PTJs.Effie and Nicca's PTJs were not showing on the Rano PTJ board.Surging Hope Gems can once again be used as expected.The default Dollbag collection categories for Shyllien Ecology and Rare Mineralogy were not collecting all the same materials as the add-on collection categories. Both lists are now the same.The Premium Collection Category Add-on Slot was not properly working for the following Dollbags:Cethlenn and Vayne Compact Doll BagCommerce Companions Compact Doll BagCrom Bas Brielle and Gillach Compact Doll BagCrom Bas Cast Compact Doll BagDeirbhile and Piran Compact BagEnya and Etain Compact Doll BagEnya, Merlin, and Altam Compact Doll BagExpeditionary Force Compact Doll BagFolamh and Irusan Compact Doll BagG22 Compact Doll BagIgerna and Caoimhin Compact Doll BagLinden and Sayiv Compact Doll BagMarleid and Piran Compact Doll BagMelwyn and Llywelyn Compact Doll BagOrder of the Black Moon Compact Doll BagPinkie and Katell Compact Doll BagSplish-Splash Cat and Bug Catcher Pup Compact Doll BagThe Spirit Weapon Additional Contract Coupon now correctly states that it can be used three times, up to a maximum of six.
The following are known bugs:
Sometimes one of the baby reindeer gets a little too excited for Part-Time Jobs and will collide with the Part-Time Job bulletin board in Dunbarton. Don't worry, he's fine and will make a full recovery (after the holidays)!A few bags are have incorrect sizes listed in their box description. This is only a text error and does not affect the actual bag.Bhatair Doll Bag Box - states 8x8, actual 7x10Morfydrianas Doll Bag Box - states 8x8, actual 7x10Tani Doll Bag Box - states 7x7, actual 7x10🐛In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.

Cloaker: Peaca Intermediate DungeonGrumbill: Shadow Mission ‘Defeat Fomor Commander II’Wight: Peaca Basic DungeonKobold: Math Advanced DungeonGhoul: Peaca Normal DungeonTo address feedback that the dungeon vouchers were out of order on the Currency menu, we have renamed them from First/Second/Third/Fourth Vouchers to 1st/2nd/3rd/4th Vouchers. Two not-quite-as-famous deities of Erinn, Paea and Kheridwen, have been retranslated as "Phaea" and "Ceridwen".No longer shall two quests ask you to Defeat 10 Black Forest Mushroom Spiders, as one has been correctly renamed to Defeat 10 Blue Forest Mushroom Spiders.We accidentally'd a word on the Ace Hero Ampoule Sets. Treasure Hunter is complaining, but Starlet will calm him down.Minor text polish on the Generations, while we were in there for Beyond.Removed a few more references to Inventory Plus Kit from certain Bag Coupons.Players reported a handful of items where the (M) and (F) descriptions were swapped. Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update:
A new dungeon, Glenn Bearna, and a new area, Sliab Mis, have been added. You can reach the area through Sidhe Sneachta.Scenario quests related to the new areas will be added.You can meet the new NPC Loiscneach, the mountainkeeper, during the Glenn Bearna scenario quest.Several enhancement changes have been introduced for Erg, Echostones, Arcana, and more.See the full post for more information: Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update. Additional details for Glenn Bearna can also be viewed on the dedicated microsite.
Update Regarding Recent Lag

We have been working hard to fix the various lag issues that have been occurring of late. Though we reduced the heaviness of the lag a few weeks back, we wanted to improve things further. There are still a few reports we've seen that we will continue to look into, but we feel that the game is in a much better state than when this all began. 

In the future we will need to further update the affected areas which could cause some return of the lag. We will communicate this with you when the time comes, and do our best to avoid and mitigate any issues. 

We apologize for the impacted gameplay, and thank you for your patience as we determined the root causes.

- The Mabinogi Team

The following changes have been made to the game:
Upgrade Reversion Kit can now be crafted using the Handicraft skill or purchased from the Item Shop.Print Casual Wear can no longer be upgraded.
The upgrade options of already upgraded items will be kept but cannot be further upgraded.
Color has been added to the sword appearance in the animation of the Special Imperial Knight Uniform.
As a material item with the name "Shining Crystal Shard" already exists, the "Shining Crystal Shard" that can be obtained from Glenn Bearna will be renamed to "Frostwork Crystal Shard" in a future patch.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed a rare issue that loading the skill UI could cause a client crash.Fixed an issue where the charge count appeared abnormally when parallel-casting Elemental Knight skills.Fixed an issue where the remaining time for Final Strike appeared abnormally when parallel-casting while using Final Strike. Fixed a rare issue where you could not finish casting Meteor Strike when you are attacked while parallel-casting. Fixed the issue where you could defend the skills which should not be defendable by Dauntless Defense. Combo: PummelAct 6: CrisisSuccubus Queen's Butterfly KissMerrow’s WaterspoutRoaring skills of dragons and NeidFixed the issue where Elemental Attunement was applied when using Thunder skill.Fixed missing plus marks on the announcement text when summoning (or unsummoning) a doll bag.Removed an incorrect mention of Royal Complete Skill EXP Potion (1 Day) being listed as part of the Snowy Scout's Warm Up Gold Shop.Fixed an issue causing the Fantastic Chorus Enhancement effect to not further boost the reduction to enemy stats. All other portions of the effect are working as intended.An issue where the Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger box and title were granted when retrieving the previous season's rewards has been identified. Characters who obtained the Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger box and title have had these items replaced with the correct Imbolic Season 2 Challenger Box and Imbolic Season Challenger title automatically during the July 13th maintenance.Found and fixed many typos through the game, this time mostly around G22, G23, Techniques/Briogh, and Arcana quests. Thank you players for continuing to report these!
The following are known bugs:
Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web shop.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.
In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.
The Journal images for Glenn Bearna display the dungeon name as "Glenn Berna".

notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1148/230627_julyupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png
Update DetailsA new dungeon, Glenn Bearna, and a new area, Sliab Mis, have been added. You can reach the area through Sidhe Sneachta.Sidhe Sneachta’s terrain has been partially changed.Scenario quests related to the new areas will be added.You can meet the new NPC Loiscneach, the mountainkeeper, during the Glenn Bearna scenario quest.Several enhancement changes have been introduced for Erg, Echostones, Arcana, and more.Additional details for Glenn Bearna can also be viewed on the dedicated microsite.
Scenario QuestsCold winds from the northern lands have blown into Tir Chonaill. The Glenn Bearna prologue story will be available. During The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event, the quest [Content] Dark Dreams of a Winter Wind is automatically given to characters who have met one of the following condition: Completed Memory Book Volume 3, Completed Generation 1's "Advent of the Goddess", Completed Arcana Guide Quest "Lighting the Arcana's Flame"During The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event, the difficulty of battles during quests will be lowered. After The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event ends, the quest [Content] Dark Dreams of a Winter Wind will be automatically given to characters who have at least one Arcana Talent that has at least 1 Link unlocked.   The Glenn Bearna scenario quest line begins with the guide quest, [Content] A Flame of Burning Cold.This quest is given when the cumulative level is 20,000 or higher, an Arcana Link is unlocked at level 1 or higher, and the prologue story quest, [Content] A God of the Northern Winds is completed.You may have to change channels to receive the quest after completing the prologue story.You can proceed with the quest by talking to NPC Laoire in the Arcana Association Room in Tara Rath Royal Castle.Progress through the story to discover the reason behind the abnormal weather.During the quest, [Content] A Tranquil Mirror of Dawn and Dusk, you will discover Sliab Mis and be able to enter Glenn Bearna.After completing the last quest of the scenario, you will be able to enter Sliab Mis and Glenn Bearna without quest limitations.
Glenn Bearna Dungeon
Entry Details
Enter Glenn Bearna through the barrier in Sliab Mis, north of Sidhe Sneachta.Dungeon Entry Conditions:Cumulative level 20,000 or higher Arcana total level 50 or higherCompleting the final Glenn Bearna scenario quest: [Content] A Fantasia of Endless WinterA minimum of 2 to a maximum of 8 party members can enter the dungeonNote: If you enter with an odd number, party members without pairs can have difficulty with some dungeon objectives.Glenn Bearna has two dungeon difficulty levels: Normal and Hard. There is no entry limit, but clear rewards can be obtained up to 3 times a week per character.
Entry Details
In order to clear the dungeon, you must overcome the frost’s grasp within Glenn Bearna.Solve the paradox between the Day and Night timelines of Glenn Bearna. The dungeon is played in pairs with the Lifeline system.The party will be split up into Day and Night groups, and you will be paired with someone from the other side.You can select which side to join and the pair will be randomly determined.You share Lifeline Health with your Lifeline Partner.Lifeline Health gauges the shared health bar of the two paired party members depending on the dungeon difficulty.Lifeline Health can be reduced or restored by certain monsters or scenarios within the dungeon.When one gets knocked unconscious while paired in a Lifeline, the Lifeline Health will be reduced by the HP of the unconscious character. Resurrection is possible unless the Lifeline Health reaches 0, and the character who got knocked unconscious and used up the Lifeline Health cannot be revived.When Lifeline Health is reduced to 0, characters with remaining health can still play. If all of the party members' Lifeline Health decreases or there are no pairs left on either side, the dungeon will fail and you will not be able to proceed further.There is a 30-second cooldown when using potions in the dungeon.You can re-enter the Glenn Bearna Dungeon up to 3 times if disconnection occurs.You will move through the dungeon to clear the areas of enemies, and gather the necessary materials to survive the cold.Party members in the Daytime are tasked with acquiring Firewood, while those in Nighttime are tasked with acquiring Ember. These are accumulated as points and can be gathered by defeating certain enemies. Which party members have accumulated the Firewood and Ember is shown in the party details on the left of the screen.The party must work together to stop the enemies and correct the paradox affecting the areas of Glenn Bearna.Strategically use the braziers, lit brightly by the gathered Firewood and Embers, to collect the souls of enemies and unleash them upon your foes.What else may you encounter in the chill of the winter?You will encounter the following enemies and Boss monsters in Glenn Bearna:Fianna GeimhridhSnuggly SneachtaGwyllionCarnivorous SnowtrapMan-Eating SnowtrapEnkindled WraithEmber SpriteIcicle SpriteAbominable RabbitAbominable Rabbit of EquilibriumFrostwork SoulFolach CattGwyllgiIce GolemPallid SoulUnfinished ReverieCnoc OighirCailleach
Dungeon Rewards
Rewards can be obtained when clearing the boss of Glenn Bearna. EXP and guaranteed rewards will be dropped from the Dungeon End Chest.Additional rewards such as gems, crafting materials and manuals, enchant scrolls, and set effect enhancement scrolls are also possible to obtain from the Dungeon End Chest. Clear rewards can be obtained up to 3 times a week per character.Normal and Hard difficulty levels share the number of rewards obtained. Introduction of Erg GradeThe Erg Grade system has been implemented into the Erg System. B-Grade and A-Grade Erg Enhancement methods have been added. Existing Erg enhancements are categorized as S-Grade Erg, being the highest grade.Note: Existing Erg enhanced weapons will become S-Grade Erg enhanced weapons.Advancement Catalyst B and Advancement Catalyst A items have been added.These Catalyst items can be crafted using the Magic Craft skill with at least Rank 9 Magic Craft.Advancement Catalyst B:Shyllien Crystal x2Fine Firewood x20Hay Bale x5Holy Water of Lymilark x20Advancement Catalyst A:Shyllien Crystal x5Divine Mineral Fragment x5Desecrated Charm Chunk x2Thorny Blue Shackle x2Massive Turtle Shell Chip x2When attempting to apply Erg to your weapon, you can select one of the three grades which are B, A, and S to start grade enhancement.Weapons with a lower Erg grade will have a lesser Erg effect compared to a higher grade, however the effect is easier to achieve.The basic effect of B-grade Erg starts from level 11.A-grade Ergs show the basic effect from level 16 and the bonus effect from level 26.After leveling up a B Grade Erg to level 50, you can talk to Kaelic with an Advancement Catalyst B to upgrade it to A Grade. After increasing the grade, the Erg level will start again at level 30.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1134/erg-advancement.png
A-grade and B-grade Erg weapons can also be transferred using the Transference Catalyst, but cannot be transferred if the transfer target has a different Erg level.Erg Grade is added to the Auction House as a detailed search option.Additional Weapon Erg Effects have been added for the following weapon types:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1207/erg-weapon-types.png
*Note: Erg effects for each level based on S grade.
Erg Enhancement has been improved to add an increased chance of success after a failure when attempting to level break. When attempting to level up Erg, the success rate now increases as the number of consecutive failures increases.Example: Success Rate: 0.70% → Failed Upgrade → Success rate: 0.71 (0.70+0.01)%Erg can now be removed from a weapon by talking to Kaelic and selecting the Remove Erg option.Caution: If an Erg is removed from a weapon, the Erg cannot be recovered. Erg cannot be removed from weapons that are sealed with a Seal Scroll.
Additional Enhancement ChangesThe readability of the equipment upgrade menu has been improved.Upgrades made to items can now be reverted using the Upgrade Reversion Kit.Normal Upgrades, Artisan Upgrades, and Gem Upgrades can be removed to return to the previous upgrade. (Special upgrades cannot be removed.)When reverting an upgrade, the proficiency used for the upgrade is restored up to 100.This item can be used on equipment that has been specially upgraded, and does not affect the special upgrade status.This item cannot be used on equipment that has been upgraded or in the process of being upgraded before the addition of the Upgrade Reversion Kit (before maintenance on July 13, 2023).Upgrade Reversion Kit can be crafted using the Handicraft skill or purchased from the Item Shop.Items that have been upgraded will now show the list of current upgrades applied in the item tooltip.You cannot check the list of upgrades for equipment that has been upgraded or in the process of being upgraded before the addition of the Upgrade Reversion Kit (before maintenance on July 13, 2023).The number of possible Echostone advancement attempts within Sidhe Finnachaid has been increased from 3 to 5.The number of Echostone awakenings has been limited according to the character's cumulative level.The AP cost per awakening attempt has not been changed.The limit is refreshed upon entering the dungeon again.[table][tr][th]Cumulative Level

notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Renovation Season 4 Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Sweet Dreams Box: Thursday, May 25th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 22nd, Before MaintenanceOpen Ocean Box: Thursday, June 8th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 6th, Before MaintenanceStar-Fishing Event Returns!: Thursday, June 8th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 6th, Before MaintenanceRenovation Season 4 Update: Permanent
Renovation Season 4:
Several skills have been modified! See the full post for more information: Renovation Season 4: Archery, Magic, and Race-Specific Skill Changes.
Commerce Alban Eiler Season 1:
Seasonal Commerce Alban Eiler Season 1 will begin at 12:00 AM PDT on July 1st, 2023 and run until November 1st, 2023 12:00 AM PDT.The following new outfits and sewing patterns have been added. The sewing patterns will be available for purchase from Sayiv’s shop in Season 1 for 3,000,000 Seasonal Ducats:Refashioned Selina Sexy Bare Lookhttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2335/refashioned-selina-sexy-bare-look.pngRefashioned Selina Lady Dresshttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2338/refashioned-selina-lady-dress.pngRefashioned Sleeveless and Bell-Bottomshttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2336/refashioned-sleeveless-and-bell-bottoms.pngUrban Casual Lookhttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2337/urban-casual-look.pngPurchase limits within Sayiv’s shop will be reset.The Alban Eiler Season 1 Challenger Box will be available, containing the following items:*NEW* Alban Eiler Season 1 Challenger 2nd Titlehttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2332/albaneilers1-gif.gifMovement Speed +3%20 Precise Reforging ToolsThe Seasonal Commerce Guide will be updated with Season 1, and Imbolic Season 3 information will be archived.Starting from the June 8th update, the required materials and quantity for each barter trading post will be partially modified.“Commerce Champion” titles that were acquired in the past and have already expired have been changed so that they can be equipped without any effects.
The following changes have been made to the game:
The Guardian Soul Stone item has been added back to the Adventurer's Seal shop and can be purchased for 6x Adventurer's Seals. The descriptive item name for “(Imbolic)” Commerce Mounts now display as “(Imbolic Style)”Between the May patch and June patch, the following changes and bug fixes were made:
The Master of Potion title now properly indicates that you are the master of multiple potions.
Modified "Red Dragon Inside Shadow Realm" to be "Red Dragon in the Shadow Realm".
Fixed a typo with the stat description of the Union enchant.
Fixed a few text issues during the Crom Bas questline.
Small typo fixes to Skill Info for Commerce Mastery and Taunt.
Several item descriptions for certain crafting materials have been made consistent by changing one of the sentences from "Used as a material when crafting special equipment" to "Used to craft special equipment"
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
An issue where the "Crest Forging Successful" notice appears when creating a Crest with insufficient bank funds has been fixed.Fixed a UI display issue when bidding at the Tara Auction.Fixed a punctuation typo with the Talented Artist title.When hovering over the Buy button in a shop without enough gold, the text will now properly indicate that you don't have enough gold in your bank.
The following are known bugs:
Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels.There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.The survey notice that appears when closing Mabinogi currently displays a white screen.Lag issues experienced by many players are currently under investigation. We have applied a change in the June 8th patch to alleviate the lag and further help our team identify the problem. We appreciate your patience and understanding while we work on this issue.

Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2306/ranged-attack.png Ranged Attack
The ranged attack minimum aim rate effect is added. (+20% at Dan Rank 3)The ranged attack minimum aim rate effect can be stacked.There is a maximum upper limit for the ranged attack minimum aim rate which cannot be exceeded. (Max +40%)
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2240/magnum-shot.png Magnum Shot
The damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.
Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill: Before: 560%After: 590%
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2238/crash-shot.png Crash Shot
The fragment damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill: Before: 280%After: 370%
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2241/urgent-shot.png Urgent Shot
The Urgent Shot effect has been changed:Before: Increased aiming speed for ranged attacks after Urgent Shot.After: Damage with Ranged Combat Skills +% for 10 sec. after Urgent Shot.After using Urgent Shot, damage with Ranged Combat Skills will be increased for 10 seconds. (12% at Rank 1)When using Urgent Shot, 10% of maximum health and stamina will be used.The Yellow Echostone awakening ability of “Urgent Shot Aiming Speed after Use” is replaced with “Urgent Shot Effect Duration.” (Increased by 0.1 seconds per level with a max of 2 seconds at level 20)The title effect of “the Master of Urgent Shot” has been changed:
Before: DEX +20, Urgent Shot Aiming Speed after Use 30%, STR -20, Will -10After: DEX +20, Urgent Shot HP and Stamina Cost -2%, STR -20, Will -10

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2262/magic-compilation-resized.gif

Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2260/hail-storm.png Hail Storm
When knocked down while casting, it has been changed so that the number of charges accumulated will be reduced by 1.The skill is canceled when knocked down with 1 charge.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2258/blaze.png Blaze
The target range is increased.Before: Melee attack distance + 0.5 metersAfter: Melee attack distance + 2 metersThe casting time to max charge has been reduced.Before: 3 secondsAfter: 1.5 secondsA marker is displayed on all enemies within range while preparing the skill.The 2 second delay after using the skill has been removed, as well a the immunity to some negative effects that were applied during the delay.Improvements have been made to the mouse cursor when using the skill.The knockdown gauge dependence is reduced by 50% in the explosion damage formula.Previously, 70% of the knockdown gauge could draw out all the explosion damage, but now it is possible to draw out all the explosion damage with only 35% of the knockdown gauge.Fixed an issue where damage was applied abnormally when switching weapons before applying explosive damage.Fixed an issue where Wind Blast damage was applied abnormally when using it after using Blaze.Improved skill so that it is not canceled when an enemy is selected outside the range while charging.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2261/lightning-rod.png Lightning Rod
Added a directional display effect that lets you know the attack direction while preparing the skill.The duration of the magic circle effect has been changed.Before: 20 secondsAfter: Unlimited
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2264/shockwave.png Shockwave
The delay after using the skill has been reduced.Before: 1 secondAfter: 0.3 secondsFixed an issue where the direction the character is facing changed after using the skill.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2265/spellwalk.png Spellwalk
Improvements have been made so that skill use is maintained even when moving to a different area.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2263/meteor-strike.png Meteor Strike
Improvements have been made so that the skill slot remains visible during the flashing effect when the skill hits.This is also applied when using the “Mini Effects” performance option setting.You can now turn off the flashing effect of Meteor Strike by using the "Mini Effects" performance option setting.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2259/fusion-bolt.png Fusion Bolt
When attacking with the skill, 50% of the opponent's magic defense is applied for each bolt.
For bolt magic combinations, a total of 2 magic defense calculations are applied, once for each bolt magic combination.

Race-Specific Skills

Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect the changes.Ladeca skills (Breath of Ladeca, Vision of Ladeca, Might of Ladeca) for all three races will no longer be canceled when changing channels, logging off, or rebirthing.

Human

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2257/human-compilation-compressed.gif

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2254/arrow-revolver.png Arrow Revolver
The damage multiplier for each shot is increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill: Before: 110% / 120% / 125% / 145% / 190%After: 170% / 180% / 185% / 205% / 250%The aim rate bonus that was applied only to the first hit has been removed.You can now perform a volley attack by pressing Ctrl + Right-Click on an enemy while preparing the skill. This will take into account the current aiming accuracy rate and damage multiplier of the current number of shots.Example 1: When attacking with a volley immediately after preparing a Rank 1 skill, the first hit will attack 5 times in a row with a damaging multiplier of 170%.
Example 2: When attacking with a volley after firing 2 shots with a Rank 1 skill, the 3rd hit will attack 3 times in a row with a damage multiplier of 185%.
An issue where the skill use status was not displayed normally when cast during knockback has been fixed.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2255/breath-of-ladeca.png Breath of Ladeca
A 10% bonus damage effect has been added for close combat skills when dual swords are equipped.Applicable skills include:Normal Attack, Smash, Counterattack, Charge, Assault Slash, Rage Impact, Bash, Windmill, Final Hit
Elemental Knight skills are not directly applied, but instead indirectly applied due to increased damage of Smash/Windmill/Assault Slash.
Note: The bonus damage effect will stack with additional damage buffs for a combined calculation.

Elf

The effect duration of the Mirage Missile has been increased. Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill: Before: 21 secondsAfter: 22 secondsDamage over time interval has been reduced from 3 seconds to 1 second.Damage for Mirage Shot based on the character’s Intelligence has been increased.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2245/elven-magic-missile.png Elven Magic Missile
The Elven Magic Missile can now be used while Final Shot is active.The way to use the skill has been changed from the existing mini-game method to selecting and using the desired attribute.When using the skill, 3 attribute options are activated. You can select the desired option by using F1~F3 keys and the chosen option will be used.It has been changed so that you can move while casting the skill.The cooldown of Elven Magic Missile is reduced.Before: 9 secondsAfter: 5 secondsCasting time of Elven Magic Missile is reduced.The projectile speed of Elven Magic Missile is increased.The Fire, Lightning, and Ice attribute damage of Elven Magic Missile is increased.The splash radius of Elven Magic Missile's Lightning and Ice attributes is reduced.The freezing effect specifications of the Ice attribute Elven Magic Missile are changed to be the same as the Ice Spear specifications.It is changed so that you can attack a frozen target with the Ice attribute Elven Magic Missile effect.When attacking a frozen target with the Ice attribute Elven Magic Missile effect, the damage dealt is reduced by 30%.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2246/final-shot.png Final Shot
When Final Shot is active, it has been changed so that the character cannot be stunned or knocked down.The duration of Final Shot has been increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 45 secondsAfter: 50 seconds

Quality of Life Updates:
Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: May Quality of Life UpdatesEnchant improvements to make highly successful enchantments more effective while reducing the penalty of huge failure.The Adventurer Seal system has been renewed, and the shop has been updated with new items.The Mabinogi BGM song titles have been improved greatly, thanks to our localization team! And more!
Hey all, GM Quuku here from the Quality Assurance team!

You may have noticed that we've done some Spring Cleaning as of late- we've been correcting more older bugs in each of our patches, and trying to hit newly released bugs as soon as they crop up.

If you'd cast your eyes below, you'll notice that our Known Bugs list has shrunk. We want to shift this from an incomplete backlog of our bugs into a parseable list that contains the largest, newest, and most relevant issues. We still have a (sizeable!) internal backlog that we're cruising through- these bugs haven't just gone away. Our team is dedicated to bringing you a quality play experience, and working through all bugs (new and old) in this distinguished game we play is one of our goals.

Many Milletians have been extremely kind in assisting us in squashing these issues as well, thank you so much for your support and patience. If you spot an issue, feel more than welcomed to report it to us via the official Mabinogi Discord!

The following changes have been made to the game:
Players will now have more time during the G23 Card Flip minigame. Blaanid's Song "Where Memories Come Together" during Memoir Book 2 now properly plays. Yay Blaanid!The Set Item name for Movement Speed Increase has been modified to differentiate the movement speed types.Eweca Movement Speed Increase Example: Items such as Fleet Feet or Shooting Star shoes. Ladeca Movement Speed IncreaseExample: Items such as Abyss Dragon Armor or Imperial Knight Boots.
Eweca and Ladeca Movement Speed Increase effects can be applied to the character at the same time.
Note: At least 10 points of a set item effect must be equipped to activate the effect. Equipped items that exceed 10 points of a set item effect will not grant additional effects. Additionally, the highest value of a set effect type is applied to the character.Revised several in-game BGM song titles to accurately reflect the songs and their details.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where players experienced extreme instances of increasing in-game lag after maintenances.Fixed an issue where players experienced extreme instances of increasing login lag after maintenances.Fixed an issue where the G10 quest "Prophecy of Irinid" would fail to start from the Crystal Ball.Fixed a few minor graphic issues with the following items:Dragon Guardian ShoesSpecial / Imperial Commander Uniforms (M)Special Casual Tech Chic Outfits (M)(F).The map and region name for Gairech Hills have been properly translated.Fixed an issue causing the Daily Messages from specific Support Puppets to not display.The Space Cadet pet skill text for "Cleansing Dust" will now display correctly when the pet is unsummoned.Corrected the Set Item descriptions for the following set bonuses: 
TroubadourDemolitionRuinationPerseusElemental HarmonyForest RangerFound a rare issue where Cliona would only sell four items, instead of the expected five, during the Tara Auction.Sheared a looming timer on the Cotton Candy Sheep (Aspiring to TRUE STRENGTH!) description. A f-ewe other edits were made as well, worthy of sheeps of praise. Mutton's gonna stop us now! We're on the lamb! We can-dy this all day, we have a cot-ton of these!
The following are known bugs:
If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.During the Master Plan event, when you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels.There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.

notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2686/200922_announcement_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Hello Milletians!

In an upcoming maintenance, we will be implementing our 64-bit Client Update. We highly recommend that you update your Mabinogi game clients, but this does not require a full re-install of the game when upgrading to the 64-bit Client.

With the February update, Mabinogi's game client will be upgraded to 64-bit, enabling improved performance on modern systems and to help us support Mabinogi long into the future. As part of this update, Mabinogi will no longer be playable on 32-bit (x86) operating systems.
Why Upgrade to a 64-bit Game Client?
Mabinogi on 32-bit was limited in its memory usage, depending on the needs of the operating system. With the change to 64-bit, it will allow the Mabinogi client to use more memory and improve client performance in various memory-intensive situations. It has been a recurring issue that any Mabinogi client exceeding more than 4GB of memory during normal gameplay would result in memory allocation failure, ultimately resulting in client crashes. In order to avoid such problems, the transition to 64-bit client may improve overall service quality. 

While the 64-bit client will improve some client performance issues, please keep in mind that it will not resolve every issue you may have encountered previously.
How can I learn what Operating System I have?
If you are unsure of what sort of operating system you have running on your PC, you can find out in the "About Your PC" System Setting page:
Use the Windows key to bring up the Start Menu, and click on the Gear icon to open up the settings.Under "System" menu, select "About" at the bottom of the sidebar.Look under "System type", which will tell you which type of operating system and processor you have.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1531/about-windows-64-bit-operating-system.png

It should show one of three possible options:
64-bit operating system, x64-based processor: No changes required, your computer is already set-up and good to go!32-bit operating system, x64-based processor: Your computer's operating system is still 32-bit, however your system's processor is able to support a 64-bit operating system. In order to play Mabinogi after the update, you will need to upgrade your operating system to a 64-bit version.32-bit operating system, x86-based processor: Unfortunately, your computer is not able to support a 64-bit operating system, and will not be able to run Mabinogi after this update.Updated Sound Library
Finally, with the future update, Mabinogi's sound library will also be updated. The sound library (MSS) used in the existing 32-bit client will be replaced with FMOD. When it came to the previous sound library, it was difficult to provide a stable environment when loading high-quality sound sources or loading sound sources of multiple instruments at once. As a result, the addition of an updated sound library will further reinforce "sound", one of the indispensable facets of Mabinogi. We will continue to strive to provide audio content that will satisfy all Milletians in the future.

Thank you for your continued support and patience!

- The Mabinogi Team
