notes.title: NEXT: Arcana Update
notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2042/221201_decemberupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png
Update Details
Arcana
New Arcana Talents, Elemental Knight and Harmonic Saint have been added. New Skills are added for both Arcana Talents.Arcana Talents combine the elements of two Grandmaster talents.Additional details for Arcana can be viewed on the dedicated microsite.
How to Learn Arcana
Characters over cumulative level 10,000 will receive the quest, [Guide] The Grandmaster’s Path.The existing Grandmaster Guide quests have been removed.You can receive the Arcana Guide Quest, [Guide] One Step Higher after progressing in the quest.After completing [Guide] One Step Higher, you will receive the quest, [Guide] Lighting the Arcana’s Flame.You must complete the Arcana guide quests [Guide] One Step Higher and [Guide] Lighting the Arcana’s Flame to learn Arcana talents.After completing the [Guide] Lighting the Arcana’s Flame quest, the permanent NPC Laoire will be added to the Arcana Association Room in Tara Rath Royal Castle.You can accept the Arcana Talent acquisition quest by talking to NPC Laoire about Promising Arcana Candidates.In order to acquire Elemental Knight, the character must meet the following requirements:Cumulative level of 20,000 or higher Acquire the Grandmaster Spellsword Talent TitleRequires the Grandmaster Mage and Grandmaster Warrior talent levelsComplete the quest, [Elemental Knight] A Dress Too Hot to HandleYou can start this quest after achieving Grandmaster Spellsword and talking to NPC Laoire about Promising Arcana Candidates - Elemental Knight.When completing the quest, NPC Cowenna will reside in the Arcana Association Room and the Elemental Knight Arcana talents, related skills, and journal achievement will be acquired.In order to acquire Harmonic Saint, the character must meet the following requirements:Cumulative level of 20,000 or higher Acquire the Grandmaster Choirmaster Talent TitleRequires the Grandmaster Bard and Grandmaster Cleric Talent levelsComplete the quest, [Harmonic Saint] An Unremembered DreamYou can start this quest after achieving Grandmaster Choirmaster and talking to NPC Laoireabout Promising Arcana Candidates - Harmonic Saint.When completing the quest, NPC Eochaid will reside in the Arcana Association Room and the Harmonic Saint Arcana talents, related skills, and journal achievement will be acquired.
Manage Arcana
A new area, the Arcana Association Room is added.You can enter through the Great Hall on the 2nd floor of the Tara Rath Royal Castle.To enter the area, you must complete the [Guide] One Step Higher quest.After completing the [Guide] Lighting the Arcana’s Flame quest, you can go directly to it by pressing the Go to Arcana Association Room button in the Talent menu under the Arcana tab.You can check the Manage Arcana menu at the Arcana Enkindling Lectern located in the area.Several options related to Arcana Level and Arcana Link are available to enhance the Arcana talents.Information related to Arcana has been added to the Basic Info tab of the Character Info menu.You can check the Arcana level, experience, and link level of the currently active Arcana Talent.The Arcana tab has been added to the Talent menu.In the Arcana tab, you can check the details of all Arcana talents.You can check the Arcana bonus effect applied to the character and the upper limit increase in stats.An active Arcana Talent tab is added to the Skill menu.You can check Arcana's exclusive skills in the corresponding tab.Through the skill management button, you can acquire and rank up Arcana specific skills.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2162/talent-ui-hud.png

Arcana Talent Enhancement
At the Arcana Enkindling Lectern, you can select and activate one of the acquired Arcana Talents.100 AP can be consumed to switch the active Arcana talent.Acquired Arcana level bonuses are maintained even if you switch to another Arcana talent.Whenever the character level increases, the currently active Arcana talent experience increases.When the Arcana Talent's EXP reaches its maximum level, the Arcana Talent's level increases.Each Arcana Talent level can be increased up to 50.Depending on the Arcana level, you can get bonus stats or learn additional skills for the talent.Training Arcana skills requires the character to reach specific Arcana Levels or rank other Arcana skills to a certain rank.AP is required when ranking up the skills.The Total Arcana Level is the cumulative level of all Arcana Talents, and the upper limit of the character's stats increases according to the Total Arcana Level.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2163/manage-arcana-hud-ui.png

Arcana Link
You can unlock Arcana Link stages when reaching a certain level of an Arcana talent.Arcana Links can be unlocked up to 5 stages, and more bonus effects can be obtained as the stage increases.The Arcana Link Bonus applies only to the currently active Arcana Talent.In order to unlock Arcana Links, the Link Unlock Requirements must be met, requiring a certain Arcana Talent Level, AP, and Scorching Crests.Arcana Talent-Specific Scorching Crest items are required for each stage.Scorching Crests can be obtained by converting the Smoldering Thread item and 10,000 Gold via the Crest Forging menu when Managing Arcana.Smoldering Thread can be obtained from certain dungeons.When reaching certain Arcana Link stages, Arcana Link Quests will be available for both Elemental Knight and Harmonic Saint Arcana Talents.You can proceed with the Link Quest when each Arcana Talent Link stage 1, 3, and 5 is achieved.You can unlock the next link stage without completing the link quest.Stage 1 and 3 link quests are accepted automatically upon reaching the link level.If you do not complete the previous stage link quest, you will not be able to progress or accept the next stage quest.If you do not receive the quest automatically or in the case of the 5th stage link quest, you can accept the quest by talking to the NPC Laoire about Promising Arcana Candidates.Stage 5 link quests can be accepted after learning both Elemental Knight and Harmonic Saint Arcana talents.
Elemental KnightElemental Knight skills can only be used while equipping a melee weapon.
Instill Flame
An active skill that grants the power of the fire elemental to an equipped melee weapon for a certain period of time.You cannot use different elemental instillment skills at the same time.While the Instill Flame skill is active, you gain the following effects.Increases minimum/maximum damage.Splash damage range is added during normal attack.Increases skill damage of Blazing Assault Slash.Depending on the skill rank, you can cast Bolt, Intermediate, and Advanced magic skills at the same time while using the skills of your Close Combat Talent.Allows Bolt magics to be cast while using Close Combat Talent skills with [Control + Right Mouse Click]Increases casting speed and magic damage by a certain percentage of maximum damage when using fire magic.Increases the Fire Elemental attribute value by one, the same effect as applying Fire Elemental to equipment.Mana is slowly consumed continuously, and the skill is automatically canceled when MP is depleted.
Instill Frost
An active skill that grants the power of the ice elemental to an equipped melee weapon for a certain period of time.You cannot use different elemental instillment skills at the same time.While the Instill Frost skill is active, you gain the following effects.Increases minimum/maximum damage.Reduces the target's movement and attack speed when using normal attacks.Increases skill damage of Shattering Windmill.Depending on the skill rank, you can cast Bolt, Intermediate, and Advanced magic skills at the same time while using the skills of your Close Combat Talent.Allows Bolt magics to be cast while using Close Combat Talent skills with [Control + Right Mouse Click]Increases casting speed and magic damage by a certain percentage of maximum damage when using ice magic.Mana is slowly consumed continuously, and the skill is automatically canceled when MP is depleted.Increases the Ice Elemental attribute value by one, the same effect as applying Ice Elemental to equipment.Movement speed and attack speed reduction effects are refreshed based on the last applied effect.
Instill Thunder
An active skill that grants the power of the lightning elemental to an equipped melee weapon for a certain period of time.You cannot use different elemental instillment skills at the same time.While the Instill Thunder skill is active, you gain the following effects.Increases minimum/maximum damage.When using a normal attack, the target’s Defense and Protection are partially ignored and the stun time is increased. In higher ranks, it also negates target’s Heavy Stander effect.Increases skill damage of Dynavolt Smash.Depending on the skill rank, you can cast Bolt, Intermediate, and Advanced magic skills at the same time while using the skills of your Close Combat Talent.Allows Bolt magics to be cast while using Close Combat Talent skills with [Control + Right Mouse Click].Increases casting speed and magic damage by a certain percentage of maximum damage when using lightning magic.Increases the Lightning Elemental attribute value by one, the same effect as applying Lightning Elemental to equipment.Mana is slowly consumed continuously, and the skill is automatically canceled when MP is depleted.
Blazing Assault Slash
It is an active skill that jumps towards the enemy and damages surrounding enemies.Able to select a landing location during the jump animation after using the skill.If you do not select a landing location, you will land at the point where you attacked.Damage increases while Instill Flame skill is active.Depending on the damage and Attack Range of the Assault Slash skill, the damage and Attack Range of the Blazing Assault Slash skill increases.
Shattering Windmill
An active skill that attacks enemies around the caster.Damages and freezes enemies on hit.
The movement speed and attack speed are reduced for enemies that are immune to being frozen.Deals additional damage when the freezing effect ends.Damage increases while Instill Frost skill is active.Depending on the damage and Attack Range of the Windmill skill, the damage and Attack Range of the Shattering Windmill skill increases.
Dynavolt Smash
An active skill that attacks enemies in a straight line.Damage increases while Instill Thunder skill is active.Depending on the damage of the Smash skill, the damage of the Dynavolt Smash skill increases.
Dauntless Defense
An active skill that blocks enemy attacks and counter attacks while in defense.While you hold down the skill button, you will continue to defend against enemy attacks, and in this state, if you release the button or after a certain period of time, you will attack the surroundings.Each enemy's attack blocked while in this defensive state will increase the counter attack damage inflicted to the target up to three times.The higher the defense proficiency of the Defense skill, the higher the defense proficiency of the Dauntless Defense skill.Reduces incoming damage based on the size of the shield.Small shield = 20% damage reductionMedium shield = 40% damage reductionLarge shield = 60% damage reduction
Harmonic SaintHarmonic Saint skills can only be used while equipping a staff or wand.
Hand of Restoration
A single target skill that recovers Health and Wounds.Additional HP recovery based on Healing skill’s recovery value.The maximum HP recovery amount does not exceed the maximum injury recovery amount.
Echoes of Salvation
A skill that restores the Health of party members within an area of effect.Increased MP and Stamina Recovery Speed for affected party members for a short time.Increased HP recovery based on Party Healing skill rank.Additional MP and Stamina Recovery Speed based on Enduring Melody’s skill rank.
Voice of Vitality
A skill that continuously recovers the Health of all nearby party members for a certain period of time.HP recovery occurs at regular intervals for affected party members and their elemental resistance is increased.Increased elemental resistance of Voice of Vitality based on the skill ranks of Fire Shield, Ice Shield, and Lightning Shield.
Pulse of Purification
A skill that continuously inflicts damage to surrounding enemies within a certain range centered on the caster. (Can be channeled for up to 15 seconds)While holding down the skill button, enemies will receive damage at regular intervals, but Health and Mana will be consumed continuously.When channeling ends, additional damage is dealt in proportion to the channeling duration.Skill casting will stop if the HP/MP required to maintain the skill is insufficient or if you are hit by an enemy.
Pall of Ruination
An active skill that grants a stat reduction effect to all enemies around the caster.Reduced stats are as follows:
Defense, Magic Defense, Protection, and Magic ProtectionMovement Speed, Attack Speed, and Casting SpeedIncreased Defense, Magic Defense, Protection, and Magic Protection reduction of Pall of Ruination based on the Dance of Death skill rank.Increased speed reduction effect of Pall of Ruination based on the Fantastic Chorus skill rank.The Time Shift technique cannot be used for the Pall of Ruination skill.
Blessing of Protection
A skill that amplifies the survivability of nearby party members by creating a shield for a short period of time.The shield negates most attacks for a short period of time. (It is not effective for certain gimmicks and instant kills.)Party members affected by Blessing of Protection gain the following stats for a certain period of time:
Defense, Protection, Magic Defense, and Magic ProtectionIncreased Defense and Protection effects of Blessing of Protection based on the Enduring Melody skill rank.
Hymn of Resurrection
A skill that revives an incapacitated party member.A party member revived with Hymn of Resurrection recovers some of their Health and Wounds.After reviving, incoming damage is reduced for a short time.Increased recovery of Hymn of Resurrection based on the First Aid skill rank.
Additional Changes

NEXT: New Beast Update
The NEXT: New Beast Update is here. See the dedicated microsite and the update post  for more information!
Skill Training Improvements have been added. Reduced training requirements make it easy to reach higher ranked skills, including the removal of CP Training. Changes have been added for Renown and Crusader training. Dan Advancement tests can be completed up to twice a day.Grandmaster now only require 10 Talent Seals to achieve a Grandmaster Talent.Changes to Blaanid’s Brave Boost have been added, easing the progression of questing and leveling for new Milletians.New rewards, including pets, Blaanid’s Blessing buff, and more!The Memory Book has been reset, so any character can start Blaanid's Brave Boost from the beginning again.Additional quest changes and the addition of the Receivable Quest Board have been added.Modifications to the Beginner Benefits have been added, and characters under level 10,000 will now receive Beginner Benefits.And more! 
The following changes have been made to the game:
Party Boards have been removed from Uladh and Iria towns. The Party Board can still be accessed through the Party Menu (P) -> Party Board option.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue causing the Book of the Sacred Chalice to be named incorrectly. Fixed an issue where characters could not progress in the G8 questline.During the G1 questline, a certain song is now properly synced with the cutscene.Fixed text and spacing discrepancies in Chapter 7 Storyline UI display.Fluttering Demon Headband and Fluttering Devil Headband display properly.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels. A textural error in Port Ceann has been reported.During the Memoir Quest "Nele's Music Basics", some objectives are displayed incorrectly.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1638/221107_novemberupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png
Update Details
Skill Training Improvements
Skill Training has been greatly improved across Skills and Talents to improve training requirements and shorten the time it takes to reach high ranked Skills. The number of training requirements has been reduced and the EXP received from training will be increased. (The adjusted amount varies depending on the Skill)Training has been adjusted so that the training items related to failure of production Skills are not essential for Skill advancement.CP (Combat Power) Training requirements have been removed from Skills.Skills that required training with monsters of a specific level (Combat Power) have been changed so that it can be trained without this requirement.A function has been added to automatically rank up a Skill when maximum training has been reached.You can activate the function by checking the Rank Up Skills upon Completing Training box at the bottom of the Skill window or the Skill Info menu.If you uncheck this option, it will be disabled again.Skills that become available for rank up by reaching 100 or more training experience while the function is activated will be automatically promoted without a separate verification process.Note: Dan Skill Advancement will still require participating in the Advancement Ceremony.AP required for Skill rank up will be consumed, and if there is insufficient AP, automatic rank up is not possible.Note: Skills that are already available for ranking at the time the feature is activated will not be promoted immediately.The Dan Skill Advancement Test has been adjusted so that the promotion test can now be completed up to twice a day.Failing the promotion test does not reduce your daily count towards it.The conditions for acquiring the Master title for each Skill has been reduced.Skills that are rank 1 or higher will only require 100% training experience for the master title to be awarded for that Skill.The conditions for acquiring a Grandmaster Talent have been adjusted.The required Talent Seals to achieve Grandmaster has been reduced from 20 to 10.It is now possible to start Grandmaster challenges for a Talent that is not actively set.Crusader level training and sub-skill acquisition adjustments have been added.Crusader EXP gained has been increased for Daily and Weekly Orders, Apostle Raids, and Alban Knights Training Grounds.Daily Order Crusader EXP completion increase is as follows:Girgashiy related Daily Order: 100 → 200Hasidim related Daily Order: 150 → 300Intermediate Bonus: 300 → 500All Clear Bonus: 300 → 1,000Weekly Order Crusader EXP completion increase is as follows:Girgashiy related Daily Order: 300 → 500Hasidim related Daily Order: 400 → 700Intermediate Bonus: 1,000 → 2,000All Clear Bonus: 1,000 → 3,000Apostle Raid Crusader EXP completion increase is as follows:Girgashiy: Easy 100, Normal 200, Hard 300, Very Hard 400 (Limit 800 per day)Hasidim: Hard 600 (Limit 1200 per day)Zebach: Hard 800 (1600 per day limit)Alban Knights Training Grounds Crusader EXP is doubled when clearing.The function of the Dogma Books (Dogma of Smithing, Dogma of Warding, Dogma of Binding) have been changed so that the selected sub-skill training is completed and the maximum level rises by 1 when used on a sub-skill.It can only be used for sub-skills with a maximum level of 14 or less.Renown training has been adjusted.The upper limit of Renown EXP that can be obtained per day has been increased by 5 times. (2,000 -> 10,000 EXP)The Nele Renown training requirements that had a negative impact on the use of the Bard Bulletin Board has been replaced with a new training requirement.When using the Music/Life Renown Seal items, you will now be able to acquire Renown EXP regardless of the daily limit of Renown EXP.To coincide with changes to Skill training requirements, adjustments to Skill training bonuses have also been added.The maximum multiplier of Skill training buffs you can receive has been changed to a maximum of 8x Skill Training.The effect from Skill Training EXP Potions will no longer stack. Alongside the change, you will be unable to use another Skill Training Potion while already having the same effect from a potion active.For example, when you are receiving 2x Magic Training EXP from the Double Magic Training EXP Potion, you will be unable to receive the EXP bonus from a Complete Skill Training EXP Potion.However, you can use the Double Ninja Skill Training EXP Potion while receiving the buff from Double Magic Training EXP Potion.If item bonuses surpass the maximum amount of training available, the maximum amount of training received will still be capped at the Max Training EXP Bonus: x8.The Character Level Effect that boosted the Skill training of an active talent when when a character reached level 100 or higher has been removed.NPC Duncan's skill untrain function will no longer be available.
Memoir Renewed
Blaanid’s Brave Boost has been renewed with changes to quests, rewards, and leveling while progressing through Blaanid’s Memoirs and the four Memory Books. If you have already completed or are in the process of completing the Memory Book, you can proceed from the beginning again with the new changes.If you have previously progressed through the Memory Books, you can acquire additional Blaanid Weapons when replaying. However, in the case of the Blade of Blossoming Memories item, even if you have two, you cannot dual wield them.Book 4 of the Memory Book has been replaced with objectives that require progressing up to Chapter 5 of the Generation Storyline quests. Certain quests and dialogue that were lacking in guidance will be improved, and the progress of some quests will be reduced.The experience point acquisition method when completing Memoir quests has been changed to increase the cumulative level of the character automatically.It is possible to reach cumulative level of up to 20,000 when you progress through the 4th Memory Book.As the cumulative level increases through the progress of Memory Book, the AP also increases by the same value.Note: AP gained is not affected by events, items, etc. that affect AP acquisition amounts.Characters over level 20,000 will receive 1/5th of the value of levels and AP when completing Memoir quests.Some of the Rebirth Potions that were rewarded during the Memoir quests have been changed to the Talent Coupon item.Talent Coupons can be used to change your currently active combat or life talent without requiring a Rebirth.Essential items and Blaanid’s weapons are now provided early on, and you can acquire additional skills of various talents to help you in battle by progressing through the Memoirs.When you clear the guide quest [Brave Boost] A Blue Fragrance on the Wind, you will receive a pet, the Brainy Sheep Whistle (Once per account).When you clear Memory Book 1, 2, and 3, you can acquire 3 Doll Bag Box items.First Memoir: Baby Bunny Doll Bag Box (7x7)Second Memoir: Fennec Fox Kit Doll Bag Box (7x7)Third Memoir: Bear Cub Doll Bag Box (7x7)When you clear Memory Book 2, you can acquire the Memorial Link skill.This skill is only available for characters who do not have the Divine Link skill, and will disappear when Divine Link is acquired.This skill is a lesser version of Divine Link.When Memorial Link is used with a pet, the pet will take enemy aggro, and both the character and pet will receive a temporary stat boost.When you clear Memory Book 4, you can acquire the Support Bone Dragon Whistle item.A new support effect, Blaanid’s Blessing, can be obtained by each volume of the Memory Book progress for the character.Blessing Effects do not overlap and the effect is applied to the character by the highest Stage.The Blessing can be set in Character Info > Additional Info > Blaanid’s Blessing to switch the Halo effect above the character.The Recall Book allows you to register a specified location, which can be teleported to by using the ‘Move’ function in the Recall Book. Blaanid’s Blessing unlocks the following effects at each stage:Stage 1Recall Book Stage 1Movement Speed +2%All Stats +1Acquire 1 additional AP at rebirthBlessing Effect Stage 1 (White Halo effect)Stage 2Recall Book Stage 2Movement Speed +4%All Stats +2Acquire 2 additional AP at rebirthBlessing Effect Stage 2 (Red Halo effect)Stage 3Recall Book Stage 3Movement Speed +6%All Stats +3Acquire 3 additional AP at rebirthBlessing Effect Stage 3 (Blue Halo effect)Stage 4Recall Book Stage 4Movement Speed +8%All Stats +4Acquire 4 additional AP at rebirthBlessing Effect Stage 4 (Yellow Halo effect)It has been changed so that the Blaanid’s Brave Boost notification banner is not displayed on the menu bar at the bottom of the screen.
Additional Changes
Generation progression has been improved.Generation quests for Chapters and Generations are now started in sequential order, and the delay time when awaiting the next quest has been removed.In G7, some information for quests that were lacking in guidance have been added. (Using Kousai's Lipai Tea)The shadow mission acquisition method has been improved in G11 and G12 so that you can enter the shadow mission immediately when talking to the NPC.The Shylock RP mission in the G15 'Price of Love' quest has been changed so that 1 to 3 players can enter it.Talking to the Bear NPC in Sidhe Sneachta during the day and selecting the Wait until Nighttime option will now allow you to enter a mission to meet NPC Tarlach in Sidhe Sneachta at night time.The dungeon length of some RP missions in Chapter 1 is shortened and the movement speed is increased by 40%.The Receivable Quest Board has been added.It has been changed so that new characters will no longer receive non-essential quests all at once.Only non-essential quests that satisfy the conditions after the quest board has been added will be moved to the quest board. Therefore, it does not affect existing quests.After completing the quest, Memories of a Chain Slasher in Book 3 of Blaanid’s Brave Boost, characters will receive the guide quest, [Guide] About the Receivable Quest Board.Characters that progress through quests will unlock quests available to select through the Receivable Quest Board.Characters can select and start the quests anytime through the quest board.Improvements have been made to the quest location check function and it is now possible to warp to locations using the world map.When checking the quest location, the viewpoint of the mini map will be modified to show the quest location and the character's current location at the same time. (May not be applicable in some areas)For quests in other areas, you will be guided to the world map as before, and the Moon Gates and Mana Tunnels will now be displayed on the world map.You can use the warp function of Traveler’s Guide by selecting the Moon Gate or Mana Tunnel displayed on the world map.It is also possible to set a hotkey to open the world map in Options > Game > Control > Hotkey Settings > World Map.Enchantment system specifications have been improved.Enchants of rank 9 or higher can now be enchanted regardless of rank.This means that no step enchantment process will be required when using Enchant Scrolls above rank 9. The phrase 'Enchant enabled regardless of Rank' in the Enchant Scroll description of certain enchants has been removed.The Portable Diffuser (Spider) item has been added.You can obtain the item by passing the hill in front of Alby Dungeon in Tir Chonaill or talking to NPC Trevor.The Portable Diffuser (Spider) can be activated by right clicking the item to Activate it.When the Diffuser is activated, spider monsters will appear in the form of an Aroma bear. This is visible only to you.Some contents of the Dungeon Guide have been improved.It has been changed so that all characters can acquire Vouchers without having to designate a main representative character.You can change it so that certain characters do not receive vouchers through NPC Eavan in Dunbarton.The expiration date of the Forgetful Potions obtained from the 1st ~ 4th Support Boxes has been changed to 30 days. (It does not apply to items that have already been acquired.)The Skill Training Seal (30) for Combat and Magic talents has been added to the 2nd ~ 4th Voucher shop.The image and text has been improved to increase the visibility of the recommended dungeon display on the Dungeon Guide UI.The recommended dungeon will be displayed based on the character's maximum damage.The Lorna and Pan tutorial has been improved.The part where the new character had to unnecessarily re-talk to Lorna during the First Steps in Erinn quest has been fixed.It has been fixed so the Item Equipping and Usage quest flow started shortly after completing the previous quest.The content of the Talent selection window has been changed when rebirthing or creating a character.The Glyphwrighting talent is excluded from the recommended talent.Magic talent and Gunslinger talents are added to the recommended talent list.The NEW mark of Glyphwrighting talent has been removed.A preset function is added when creating a character for the first time.When creating a character, you will be able to set the appearance based on several presets with premium appearances.Character presets can only be used when creating a character using a character card that can use a premium appearance, such as a Novice card.If you are using a character card that cannot use a premium appearance, the character appearance can be selected in the same way as before.Some appearances have been changed to premium appearances, indicated by the ‘P’ icon.These appearances can be selected by creating a character using a character that can use premium appearances, or by using a Pon during Rebirth or in the Dressing Room.Beginner Benefits have been updated.The criteria for Beginner Benefits has been increased to characters under cumulative level 10,000.Free warp using the Traveler’s Guide has been increased up to level 10,000.It has been changed so that beginner characters do not receive 3 types of beginner potion items when logging in.It has been changed so that beginner characters do not receive Heart Sticker items when logging in.All heart sticker items will be deleted.Heart Points Info has been removed from the Character Info > Additional Info menu.The reduced time between Rebirths of a beginner character has been changed as follows:Cumulative level 1 ~ 4,999: 1 day (24 hours)Cumulative level 5,000 ~ 7,999: 2 days (48 hours)Cumulative level 8,000 ~ 9,999: 4 days (96 hours)Cumulative level 10,000 or more: 6 days (144 hours)The [Return Incentive] Explorers League Patronage quest which can start the Returned Milletian benefits will no longer be available.You can continue to use the benefits you have already received and the ongoing Ten Missions of the Returned Milletian quests until the validity period of the Returned Milletian title expires.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1120/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussonforums-nxabtn.pnghttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1121/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussondiscord-7289dabtn.png

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:

Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update
The Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update is here. See the full post for more information: Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update
Chapter 1 Advent of the Goddess can now be replayed.New Replay Rewards such as the new Homestead items, including the Jukebox and Goddess Statue, Title, and Journal Achievements are available. NPC Voiceover, in Korean, has been added to NPCs appearing in Chapter 1 throughout the generation quests.Chapter 1 Advent of the Goddess will be renewed as a whole, with graphic updates and minor quest changes.The Chapter Info menu has been replaced with the Storyline Menu with improved generation information.
The following changes have been made to the game:
Several changes to the Campfire Spirit have been implemented.The cooldown for obtaining Burning Firewood has changed to be within 5 to 10 hours. The duration of the Burning Firewood and Campfire Invitation items have been reduced from 30 minutes to 15 minutes.Improvements have been made so that, when burning an item in a campfire, an additional notice message appears during the time period when Burning Firewood can appear.Brielle and Gillach have been added to the list of NPCs that can be invited through the Campfire Invitation.Brielle: Cotton Cloud CandyGillach: Tourmaline 10cmThe reward items sent by some NPCs after using a Campfire Invitation have been changed to the following items:Duncan: Physical Power Potion (1 hour)Castanea: Magic Power Potion (1 hour)Melwyn: Stardust Dye AmpouleSeasonal Commerce Imbolic Season 2 will begin on November 1st, 2022.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue with certain G3 cutscenes not playing and deducting gold when using the Crystal Ball.Fixed untranslated notice message when using Supply List item during trade action.Fixed several names of Enchant Scrolls that Stewart requests to exchange for Restoration Powder are incorrect. (Sheep Raising is Sheperd's, Excavator is Digger, Gusty is Windy, Boar is Wild Boar, Earthling is Earthen)Fixed the unnecessary line breaks within the Field Raid Messenger's dialogue.
Fixed the few text discrepancies when a Field Raid boss monster attempts to recover or recovers from Pragarah and Brionac attacks.Fixed the known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".Fixed the line break issue in the notice message when burning an item in a campfire.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.

If you have played all of G1 Advent of the Goddess, you can replay G1.If you have played all of G2 Paladin, you can replay G2.If you have played all of G3 The Dark Knight, you can replay G3. However, side quests cannot be replayed. You can obtain the C1 Replay Reward Box by completing the replay.NPC Voiceover, in Korean, has been added to NPCs appearing in Chapter 1 throughout the generation quests.The volume of the voice can be adjusted in Options > System > Sound > Voice Volume.Voices are not provided in general conversations and keyword conversations.A microphone icon is displayed in the upper left corner of the NPC's chat window when voiceover is playing.Audio is not provided for lines without this microphone icon.Voices are also provided for Chapter 1 NPC's speech bubbles.The volume may be loud or low depending on the distance from the character.The volume of the speech bubbles can be adjusted in Options > System > Sound > Sound Effect Volume.Chapter 1 Advent of the Goddess will be renewed as a whole.Quest information for some of Chapter 1's quests has been improved to provide more detail.Some story dialogue has been improved throughout the Chapter 1 Generations. Some changes to cutscenes and RP dungeons have been added, including graphic overhauls for major Chapter 1 NPCs such as Mari, Ruairi, and Tarlach. The pictures that appear during quests have been adjusted to a larger size.The length of Math dungeon in some quests has been shortened.The difficulty of some RP dungeons in some G2 quests has been adjusted lower.The length of Baol dungeon in some G3 quests has been shortened.During the first playthrough of Chapter 1, the Goddess Teleportation Support Scroll items will be provided for movement convenience.This scroll can be used to move to a Moon Gate location.The time for receiving certain quests has been shortened, and the quest dialogue will indicate the amount of time to wait to receive the next quest.The performance of the Adventurer’s items received when playing the Chapter 1 quests for the first time has been increased.The Smash Enhancement and Decreased Durability Loss set effects have been added and will activate when equipping all 4 Adventurer’s items. A Clear Reward Box can now be obtained when clearing the G1, G2, and G3 generation quests for the first time, containing Gold, EXP, AP, and an Adventurer’s Bag Coupon (7x7).Notice: Some character’s quest status for “Old Advent of the Goddess” quests have been reorganized.“Old Advent of the Goddess” refers to quests from Pre-Genesis Chapter 1 (G1~G3) received before June 2012.Characters who log in after the update will receive the proper quest progress automatically and the status will be revised to the progress of current "Advent of the Goddess" quests.G1~G3 completion rewards will be sent to the character's mailbox.Title/Journal achievements will automatically be obtained when logging in after 10/20 (Thu) maintenance.Data related to the "Gathering Dark Knight Armor Pieces" quests will not be reset.The “Bind” quest will be removed from all characters.Storyline Menu

the Chapter, story information by Generation, and detailed story information alongside quest progression.Chapter: Shows chapter information, distinguishing the Generations within the Chapter. Generation: Shows the generation information, including starting conditions, and completion reward information.Quest: You can check the list of quests that make up the story.Story Guide: You can check the information necessary to progress the story depending on which part of the story is selected in the menu.You can check your character's Chapter progress at a glance.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1176/ch_ns.png Chapter has not been started.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1175/ch_ip.png A Generation within the Chapter is 'In https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1178/g_ip.png   The Generation is 'In progress'  https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1177/g_complete.png   You have completed all of the quests of that Generation.Generation ReplayThe Replay function is added so that you can begin the story again at any time.Only Chapters that have already been completed can be replayed.To replay a single generation, you must complete all Generations in the Chapter that the Generation belongs to.For example, to replay G1, you must clear all of G1, G2, and G3 to complete Chapter 1 first.The Replay function is currently only available for Chapter 1: G1, G2, and G3 storylines.Replays can be started by using 3,000 gold. The replay is specific to each story part in the Storyline menu.Only 5 stories per day per character can be replayed, and only one story can be replayed at a time.The daily replay count is reset at 7:00 AM PDT.You can complete a replay immediately using 50,000 gold, 1 Pon, or 1 Instant Replay Completion Ticket to receive a C1 Replay Reward Box.However, this does not count towards the “Completed Replays” completion count (Title and Journal Achievements).While undergoing a replay, you can Forfeit Replay, however the 3,000 Gold is not refunded.Even if the replay is canceled through this method, the replay will still count towards the daily replay count.Replay RewardsYou can check the total number of replay completions for your character in the Storyline > Replay Rewards section of ​​the Storyline Generation Info window.Regardless of the selected story, the total number of replays completed by your character is displayed in this section.

notes.title: Quality of Life and Raid Improvements - Patch Notes - September 22nd
notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Check out this month's Patch Notes below!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Crom Bás Fever Time: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeStudy Event Season 2: Thursday, September 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 29th, Before MaintenanceIrusan's Check-In Attendance Season 2: Thursday, September 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 24th, Before MaintenanceAbsolute Box: Thursday, September 8th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 6th, Before MaintenanceYoung Miss and Master Box: Thursday, September 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 20th, Before MaintenanceBalloon Festival Returns: Thursday, September 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 27th, Before MaintenanceSeptember Quality of Life Updates: PermanentField Raid Improvements: Permanent
Field Raid Improvements
Several changes have been added to the Field Raid system. See the full post for more information: Field Raid ImprovementsChanges to the Field Raid schedules have been made.Field Raid Announcements have been improved with more detailed information.Contribution quests have been renewed.Earn Field Raid Mementos when defeating Field Raid monsters and exchange them for materials.And more!
September Quality of Life Updates:
Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: September Quality of Life UpdatesImprovements to Enchanting and Special Upgrades have been added: Improvements have been made to the Inventory Search function with a new Inventory list menu and new item tags. UI Improvements have been added for Synthesis, Fragmentation, Metal Conversion, and Mana CrystallizationThe flashy effects for skill rank-up, Critical Hits, Meteor Strike, etc. have been reduced.You can now sell Fynni Pet Whistles all at once to Fionnait.And more!
The following changes have been made to the game:
As announced, prior to the upcoming NX Merge, changes to the Trade Restriction Protection system have been made.For security reasons, there are restrictions on how NX can be spent. When NX is purchased for the first time on an account and when certain other criteria are met, the Trade Restriction Protection begins and a 4-day restriction timer is started on the account. The account will be restricted from certain trade-related actions in-game. Players will be notified in-game when attempting the restricted trade actions.The criteria in place that requires a certain Cumulative Level limit to purchase certain Cash items in the Mabinogi Item Shop have been removed.Information regarding Enchant Burning has been added to the Enchant and Campfire Skill Descriptions and several related menus. With the August update, there were several issues with Campfire Spirit contents. Since these changes were not stable, the following changes have been removed:Gifts from some NPCs had been changed.You could invite some NPCs that hadn't officially been added.Fixed a typo in the mini-map for Errans Gorge name.Fixed an issue with not being able to end the dialogue with the Fashion Contest Helper.Fixed an issue where the Cherry Delight 2nd title appeared untranslated.Fixed a typo in the listed items for Finishing Materials for Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.Fixed an issue in south Pantay Swamp mini-map where Lutra River appeared untranslated.Fixed an issue in La Terra Highland mini-map with the Mana Tunnel appearing untranslated.
The following are known issues:

notes.title: Producer's Letter: Team Status Update and News for 2022
notes.notes:
Dear Milletians,

I am writing to you today to update you on the current status of our team and share a brief outlook of what’s next for us in Mabinogi this year!

Please let me introduce myself; I am GM Mewlynne, your new Mabinogi Producer. It’s nice to meet you! And for those who already know me, hello! We last left off with our Producer, GM Supreme, sharing his farewell as he has moved on from Nexon America. I am honored to have worked alongside Supreme while he was on the team. He is an admirable mentor and friend, and I am proud to be his successor.

To share a bit about myself, I’ve been working with the Mabinogi team since 2016, and have been a Milletian since 2008. I’ve spent countless hours playing, testing, and living my fantasy life in Mabinogi, so I’ve been an advocate for Milletians since the very beginning. I started my journey at Nexon on the Customer Support team before joining the Production team. To be honest, it’s hard to believe that I have made it here; it was always my dream! I will continue to support you and the game moving forward, and I’m very delighted to be in this role. Please give me a bit more time to get settled, and I’d love to see you all in-game for a GM event sometime.

The Mabinogi Team has been working on quite a few things this year. We are so excited to have brought the community together in Erinn and hope to continue the adventures with our upcoming content updates. In the fall, we will first focus on polishing older content with updates such as the Chapter 1 Masterpiece update, Raid improvements, and multiple Quality of Life changes. We are also working hard to bring the progression improvement update that has been recently introduced in Korea along with exciting new talent content to NA by this winter.

I’m looking forward to sharing more details with you in the near future through the Producer’s Letter again.

Sincerely,

GM Mewlynne
Mabinogi Producer

—

Hi Milletians,

I have important news to announce: Friday, July 29th, 2022 will be my last day as your Community Manager, as I will be leaving Nexon America for a new adventure. I have been on the Mabinogi team since 2017 and have been a Milletian since 2008.

My time spent being your Community Manager has been an amazing experience and I will miss each and every one of you. Thank you to everyone on the Mabinogi Team for believing in me and helping me take the next step from a QA tester to a Community Manager. I know that Mabinogi will continue to do great things in my absence; just take a look at all of the exciting updates that we have coming this year alone!

To everyone in the community, thank you for welcoming me with open arms and for attending each and every one of my streams. I loved being your Community Manager and I look forward to seeing your excitement for the upcoming content as a player in the future. Until next time, Milletians.

Sincerely,

Katherz
Queen of Cheese Management
Milletians Don’t Read Club President
 
—

Thank you for your constant support, Milletians. While our team bids farewell to Katherz, she has made an everlasting impact that will not be forgotten. Please join us in Discord and keep an eye on our future posts as we will continue to update you on what’s to come.

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Renovation Season 3: Dual Guns, Ninja, and Puppetry Talent Changes
notes.notes:
Gunslinger
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1715/dualguns.png

System Changes
The stat calculation for determining damage while using Dual Guns has been changed.Before:For every 6 Strength and 6 Intelligence, Minimum Damage is increased by 1.For every 5 Strength and 6 Intelligence, Maximum Damage is increased by 1.After:For every 5 Strength and 5 Intelligence, Minimum Damage is increased by 1.For every 4 Strength and 4 Intelligence, Maximum Damage is increased by 1.The stun duration has been increased based on the weapon's Attack Speed and hit count.The stun time is adjusted to 1 second or more, varying according to Attack Speed and number of hits.Weapons with fewer hits compared to their Attack Speed have a longer stun time.The description of certain Spirit Enhancement attributes have been changed:Awakening Attack EnhancementExample: At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Damage +150% has been changed to Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Damage Multiplier +150%Awakening Range EnhancementExample: At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Attack Range +50cm has been changed to Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Attack Area Radius +50cm
Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.
Flash Launcher

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1706/mabinogi-renovations3-flash-launcher.gif
Flash Launcher has been changed to a skill with ranged attack properties so you can attack from a distance.The skill casting time has been greatly reduced.The damage for each Rank has been increased.Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill:Before: 950% DamageAfter: 1300% Damage
Bullet Storm

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1705/mabinogi-renovations3-bullet-storm.gif
The attack method of Bullet Storm has been changed so that it fires a set number of bullets at enemies within a certain range.The more enemies there are within the skill casting range, the more powerful the attack. If there is only one enemy, all bullets are concentrated in one place.When the Technique Seal: Pragarah is activated, the Magic Defense and Protection of the target are reduced according to the number of Bullet Storm hits.The Mana Bullet consumption amount is fixed by Rank.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 24 Mana BulletsThe maximum number of targets per Rank has been changed:Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 9 maximum targetsThe skill's attack range has been expanded.Skill casting time has been reduced.The knockback distance of the target has been reduced.A basic damage multiplier per bullet has been added to each skill Rank.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 50% per bulletThe damage multiplier per additional target has been adjusted from 2 or more targets.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 120% damageAfter: 60% damageThe final damage multiplier is now determined by adding up the base damage multiplier and the damage multiplier that increases per target.
Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:For 3 targets: 50% + (60% *2) = 170% DamageThe maximum damage limit has been adjusted per bullet and is applied at a fixed amount.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 400% Damage
Grapple Shot

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1707/mabinogi-renovations3-grapple-shot.gif
Grapple Shot has been changed so you can now use the skill by directly clicking on the ground where you want to move.When you arrive at the targeted location, damage is inflicted to enemies near the targeted location within a certain radius.The skill has been modified so that you no longer get hit for a short time while moving, similar to Chain Slash's Anchor Rush skill.The skill cooldown has been reduced for skill Ranks Novice to Rank 2. Rank 1 remains unchanged at 10 seconds.Example: Based on Rank Novice of the skill:Before: 16 secondsAfter: 13 secondsThe damage for each Rank has been increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 200% damageAfter: 400% damage
Bullet Slide

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1710/mabinogi-renovations3-bullet-slide.gif
Bullet Slide has been changed so that regardless of the number of attacks, the target's defense and protection are only applied once.The skill's casting range has been increased to a range similar to that of a normal attack.Skill casting time has been greatly reduced.The knockback distance of the target has been reduced.The damage for each Rank has been increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 250% DamageAfter: 1200% DamageSkill motion can no longer canceled with the ESC key.
Shooting Rush

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1709/mabinogi-renovations3-shooting-rush.gif
Shooting Rush has been changed so that regardless of the number of attacks, the target's defense and protection are only applied once.The skill will be cast in the direction of the location selected by the cursor, regardless of the direction the character is facing when attacking.The enemy will be knocked back according to the direction of the skill attack.Skill casting time has been slightly reduced.The knockback distance of the target has been reduced.The damage for each Rank has been increased.Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill:Before: 520% DamageAfter: 600% Damage
Reload
Reload has been changed so that the skill is not canceled even if you are attacked by an enemy while casting the skill.The skill is only canceled if you are knocked down or die while reloading.
Way of the Gun
Bonus Damage has been added to all Ranks of Way of the Gun.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 15% DamageBonus Damage will also be provided to other Gunslinger skills while Way of the Gun is activated.
Ninja
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1714/ninja.png

System Changes
The damage calculation method for Ninja skills have been changed. The way of applying the target's defense and protection values has been changed to match that of other talent skills. The damage multiplier of the skill is applied first before the enemy's defense and protection reduces the damage.The stun duration has been increased based on the weapon's Attack Speed and hit count.The stun time has been adjusted to 1 second or more, varying according to Attack Speed and number of hits.Weapons with fewer hits compared to their Attack Speed have a longer stun time.Evasion based on an enemy's Luck stats will no longer occur.The description of certain Spirit Enhancement attributes have been changed: 
Awakening Attack Enhancement
Example: At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Shuriken Awakening Damage +150% has been changed to Spirit Shuriken Awakening Damage Multiplier +150%Awakening Range Enhancement
Example: At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Shuriken Awakening Attack Range +50cm has been changed to Spirit Shuriken Awakening Attack Range Radius +50cm
Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.
Explosive Kunai

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1708/mabinogi-renovations3-explosive-kunai.gif
Skill activation time has been slightly reduced.The method of triggering the skill's explosive attack has been changed.When an enemy steps on the explosive kunai, all kunai explode at the same time.All enemies in a 3m area around each kunai that explodes will take damage.Depending on the location, one enemy may receive damage multiple times.Enemies caught in the explosion are stunned for 3 seconds, and at the same time, the target's movement speed is decreased for 6 seconds.The damage for each Rank is increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 200% DamageAfter: 300% Damage
Shuriken Charge

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1711/mabinogi-renovations3-shuriken-charge.gif
Shuriken Charge has been changed so that you no longer have to charge the skill. Instead, the attack hits at full damage when the skill is used on an enemy.The previous animation that played when charging the skill is now played while you have the skill activated.You can now move your character while the skill is activated.You can also cancel the skill using the ESC key or by clicking on the skill balloon.Splash damage now always occurs when the skill is used on an enemy within 2m, and the same damage multiplier as the selected target is applied.The damage for the skill has been changed to be a fixed amount at each skill rank instead of requiring it to be fully charged for the full skill damage.Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill - 690% DamageThe "Successfully use a fully charged attack" training requirement for Rank A and higher skill ranks, has been changed to "Defeat an enemy with Shuriken Charge".
Shadow Bind

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1712/mabinogi-renovations3-shadow-bind.gif
Shadow Bind has been changed so that binding an enemy persists while you are using the skill, keeping your character in place as you bind.A max binding duration has been added.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 20 secondsThe continuous binding can be stopped by canceling the use of the skill. It will also be stopped if you are stunned or knocked back due to an enemy's attack.Even if the skill use is completed or canceled, an additional binding time is applied to the target.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 5.5 seconds
Shadow Cloak
A bonus damage effect has been added for Ninja skills used while Shadow Cloak is active.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 10% Bonus DamageThe skill duration has been increased to 10 seconds.The damage of the skill's Tornado attack has been increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 120% DamageAfter: 300% Damage
Smokescreen
Smokescreen has been changed so that it now reduces the target's Magic Defense and Magic Protection. The reduction is the same as the Defense/Protection reduction.The smoke effect of the skill will now disappear naturally.
Kunai Storm
Damage for Kunai Storm has not been changed, however the skill description for each Rank has been changed to the damage amount rather than the damage multiplier.Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill:Before:  +460% DamageAfter: 560% Damage
Sakura Abyss
Sakura Abyss has not been changed, however the skill description for each Rank has been updated to include more information.Puppetry
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1713/puppetry.png

 System Changes
The damage calculation method for Puppetry skills has been changed. The way of applying the target's defense and protection values has been changed to match that of other talent skills. The damage multiplier of the skill is applied first before the enemy's defense and protection reduces the damage. The description of certain Spirit Enhancement attributes have been changed:Awakening Attack EnhancementExample: At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Control Bar Awakening Damage +150% has been changed to Spirit Control Bar Awakening Damage Multiplier +150%Awakening Range EnhancementExample: At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Control Bar Awakening Attack Range +50cm has been change to Spirit Control Bar Awakening Attack Area Radius +50cmThe formula that applies the increased Marionette Damage from the Spirit Enhancement Attack effect "Spirit Training" has been changed. Damage is now increased when using a Spirit.The "Marionette Critical Damage" set effect has been changed.Before: Increases Marionette's Critical Damage by 40%After: Increases the Marionette's Critical Damage multiplier by 80% when a Critical hit occurs.
Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect the changes.The following skills have not been changed, however the Skill Info has been slightly updated:Act 1: Inciting IncidentAct 4: Rising ActionAct 6: CrisisAct 7: Climactic CrashWire PullPuppet's Snare
Control Marionette
The Marionette will now gain 70% of the Puppeteer's Armor Pierce and Piercing Level.
Act 2: Threshold Cutter
The Combo Card damage bonus has been changed. It will now be applied to the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd consecutive hits while using the skill.Additional information has been added to the skill info and description.
Act 9: Invigorating Encore
While using Act 9: Invigorating Encore, the Marionette's Defense, Magic Defense, Protection, and Magic Protection is increased. Bonus damage is also applied when the Marionette attacks.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skillMarionette Attack Bonus Damage +10%Defense, Magic Defense Increase: +580Protection, Magic Protection Increase +80The skill effect is maintained, even if the Marionette dies and is resurrected or if the summon is canceled and re-summoned. The skill effect will continue to be applied to the Marionette for the remaining effect duration.The skill's activation time has been reduced.

Additional Content Changes Some content and NPC dialogue of the following tutorial missions have been changed to match the talent changes:Intro Gun TrainingIntro Gun Training: Movement SkillsIntro Gun Training: Ranged Attack SkillsTry TalentsContinue to Try TalentsLearn Shuriken ChargeThe following NPC's Gunslinger and Ninja talent skill Ranks will be lowered and their AI has been changed:Enemy NPCsCessair's Heart in the following missions:Heart Awakening MissionFading Pulse MissionInto Battle MissionCave of Trials MissionLlywelyn in the following mission:Fading Pulse MissionLlywelyn's Thoughts in the following mission:Alban Knights Training Grounds MissionSuccubus Fiend in the following mission:Rabbie Phantasm DungeonRabbie Phantasm Mirror World DungeonDisciple, Dark Disciple, and Melci Diafol in the following dungeon:Crom Bás DungeonAlly NPCs
Treasure HunterLlywelynThe attribute option text has been changed slightly for certain content to reflect the talent changes.Only the name of the option has been changed. The content, appearance, and probability are unchanged.This affects certain descriptions for Reforging and Echostone attributes, Glyphwrighting stats, Erg stats, and the Skill Master titles related to Gunslinger, Ninja, and Puppetry.

notes.title: Gold Renewal Update
notes.notes:
Gold Update
Improvements to the Gold currency system have been made!
Gold no longer occupies inventory space. It is now stored in your main inventory as a currency amount, similar to Ducats.All Gold stored in your inventory in the form of Gold, Gold Pouches, and Gold Boxes has been changed to the value amount of Gold you have.Immediately after the update, your Gold amount may exceed the maximum Gold storage limit. You will be unable to obtain Gold until you store the amount you have in the Bank or in a Pet's inventory.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1733/mabinogi-gold-amount-of-gold.png
The maximum Gold limit that each character, Pet, or Partner character can store is 1,000,000 Gold (1 Million).A character's maximum Gold limit can be increased by an additional 1 Million Gold when the character achieves cumulative level 10,000. This is not applicable to Pets/Partners.Characters who have already reached cumulative level 10,000 or higher will have their maximum Gold limit increased the first time they log in after the update.The maximum Gold limit can be increased further up to 100,000,000 Gold (100 Million).Gold Box items have been changed to a consumption item that increased the maximum Gold limit for the character that consumes it.When using Lorna or Pan's Gold Box, the limit is increased by 50,000 Gold.When using Lorna, Pan, or Blaanid's Special Gold Box, the limit is increased by 100,000 Gold.Important NotesPet and Partner gold limit cannot be increased.The Gold Box Upgrade Coupon items function as usual to upgrade a Gold Box to the Special version.If you obtain Gold that exceeds your character's carrying capacity, the excess amount will fall to the floor.If the total amount of Gold you are holding reaches the maximum limit, you can no longer pick up Gold.When selling items at an NPC shop, you cannot sell any items if the sale price exceeds your maximum Gold limit.Gold can be exchanged through the Give and Claim buttons in a Pet's or Partner's inventory.Give can be used to store Gold in a Pet/Partner's inventory, up to 1,000,000 Gold (1 Million).You can also pick up Gold and transfer them directly.Claim can be used to withdraw and receive the Gold amount to your character's inventory.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1732/mabinogi-gold-give-gold.png
Gold now stacks to 50,000 when picked up from the character's inventory or when obtained from certain content.Example: Gold dropped from a Dungeon End Chest will now be dropped as a Gold stack instead of a Big Gold Pouch.Gold can be divided and picked up from a character's inventory by clicking on the Gold button in the main inventory.50,000 Gold is the maximum amount that can be picked up.You can drop Gold on the ground or give them to NPCs this way.If you put the Gold back into your inventory, it will return your Gold value.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1731/mabinogi-gold-pick-up-gold.png
When Trading (including Trading during Pet battles), the Gold button can be clicked to select the amount of Gold you wish to trade.A maximum of 1,000,000 Gold (1 Million) can be traded at once through this method.Checks can be traded as normal and the total value of Gold being traded will be shown as the cumulative amount of Gold and Checks added to the trade.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1730/mabinogi-gold-checks.png
If the trade recipient does not have enough room in their inventory to receive the Gold amount, Gold cannot be added to the trade window.Note: Gold cannot be picked up from the main inventory window while trading.If you attempt to withdraw Gold from the Bank and you have already reached the maximum Gold limit in your inventory, the Gold value will be shown as 0.You are still able to issue a Check however.The "Gold" tag has been removed as a selection from the list of bag tags for Item Bag organization.The acquisition method for obtaining Gold from certain content has been changed to distribute Gold to your Gold value automatically.Example: Raids, Alban Knights Training Grounds, Sidhe Finnachaid, certain quests, etc.Gold Pouches have been removed from the game.The Gold Pouch and Big Gold Pouch items have been removed and you will no longer be able to obtain these items through NPC shops, quest rewards, Dungeon/Shadow Mission reward boxes, and monster drops.As previously announced, this removal includes Gold Pouch items that have not been retrieved from the Auction House.After the update, any Gold stored in Gold Pouches that you own will be added to the Gold value for the character, Pet, or Partner who had the item.The Gold value equal to the sales price value of the Gold Pouch (i.e. when sold to an NPC) will be added to your Gold amount automatically.The sales price of a Gold Pouch is 880 Gold, and the sales price of the Big Gold Pouch is 4,900 Gold.The way that the Small Gold Purse, Medium Gold Purse, and Large Gold Purse items function have been changed.Before: Storage bag for Gold Pouches and Gold Boxes.After: Storage bag for items.The name of Gold Purses have been changed to Item Bag.The quest objective, NPC dialogue, and TIP have been changed for Blaanid's Brave Boost quest, "How to be a Prepared Milletian 1".The quest objective that requires you to obtain an item from the General Shop has been changed from a Big Gold Pouch to a Medium Sized Bag (5x5).Blaanid's voice will not be available for this memoir.

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the RE:Life Update!

RE:Life
The Life Talent is getting an update! Read the full details of the RE:Life Update on the dedicated webpost.The Production Crafting Diary has been added to the Collection Journal tab of the character information window.You can view production completion records for crafted items.Crafting items will reward you with items.6 new Journal Achievements have been added.The crafting menu has been updated for life skills.The Crafting Success Rate has been increased to 100%.18 new Tailoring Sewing Patterns have been added as drops to certain Tech Duinn Missions.30 new Cooking recipes have been added.2 new Potion Making recipes have been added.The Weaving crafting recipes for Fabric and Silk have been changed.New material pouches have been added.New Homestead gathering props have been added.
The following changes have been made to the game:
The purchase limit, previously limited to 3 purchases per Erinn day, has been removed for the Teardrop Gem. This item has also been moved to the General tab of the shop and can be purchased at the Trading Post Merchant Imp for 35,000 Ducats each.The Netherlands Trade Restrictions that were previously applied during the December patch have now been removed.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
The Iria Quest board will no longer cause a crash when clicked on.[strike]Players are able to delete characters again.[/strike]Unfortunately, during today's testing, it was found that the issue still occurred on the live servers. We apologize for the inconvenience and we will continue investigating the issue.Unclaimed rewards from Irusan's Attendance Check-in event will be available in your Point Shop Inventory.The Blooming Roses 2nd Title will no longer appear as XML text in the title list.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.There is a chance that when logging off, you will not return to the character selection screen and will be kicked to the start menu with the error, "Server cannot be reached". This means you will need to shut down your game client and log in to the account again if you are attempting to switch characters.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.
Several menus and buttons in the Production Crafting Diary have text that is cut-off or is overlapping.The Journal Achievement for completing 1000 crafts incorrectly states "100" crafts.A few Weaving crafting recipes are incorrectly labeled:Fabric -> Cheap FabricCommon Fabric: Make Fabric (Normal) -> Make Fabric (Common)Silk -> Cheap SilkCommon Silk: Make Silk (Normal) -> Make Silk (Common)
The material for crafting Ice Silk is incorrect; Cold Thread -> Frost Thread"Macaroon" recipe and food item name is incorrect and will be changed to "Macaron".Attempting to delete a character may result in a "Failed to delete the character." error message.

Production Crafting DiaryThe Production Crafting Diary has been added to the Collection Journal tab of the character information window.
You can also set a hotkey shortcut for this menu in Options -> Game -> Control -> Hotkey Settings -> Crafting Diary.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1446/mabinogi-relife-production-crafting-diary.png
You can view the production completion records for all items crafted for the following skills:TailoringWeavingHandicraftBlacksmithingPotion MakingCarpentryHillwen EngineeringMagic CraftStationery CraftingFynn CraftingRefiningMillingAny time an item is crafted, it is automatically collected in the Crafting Diary.Note: Items made with Sewing Patterns and Manuals that can only be obtained from specific ways, such as part-time jobs or events/mainstreams quests, are excluded from the collection of the Crafting Diary.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1448/mabinogi-relife-production-crafting-diary-ui.png
The Crafting Diary is divided into two sections; Collection Items and Achievements.When viewing an item from the Collection Items tab:You can view all craftable items that can be collected in the Crafting Diary and view the date you've first crafted an item.You can sort by View All, Completed Items, or Uncompleted Items.You can view any related achievements that the item is associated with and your achievement progress. Clicking on a related achievement will bring up the achievement details.Example: Crafting a Hairband fulfills the requirement for the achievement, "Novice Crafter - Tailoring".You can open the corresponding crafting menu by clicking on the hammer icon.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1444/mabinogi-relife-crafting-diary-achievements.png

Select a potion for one of the following skills:
