notes.notes:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the server merge of Alexina and Nao into the Erinn server!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Crom Bás Fever Time: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeTidal Guardian Box: Thursday, March 31st, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 28th, Before MaintenanceMilletian Events: Server Merge Celebration!: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Multiple End DatesErinn Adventure Journal: Special Server Merge Season: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before MaintenanceThe Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 3: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 23rd, Before MaintenanceMilletian Events: The Grand Guild Gathering: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before MaintenanceShopkeeper's Sale: Server Merge Fun!: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 28th, Before MaintenanceElemental Harmony Box: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before MaintenanceCash Shop Renewal: PermanentAlexina/Nao Server Merge: Permanent
Server Merge
The Alexina and Nao servers have been merged into the Erinn server. For full details about the merge, please read FAQ 1 and FAQ 2.If you are a returning player to Mabinogi, we highly recommend checking out the Returning Milletian Guide for a quick recap on recent updates.
The following changes have been made to the game:
Guild Management and Guild Creation no longer requires Mabinogi Premium Service or VIP Service.Known Issue: We are investigating the issue where some guilds cannot place a guild stone or invite new members.Extra Equipment Slot Tabs can now be increased to a maximum of 12 tabs, up from 8 tabs.Bank Limit Changes 
The default bank limit has been increased by 50,000,000 gold for the first character created on an account. (20,000,000 -> 70,000,000 gold)When visiting any Bank, you can view your current maximum bank limit. 
E.g. Current: Gold Amount / Max: 3,500,000,000Your current bank limit is determined by the amount of characters you have on the account and can be increased in other ways: Character Bank Limit DetailsYou will not be able to deposit any more gold to the bank once the Current maximum gold is reached for your account.The maximum bank limit that can be reached is 3,500,000,000 gold.
The maximum amount that can be reached by creating characters is 2,100,000,000 gold.You can increase your account’s bank limit by using a Bank Limit Expansion Coupon to increase the capacity by up to 10 million, 50 million, or 100 million gold at a time.If the bank limit is increased using Expansion Coupons up to 3,500,000,000 gold, the limit cannot be further increased by other methods.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where the Bhatair, Morfydrianas, and Tani Doll Bags had the incorrect dimensions in their descriptions.Fixed an issue where the recipe for the Item Illusion T46 recipe stated that it required Steel Plates.Fixed a grammar issue in the item attribute section of the Trader Enchant Scroll.Fixed a grammar issue in the Tidal Guardian Box description.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.The Iria Exploration Quest Board will cause a crash when clicked on.A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.

14th Anniversary 
Happy 14th Anniversary, Milletians! Celebrate 14 years of Mabinogi with mini-games and tons of prizes! Check out the event page for more in-depth details!Talk to Dero the Eventsman in Festia to start the 14th Anniversary celebration.Complete daily quests to receive Night Bazaar Stickers. The more daily quests you complete, the more rewards you can obtain!How good are you at the Night Bazaar mini-games? Play 4 different types of mini-games every day!Conquer the waves of enemies within the Cave of Trials to receive prizes and event titles celebrating your achievements! The title rewards will replace your existing Cave of Trials titles if you've been through the scenario previously.Use gold or Instant Prize Tickets Capsule Machine in Festia for a chance at different rewards every week.Exchange your Night Bazaar Stickers for special prizes at different shopkeepers!Don't forget to log in weekly for more rewards as well as additional Night Bazaar Stickers.
Repair Cost Reduction
The cost of repairing equipment has been lowered to 1/5th (80% per repair point) of the original price.Example: If the repair cost was 260 gold per repair point before the update, it is now 52 gold per repair point after the update.If the discounted repair cost after the update is less than 1 gold, the repair cost is set to 1 gold.Example: "Beginner" equipment repair cost per point is 1 gold before and after the update.The reduced repair cost applies to Gold and Ducat repair methods.All repair types benefit from the discount, including Falias Artifacts.However, keep in mind that this reduction does not benefit Brionac repair as it uses AP and not gold.Cost-modifying effects such as enchantments and upgrades will still apply the cost modification, but the cost of the repair will still be lower as the base repair cost has been reduced.NPC repair rates have not been changed. 
Crom Bás Dungeon Polishing
The overall dungeon length for Crom Bás has been reduced.
The appearance of magic circles and destinations to certain rooms and puzzles will change accordingly.The puzzle requiring you to rescue endangered citizens has been lowered from 30 waves to 16 waves.The location of campfires and traps has been changed.The number of waves of monsters and amount of monsters that appear has been adjusted.The maximum number of Souls that appear has been changed from 4 to 6, depending on the Crom Bás Info score.There has been a change made so that Melci Diafol may not appear at a low chance.You can now use the following skills when fighting Irusan and Glas Ghaibhleann:Anchor RushTumbleWings of EclipseIrusan's HP has been greatly reduced in the Advanced and Elite difficulties.Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's movement speed has been increased.The delay time before and after the Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's Jumping Dash skill has been reduced.The combat AI of Completed Glas Ghaiblheann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann has been changed to be a little more aggressive.The movement speed of the Dark Shrieker that spawns during the Glas Ghaibhleann boss fight has been increased.When Dark Shrieker's self-destruct attack accumulates more than 5 times for Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and more than 9 times for Giga Glas Ghaibhleann, Confusion will be applied to the boss.The damage taken when Confusion is applied to Glas Ghaibhleann has been increased slightly.

The Weekly Reward Limit for Crom Bás has been changed from 7 times a week to 10 times a week.The drop rate has been slightly increased for some enchantments that were difficult to obtain in Crom Bás.The drop rate of the Nightbringer Huntsman has been increased in the Crom Bás dungeon.Mana, Stamina, and Hunger will no longer drop below 0 if you are possessed in Crom Bás.The time it takes to bless an item using Holy Water of Lymilark has been changed from 4 seconds to 0.5 seconds.

notes.title: Custom Motion Update
notes.notes:
Custom Motion
You can now swap between custom idle motions of any outfits that have special poses!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1445/mabinogi-custom-motion-motion-applied.gif
The View Outfits with Motion checkbox has been added to the Dressing Room -> Clothing tabWhen this checkbox is checked, only outfits with custom idle motions will be displayed in the Dressing Room.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1444/mabinogi-custom-motion-dressing-room.png
To apply a motion of an outfit in the Dressing Room to your Style Tab, click on the green Motion button next to the desired outfit in the Dressing Room. Once the motion is applied, the button will change to a yellow Applied button.You cannot apply the motion of outfits that you do not own, or that cannot be equipped on your current character.The motion of special collaboration outfits cannot be applied.Once a motion has been applied, it will change the custom idle motion of outfits worn in the Style Tab to the motion of the selected outfit.The motion can only be swapped between outfits that have motion.Only one motion can be applied at a time.Even if you change the clothing equipped in the Style Tab, the applied motion is maintained.Even if there is a motion being applied in the Dressing Room, the motion will not be applied if the outfit you are wearing has no motion, or if the Style Tab has expired.The motion of an outfit will not change if it is equipped in the Gear Tab instead of the Style Tab.If you remove the outfit with the motion that is being applied from the Dressing Room, the motion is turned off.To remove an applied motion, click the Applied button again, or select a different outfit using the Motion button to change to a different motion.When an outfit with motion is worn in the Style Tab, a small icon is visible on the bottom-left corner of the Outfit slot. Click on this icon to bring up the Dressing Room with the View Outfits with Motion option selected.

notes.title: Netherlands Trade Limitations Update
notes.notes:
Dear Dutch Milletians,

We've updated more details on the trade functionality changes that we announced in our Notice for Netherlands Players: Part 2. In order to comply with Netherlands regulations, the following in-game trade functions will be restricted for Dutch players:
Give and Receive items via 1:1 Exchange tradeItem droppingBuy and Sell via the Auction HouseMailing messages with items attachedPersonal shop sales or purchases (viewing other players' shops is still possible)Even if you have a Personal Shop Bag, you cannot open a Personal Shop.You can still buy the Merchant License from the Bank, but you cannot use it.Housing shop purchases (viewing items is still possible)Kiosk sales or purchases (viewing other players' Kiosks is still possible)Items given in exchange for an Enchant EntrustmentItems acquired through pet battlesEntering Uladh/Iria Dungeons using Item Drops, or touching the statueIf you are in a party as a party member, you can enter the dungeon with other players when they enter.You can enter a dungeon if you use a Unlimited Dungeon Pass.Receiving Mail Delivery part-time jobs from the Tara Bank
The above limitations will be implemented during the December 9th, 2021 maintenance.

Thank you,

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Beauty Update
notes.notes:
Beauty Updates30 new eye colors have been added to the Dressing Room.Changing your eye color will cost 3 Pon.Sandy BrownPoppy BrownDeep Olivehttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2268/mabinogi-beauty-update-new-eye-colors.pngIrish Mint GreenRainy GraySmog GrayAncient Blue-GreenThunder GrayGloomy GrayBold Sky BlueSoft Blue-GreenShadow NavyPremier VioletCaramelScented PinkSophie GreenLovely PinkSweet VioletSoft MagentaForest BrownNostalgic GrayLight BeigeLight ApricotClear Gray-BlueSnow GrayDeep Dark GrayDevil's ShadowSoul RedApricotSilky Pink30 new skin colors have been added to the Dressing Room.Changing your skin color will cost 4 Pon.Soft TanDark MudAlmondhttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2269/mabinogi-beauty-update-new-skin-colors.pngLight PeachDeep BrownSilverLight RedDark TanSoft EbonyPale ApricotDark AlmondPale CopperPale WaterCloudLight TanWaterPeanutMauveOakDark WaterBerserkButterMudSweet PotatoRed SnowZombieBlackPoisonSpectral SoulLight PinkBeauty SlotsThe Beauty Slot system has been added to the Dressing Room.This system allows you to store and change your Hair, Eye, Face, and Mouth appearances.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2279/beauty-slots.png
[olist]Access the Slot Section in the Dressing Room by clicking on the Beauty Slot icon.Select an appearance tab: Hair, Eye, Face, or Mouth.Click on "Save Appearance", depending on which tab you are currently viewing, to save the current appearance of your character.Click on "Save All Appearances" to save all currently applied appearances of the character.If an appearance has not been saved, each appearance will be saved in an applicable empty Beauty Slot.Appearances that have already been saved will not change.If there are not enough empty Beauty Slots available, this option will not be available for use.Select an appearance in a Beauty Slot, then click "Delete Appearance" to remove the selected appearance from the saved Beauty Slot.Deleting an appearance cannot be reverted.After a saved appearance is deleted, the Beauty Slot will become empty and will be available for use.Click "Beauty Slot Expansion" to increase the number of empty Beauty Slots using Pon.60 Pon can be used to add an additional empty Beauty Slot to the Hair tab.45 Pon can be used to add an additional empty Beauty Slot to the Eyes, Face, and Mouth tabs.[/olist]
Additional Details
All appearances can be saved once in a Beauty Slot.When saving an appearance, the Hair, Eye, and Skin colors are also saved.You can change the character's appearance between all saved appearances at any time.After clicking on a saved appearance, click the "Change" button to apply the saved appearance to the character.If you change to an appearance saved in the Beauty Slot, without saving the current character's appearance, you will not be able to revert back to the unsaved appearance.Beauty Slots are exclusive to a character, and are not shared across your account.Each character receives 3 free empty Beauty Slots per appearance type.Saved appearances are available only for the individual character that saved the appearance.Additional empty Beauty Slots can be expanded up to 300 for each appearance tab.Eye Blinking
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2271/access_blinking_settings.png
The Eye Blinking feature has been added.This feature can be accessed in the Dressing Room under (1) Appearance Change -> (2) Eye -> (3) Blink Settings.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2272/blinkingsettings.png
[olist]Click on the "Enable Blinking" checkbox to turn the blinking settings on or off.
If checked, the blinking settings are applied to the character.If unchecked, the blinking settings are not applied.The "Blinking Interval" can be set from a minimum of 1 second to a maximum of 60 seconds.This determines the time between eye blinks. The character will blink randomly between the set times.Example: If set to a minimum of 1 second and a maximum of 10 seconds, the eyes blink randomly between 1 and 10 seconds. Immediately after blinking, the cycle is reset, and blinks randomly again.The "Number of Blinks" can be modified for the blinking setting.Blink OnceBlink Twice (consecutive blinks)RandomizeIf selected, your eyes will blink once or twice (consecutively) at randomThe "Blinking Speed" can be adjusted.This is the time it takes for a character to open and close their eyes.This time can be set from a minimum of 0.03 seconds to a maximum of 0.15 seconds.[/olist]Once the blinking settings have been set up, click Apply to save it to the character.To apply the default eye blinking settings, click on the Default option, then click Apply.
 

 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2274/default.gif

Default Blinking Speed
Blinking Interval: Min. 1 seconds/Max. 10 seconds
Number of Blinks: Blink Once

notes.title: Dungeon RE:Fine Update
notes.notes:
New ChangesThe Dungeon Notebook has been added to the game.The Dungeon Notebook can be obtained by speaking to the Researcher near Poulnabrone Rock using the "Dungeon Notebook" option.The Main Rewards that can be obtained from dungeon end chests and dungeon boss kill drops are now listed in the Dungeon Notebook for the following dungeons and their corresponding difficulties: Uladh DungeonsShadow MissionsBaltane MissionsTech Duinn MissionsYou can reference the Recommended Dungeon based on your Total Skill Level in the Dungeon Notebook.The Dungeon Notebook can be stored in the Me tab.If you destroy the item, talk to the Researcher again to obtain a new one.Four new Refined Armor sets, their respective Blacksmith Manuals, and Blacksmith crafting recipes have been added.

In Uladh Dungeons and Tara and Taillteann Shadow Missions, you must meet a certain level of participation time in battle to fully obtain all rewards.
60 seconds of battle is required for Uladh Dungeons30 seconds of battle is required for Shadow MissionsThese conditions apply to individual characters within the dungeon or mission.These conditions apply to the following:
Uladh Dungeons: Basic, Intermediate, Advanced and Hard Mode AdvancedShadow Missions: Basic, Intermediate, Advanced, Hard, and EliteSome dungeons are excluded from this reward acquisition system, such as Normal Dungeons, Siren Dungeons, Veteran Dungeons, Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon, Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon, Abyss Coill Advanced Dungeon, Musical Math Dungeon, Lord Missions, Sinead’s Secret Missions, and special dungeons and missions exclusively for Tutorial or Generation quests.A dedicated icon has been added to the top left of the screen next to the list of party members when entering Uladh Dungeons and Shadow Missions.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2282/checkmark_combat_icon.png
If you meet the conditions for obtaining rewards, the icon will be highlighted with a check mark, indicating that the condition has been fulfilled and rewards can be obtained.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2280/grey_combat_icon.png
If you do not meet the conditions for obtaining rewards, the following penalties will be applied:
Uladh Dungeons: The dungeon itself is cleared, but the key to the reward box is not obtained after the boss is defeated.Shadow Missions: The mission itself is cleared, but the key of the reward box is not obtained and only half of the completion experience and completion gold is rewarded.Avon Theater Mission passes of the Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced difficulty can now be purchased from Marlowe in Avon.Crafting recipes for the Play Pages that can be collected from Avon Paper Sheep have been added so that it is now possible to create Play Pages of a higher difficulty when using the Magic Spinning Wheel.
5 Faded Play Page -> 1 Bronze Play Page5 Bronze Play Page -> 1 Silver Play Page5 Silver Play Page -> 1 Gold Play PageColor values ​​have been applied to Avon Theater Mission passes to make it easier to distinguish passes by difficulty.During a Grandmaster Mission, the durability of items equipped and used inside the mission will not decrease.
The durability will still decrease if using certain Life skills in the mission, such as Handicraft or Cooking.The issue of walls blocking the view has been improved for the following:
The boss room in the Lord Mission: Fragments of a Trivial FateThe Alby Battle Arena room in the Alban Knights Training GroundsThe Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon Pass can now be stacked up to 10 passes.The newly added rewards to several dungeons have been added to the Dungeon Reward List on the Dungeon Guide.Repeated Clear Guaranteed Rewards have not changed.Uladh Dungeon ChangesThere have been several changes made to Uladh Dungeons.
These changes apply to Basic, Intermediate, Advanced and Hard Mode Advanced Uladh Dungeons.These changes do not apply to Normal Dungeons, Siren Dungeons, Veteran Dungeons, Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon, Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon, Abyss Coill Advanced Dungeon, Musical Math Dungeon, and special dungeons exclusively for Tutorial or Generation quests.The length of the entire dungeon and the number of rooms have been reduced.
Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced Dungeons = 1 floorPeaca Intermediate Dungeon, Hard Mode Advanced Dungeons = 2 floorsWhen entering dungeons from Basic to Advanced difficulty, the mini-map inside the dungeon will be displayed from the beginning.
When entering dungeons above Advanced difficulty, including Hard Mode and Advanced Hard Mode, the mini map is hidden as before.The Dungeon Key has been changed so that it no longer drops on the ground for pickup.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2281/key.png
Now, if the party meets the conditions for the key to drop, the key will be acquired and displayed as a separate icon in a new special Dungeon Key menu.Any party member can use the Dungeon Key to open dungeon doors.Once the key is used, it will disappear from the menu until a new key is acquired.This change does not apply to Uladh Dungeons that do not use a key such as Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon, Abyss Coill Advanced Dungeon, and Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon.You can now purchase Dungeon Passes from Basic to Advanced difficulty levels from the Poulnabrone Researcher.
The shop tabs are now separated by Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced Dungeon Passes.The shop list of Tiro, who appears in some dungeons, has been changed.
All of the items in the Potion tab have been changed.

notes.title: Reflections - Patch Notes - September 9th, 2021
notes.notes:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Reflections Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Return of the Playful Puzzles 2021: Thursday, August 26th, 7:00 AM PDT - Wednesday, November 24th, Before MaintenanceBleugenne Viola Box: Thursday, August 26th, 10:00 AM PDT - Thursday, September 23rd, Before MaintenanceWish Upon a Star Candy: Thursday, September 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 7th, Before Maintenance[Shopkeeper's Sale: Homestead Refreshments and Hotdays!: Thursday, September 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 7th, Before MaintenanceRoyal Teacup Box: Thursday, September 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 7th, Before MaintenanceFamily Weekend Fishing Event 2021: Friday, September 10th, 12:00 AM PDT - Sunday, October, 3rd, 11:59 PM PDTRenovation Season 2: Combat Talent Changes: PermanentRenewed Adventures - Quality of Life Updates: PermanentRefresh Your Homestead - Homestead Update: Permanent
Reflections Update
September is a month of reflection, and we have several updates to renew your fantasy life in Erinn. Check out each of the individual posts below to learn more about each of the updates:
Refresh your Homestead!
The Homestead can be expanded to be even bigger than before.New Sales items and returning favorites are here, including Partner pets! Check out the Shopkeeper’s Sale: Homestead Refreshments and Hotdays post for more details.Changes have been made to the Homestead Options menu, and you can now view your Homestead visitor count.You can now place your Partners on your Homestead.Renovation Season 2: Combat Talent Changes
Several new changes and improvements have been made to the Close Combat, Archery, Magic, Puppetry, and Alchemy talents.Renewed Adventures - Quality of Life Changes
Over 40 game changes and updates are here to improve your Quality of Life in Erinn, such as no durability decrease outside of combat, visual skill cooldown timers and music buff duration, a hotkey to pick up items off of the ground, and more!

The following change has been made to the game:
Changed the title for "a Soul Streamer" to "the Soul Streamer".
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where the crafting materials for Energy Amplifiers were switched.Fixed an issue where Weapon Magic Attack was incorrectly labeled as Weapon Magic Damage while Erging.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charges gold.There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.There is a text issue where the quantity of Glyph Recovery Scrolls used appears abnormally in the sentence after using the Max Recovery option.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a partner has something equipped in their left hand.

notes.title: Refresh Your Homestead - Homestead Update
notes.notes:
New Homestead ExpansionThe size of your Homestead can now be expanded to be even bigger than before.Increase the size of your Homestead past the existing Stage 3 size using the following all-new items:Homestead Expansion Permit Stage 4Homestead Expansion Permit Stage 5Homestead Expansion Permit Stage 6
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1865/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-stages.jpg

Homestead Size by Level
[table][tr][th]Homestead Level[/th][th]Size[/th][/tr][tr][td]Level 1[/td][td]9x9[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 2 - 3[/td][td]17x17[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 4 - 9[/td][td]25x25[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 10 - 13[/td][td]33x33[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 14 - 15[/td][td]49x49[/td][/tr][/table]
Homestead Size when using a Homestead Expansion Permit
[table][tr][th]Stage[/th][th]Size[/th][/tr][tr][td]Stage 1[/td][td]55x55[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 2[/td][td]61x61[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 3[/td][td]67x67[/td][/tr][tr][td]*NEW* Stage 4[/td][td]75x75[/td][/tr][tr][td]*NEW* Stage 5[/td][td]83x83[/td][/tr][tr][td]*NEW* Stage 6[/td][td]91x91[/td][/tr][/table]
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1866/mabinogi-homestead-update-homestead-items.jpg

Homestead Expansion Permit Details
Homesteads that are Level 14 or higher can be expanded in size using Homestead Expansion Permits, up to Stage 6.Each Expansion Permit will increase the size of the Homestead.Stage 1 - 3: Size will be expanded by 6 tiles horizontally and vertically.*NEW* Stage 4 - 6: Size will be expanded by 8 tiles horizontally and vertically.Each Permit can only be used on a Homestead once.Each Permit, past Stage 1, requires the previous Stage Permit to be used on the Homestead.Example: The Homestead Expansion Permit (Stage 4) cannot be used until a Homestead Expansion Permit (Stage 3) has already been used to expand the Homestead.Homestead Expansion Permits are permanently available and can be purchased in the Item Shop:Homestead Expansion (Stage 1)Homestead Expansion (Stage 2)Homestead Expansion (Stage 3)*NEW* Homestead Expansion (Stage 4)*NEW* Homestead Expansion (Stage 5)*NEW* Homestead Expansion (Stage 6)
[/td][/tr][/table]New Homestead Changes
Options and Permissions
Upon entering your Homestead, two new buttons can be accessed in the Homestead Information menu in the top right. 
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1879/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-options-1.png
Options: Apply overall Homestead permissions through this menu.
This option button replaces the need to click on the Homestead Entrance -> View Information button to open the Building information menu previously.Minimize: This Homestead menu can now be minimized.You can also minimize this menu when visiting other character's Homesteads.When you click on the Options button in the Homestead menu, you can view the Homestead Options.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1868/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-options-2.png
Entry Permissions: Set the permissions of who can enter your Homestead.Item Permissions: Apply permissions to all Homestead Props.This has been changed from needing to set the option for each Homestead prop.You can still set the option for each Homestead prop individually.However, if you set the permissions for a prop individually, the saved option in Homestead Options -> Item Permissions will be unchecked. If checked again, it will change the permissions of all props once more.When placing a new Homestead prop, the permission setting is reflected on the new item as well.
Visitor Count
The Homestead visitor count is now displayed.Open the Homestead menu (Default Hotkey: U) when outside of your Homestead to view the Today and Total visitor count.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1869/mabinogi-homestead-update-vistor-count.png
Today's Count: View the total number of visitors to your Homestead for the day.This will count once per visiting character per day, and resets at 7:00 AM PT daily.Total Count: View the total number of visitors who have visited your Homestead.
Partner Homestead Placement

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1870/mabinogi-homestead-update-partners-1.gif
You can now place your Partners in your Homestead.Upon entering your Homestead, a new Partner Placement button is available underneath the Edit and Construction List Homestead buttons.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1871/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-buttons-partnerplacement-added.png
Open up the menu to view the list of available Partners that can be placed in your Homestead.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1957/mabinogi-homestead-update-placement-menu.png
Select Static Placement from the menu to place a Partner anywhere in your Homestead.Select Interactive Placement from the menu to place a Partner on a Homestead Prop, such as a chair.A silhouette view will appear and it will show where the Partner can be placed on all available Homestead props.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1872/mabinogi-homestead-update-silhouette-before.png
You can move a Homestead prop that has a Partner placed on it and the Partner will be moved with it.If you remove a Homestead prop that has a Partner is placed on it, the Partner will also be removed with the prop. The Partner can be placed again from the Partner Placement menu.
You are unable to select a Partner that is already placed in another Homestead within the same account.Partners cannot be placed inside a Homestead House.Partner take up a 1x1 space when placing them in your Homestead.Partners cannot overlap existing Homestead prop grids.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1873/mabinogi-homestead-update-partners-2.png

Partner Homestead Options
While outside of the Partner Placement menu, click on a placed Partner to view the following options:Partner GestureMoveSwitch Out
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1874/mabinogi-homestead-update-partner-options.png
You can now modify the Gestures of Partners place in your Homestead.You are unable to modify Partner Gestures when a Partner is placed on a Homestead prop.Crossover Partners such as Ram and Rem from the Re:ZERO crossover cannot use Partner Gestures.
Basic Motion
Homestead Partner Cards can be used to add new basic motions to a Partner, like an idle stance.Homestead Partner Cards can be obtained from the Homestead Partner Basic Motion Card Box sold in the Maid and Butler Partner shops for 500,000 gold.You can obtain 1 of 85 Basic Motions with an equal chance when opening the box.Once you have a Homestead Partner Card in your character's inventory, open the Partner Gesture menu. Under the "Motions" column, click Add, then select a Card to give to your Partner, and then click OK.
Each card is a one-time use and will only be applied to the chosen Partner.You can add up to 100 Basic Motions.You can Delete the added motion, but the Motion Card will not be returned.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1875/mabinogi-homestead-update-adding-motion.gif
If a Partner is wearing an outfit with an animation, the animation will play when the default "Basic Motion" option is selected.
Gesture Motion
Gesture Cards can be used to add Gestures that a Partner can use.Existing Gesture Cards can be used.Once you have a Gesture Card in your character's inventory, open the Partner Gesture menu. Under the "Gesture" column, click Add, then select a card to give to the Partner, and click OK.Each card is a one-time use and will only be applied to the chosen Partner.You can add up to 100 Gestures.You can Delete the added Gesture, but the Gesture Card will not be returned.You can change the time interval (in seconds) that the Gesture will repeat.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1876/mabinogi-homestead-update-interval.png
At 0, the Gesture will continuously repeat from beginning to end. If the set interval is shorter than the length of the Gesture, the Gesture is cut off and plays again.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1877/mabinogi-homestead-update-2sec-repeated-gesture.gif
If the Gesture interval is set longer than the length of the Gesture, the Gesture will play. When it ends, the Basic Motion will play until the Gesture plays again.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1878/mabinogi-homestead-update-15sec-gesture-then_basic-motion.gif
The max interval can be set is 999 seconds.If you do not want a Gesture motion to be played, select the default "Do Not Use" option and the selected Basic Motion for the Partner will play instead.
Move
You can move the Partner around your Homestead, similar to a Homestead prop.You are unable to move the Partner if they are placed on a Homestead prop.
Switch Out
You can remove a Partner from the Homestead.Once a Partner is placed on the Homestead, you cannot summon it until you've removed them from the Homestead.

notes.title: Renovation Season 2: Combat Talent Changes
notes.notes:
Magic
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1836/mabinogi-talent-update-magic.png

System Changes
The magic system has been changed so that only 1 magic charge (previously 2 magic charges) is decreased if you are knocked down while charging Healing or any of the following intermediate magic skills:ThunderFireballIce SpearThe magic system has been changed so that the charge count is not removed if you are knocked down while charging any type of Bolt Magic.
Item Changes

Wand
You can now use all intermediate magic regardless of the type of Wand you have equipped.
For example, Thunder, Fireball, and Ice Spear can all be cast using a Lighting Wand, Fire Wand, or Ice Wand.Each Wand receives 5% bonus damage when the intermediate magic being used matches the elemental attribute of the Wand.Lightning Wand - Thunder Bonus Damage +5%Fire Wand - Fireball Bonus Damage +5%Ice Wand - Ice Spear Bonus Damage +5%Divine Tribolt Wand - Can receive Bonus Damage +5% effect from all intermediate magic
Staff
All Staves can use intermediate magic.You no longer need to collect elemental charges with some Staves, such as a Trinity Staff.
Skill Changes

Fireball

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1833/mabinogi-talent-update-fireball.gif
The damage of Fireball has been increased.This increased damage also applies to some enemies.Fireball can now be used from 1 charge, instead of requiring 5 charges.The charge can still be stacked to 5, and the damage will increase with each charge up to 5.Damage ratio per charge = 1: 2: 3: 4: 6.51 Charge: 1/6.5 Damage2 Charge: 2/6.5 Damage3 Charges: 3/6.5 Damage4 Charges: 4/6.5 Damage5 Charges: 6.5/6.5 DamageThe time that Fireball will fly in the air has been shortened to 1 second.Previously, the time was 2.5 seconds.This change does not apply to enemies.
Ice Spear
The damage of Ice Spear has been increased.This increased damage also applies to some enemies.
Thunder

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1846/mabinogi-talent-update-thunder.gif
The damage of Thunder has been increased.This increased damage also applies to some enemies.The time it takes for lightning to strike has been reduced to one second, regardless of the skill Rank.This change does not apply to enemies.
Blaze
While charging Blaze, stun is now ignored, and no longer cancels the skill.Being knocked down will still cancel Blaze.Attacks that inflict a special stun will still cancel Blaze.
Hail Storm

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1835/mabinogi-talent-update-hail-storm.gif
Hail Storm can now be used with Spellwalk, enabling you to walk freely while the skill is charging, or while having active Hail Storm charges.
Spellwalk
The way Stamina is consumed for Spellwalk has been changed.Stamina no longer decreases while Spellwalk is active.Stamina will only decrease when moving while charging a skill, or before using a skill that has been charged.This only applies to skills that you cannot normally move with without Spellwalk active.10 Stamina points are consumed per second in this state.
Meteor Strike

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1844/mabinogi-talent-update-meteor-strike.gif
The damage of Meteor Strike has been increased.This increased damage also applies to some enemies.The casting time of Meteor Strike has been reduced to 2 seconds from 4 seconds.This change does not apply to enemies.The time it takes for Meteor Strike to hit has been reduced to 2 seconds from 5 seconds.This change does not apply to enemies.The damage reduction based on the distance furthest from the center of impact has been removed.

Close Combat
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1830/mabinogi-talent-update-close-combat.png

Skill Changes

Windmill

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1853/mabinogi-talent-update-windmill.gif
The maximum damage per Rank has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Human/Giant: 250% -> 400%Elf: 200% -> 320%Windmill's attack range has been increased depending on the Rank of the skill.When you have a melee Combat talent weapon equipped and are using Windmill, enemies hit by Windmill are knocked down in place. They are no longer knocked back and scattered.This change does not apply to enemies who use Windmill.
Charge/Lance Charge
The position lag issue when using Charge/Lance Charge has been improved.
Assault Slash
Assault Slash's cooldown has been reduced to 7 seconds across all Ranks.The activation speed has been increased when using Assault Slash after Smash.

Alchemy
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1841/mabinogi-talent-update-alchemy.png

System Changes

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1854/mabinogi-talent-update-alchemic-damage.png
Alchemic Damage has been added to the Character Information menu.It now shows stats for Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth attributes based on the character's equipped titles, gear, and talent bonuses.The stats that affect Alchemy have been changed.
Damage is increased by the average of the character's Max HP, Max MP, and Max Stamina.The affected skills are as follows:Water CannonFlame BurstWind BlastHeat BusterSand BurstFrozen BlastShock
Skill Changes

Water Cannon
Water Cannon has been changed to apply a fixed maximum damage amount regardless of the distance from the target.This change does not apply to enemies.Before: Base damage 1x * Damage by Distance from target (0.6x to 1.4x)After: Base damage 1x * Distance 1.4x
Flame Burst

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1834/mabinogi-talent-update-flame-burst.gif
Flame Burst's duration has been increased for some Ranks of Flame Burst.If the new duration includes a time less than 1 second, the Flame hit will be calculated as 1 second.In this case, the last hit of Flame Burst will deal damage proportional to the original duration.Example: If the duration of Flame Burst's usage is 4.2 seconds, it will hit 5 times over 5 seconds. The last hit will be applied at 20% of the damage of 1 hit.
Wind Blast

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1839/mabinogi-talent-update-wind-blast.gif
Wind Blast's activation structure has been changed to be activated by clicking the ground after casting.When activated, enemies within a 4 meter radius around the character are pushed in one direction.Enemies behind the character are pushed in the direction the character is facing.This change does not apply to enemies.The reforge option, Wind Blast Range, has been changed to Wind Blast Attack Range.Previously, the reforge started at 1 meter, and increased the range by 0.25 meters per level.This has now been changed to an option that increases the attack range by 0.15 meters per level.The Stardust Support Effect for Wind Blast has been changed from Blast to Flare.
Heat Buster

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1837/mabinogi-talent-update-heat-buster.gif
Heat Buster has been changed so that you can activate this skill when the cylinder pressure is 50% or higher.Previously, it required 100% cylinder pressure.When activated, the damage is proportional to the pressure amount.Example: When activated at 50% pressure, it is activated at 50% damage.When activated at maximum pressure, an additional 20% damage is inflicted as before.
Life Drain

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1858/mabinogi-talent-update-life-drain.png
Life Drain can now be activated even when you have Max HP.
Summon Golem
The stats of the summoned Golem's HP, Magic Defense, and Magic Protection have been increased.The casting time and attack time of the summoned Golem's Smash, Defense, and Windmill skills have been reduced.Fixed an issue where the summoned Golem's Taunt skill did not have a cooldown.

Puppetry
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1838/mabinogi-talent-update-puppetry.png

System Changes

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1855/mabinogi-talent-update-marionette-info.png
Marionette Information can now be viewed in the Character Information menu. It outlines the stats of the summoned marionette and can only be viewed when a marionette is summoned.This menu can also be opened by right-clicking the summoned marionette character and clicking on "View Status".A new option has been added.Options -> Game -> Controls -> Use Marionette CameraWhen activated, the camera moves around the doll instead of the player.Marionettes can now pick up items.
Skill Changes

Control Marionette

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1857/mabinogi-talent-update-puppetry-dismount-pet.gif
The Control Marionette skill has been changed so that if the marionette summon is canceled due to mounting a pet, the marionette will be summoned automatically after dismounting the pet. The Control Marionette skill will also be activated after dismounting the pet.
Act 1: Inciting Incident
The base damage of Act 1: Inciting Incident has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1 of the skill:200% -> 300% damage
Act 2: Threshold Cutter

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1843/mabinogi-talent-update-act-2.gif
The base damage of Act 2: Threshold Cutter has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1 of the skill:700% -> 960% damageThe character and marionette motion when using the skill has been changed.The skill has been changed to an AoE attack skill that simultaneously attacks enemies within a 2 meter radius from the original targeted enemy.Attack speed has been increased.The Stardust Support Effect for Act 2: Threshold Cutter has been changed from Blast to Flare.
Act 4: Rising Action
The base damage of Act 4: Rising Action has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1 of the skill:300% -> 560% damage
Act 6: Crisis
The invincibility duration of enemies hit by the skill has been removed.
Act 7: Climactic Crash

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1847/mabinogi-talent-update-act-7.gif
The base damage of Act 7: Climactic Crash has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1 of the skill:550% -> 860% damageIt has been changed so that the control of the marionette is not canceled after the attack is completed so long as the position of the marionette is within the control range.The enemy is knocked back in the same direction as the skill casting direction, increasing the probability of enemies being hit by all 3 hits.Fixed an issue where the marionette would not move intermittently when using the skill in front of obstacles.Fixed an issue where you are intermittently unable to attack enemies when using the skill in front of obstacles.

Archery
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1845/mabinogi-talent-update-archery.png

System Changes

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1831/mabinogi-talent-update-archery-rework.gif
Archery has been changed so that regardless of the aiming rate, the Archery Talent attack will always hit an enemy.If attacking outside of the attack range, the attack will miss.The damage is determined by the character's minimum/maximum damage in proportion to the aiming rate at the time of the attack.When the aiming rate is 100%, the minimum/maximum damage is 100% reflected.Various effects that previously affected accuracy have been changed to now affect aiming rate.Certain text descriptions that mention Accuracy have been changed to Aim Rate.The delay time when aiming from 99% to 100% is now removed.The effect that appears when the aiming rate is 100% has been changed to now appear when the aiming rate is 70%.A bonus to the aim rate is now applied when reaching 70% aim rate, regardless of the aiming speed.This change only applies to player characters.
Item Changes
The Bow and Crossbow Erg Bonus Effects have been changed.Before: "Skill cooldown upon aim failure"
Decreased time by seconds per Erg levelAfter: "Archery Skill Cooldown"
Decreased time by seconds per Erg levelThe Erg effect reduction value per level has been decreasedExample - Based on level 50 Erg:Max 2 seconds -> 1 secondVarious arrows and bolts can now be bundled up to 500 pieces.The number of bundles of arrows/bolts sold by weapon shop NPCs has increased.1,000 arrows can now be inserted into the Quiver.The Piercing Forest Arrow description has been corrected to include the additional 12% maximum damage bonus.
Skill Changes

Crash Shot

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1859/mabinogi-talent-update-crash-shot.png
Crash Shot has been changed so that the fragment attack occurs at the same time as Crash Shot hits an enemy.This change does not apply to enemies.
Urgent Shot
Urgent Shot has been changed so that you can use the skill regardless if the previous attack hit or missed.Skill cooldown has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1:
10 secondsThe skill training requirement has been changed.Before: "Use the skill successfully immediately after missing."After: "Use Urgent Shot to defeat an enemy."The Glyph Effect for Urgent Shot has been changed.Before: "Urgent Shot Available Time"Increased by 0.05 seconds per levelAfter: "Urgent Shot Cooldown Decreased"Decreased by 0.2 seconds per level
Final Shot
When using Final Shot, you can now immediately activate the skill without casting time.Previously, the casting time was 2 seconds.The duration of the skill has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1:30 seconds -> 45 secondsSkill cooldown has been reduced.Example - Based on Rank 1:260 seconds -> 240 secondsThe skill has been changed so that the durability of the equipped weapon does not decrease when using the skill.

Stardust Part 1 Update
Discover the power of Stardust with Stardust: Part 1! After reaching cumulative level 3,000, help out the Royal Society of Astronomy by starting the quest [Guide] An Astronomical Discovery found in the "Society Sponsorship" quest tab.Learn more about the new Stardust System through the guide.

notes.title: A Fresh Memory Update Preview
notes.notes:
Help Blaanid recover her lost memories with the revamped Memoir questline! Obtain new rewards, level up your character, and train your skills as you proceed through your journey in Erinn. Don't forget to read our previous announcement to see what is being changed/removed in this update. Check out the details below.

Blaanid's Brave Boosthttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1261/mabinogi-boost-up.png
With the new Blaanid's Brave Boost quests, you can level up quickly and earn AP!
If your cumulative level is less than 5,000, completing Blaanid's Brave Boost quests grants 5x EXP.AP is also doubled when leveling up.This effect is applied only with the experience obtained through Blaanid's Brave Boost quests. AP is earned at a fixed rate of 2, regardless of the use of items that affect the amount AP that can be earned.Whenever you complete a quest, you will receive a Rebirth Potion. If you leveled up by completing a quest, reset your level by rebirthing.Please note that you will only receive a Rebirth Potion if you are under cumulative level 5,000.When a Rebirth Potion is used, the waiting time for rebirthing is reset, and you can rebirth immediately.Only characters under cumulative level 5,000 can use the Rebirth Potion given.

notes.title: Dungeon Guide System - Patch Notes - November 12th, 2020
notes.notes:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Dungeon Guide System update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Playful Puzzle Returns!: Thursday, September 24th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 24th, Before Maintenance	Attendance Check Event: Thursday, October 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 19th, Before Maintenance	Steam Engineer Toolbox: Thursday, October 29th, After Maintenance - Wednesday, November 25th, Before Maintenance	Dungeon Drop Rate Increase Event: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 17th, Before Maintenance	Generation Boost Event: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 10th, Before Maintenance	Weapon and Pet Rental: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 11th, Before Maintenance	Dark Divination Box: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 10th, Before MaintenanceDungeon Guide System: Permanent		

Dungeon Guide System:
The Dungeon Guide System update is now live! Easily see which dungeons you've cleared or find new dungeons to explore with the new Dungeon Guide UI. You can also earn a ton of rewards and buy items from a brand new shop. 		You can check out the full details of the Dungeon Guide System update in the guide!	You can access the Dungeon Guide UI by clicking on the Info tab, and selecting Dungeon Guide.	Each dungeon and mission listed on the Dungeon Guide UI will show information about that dungeon/mission. It will also show some of the main rewards of that dungeon/mission, as well as the guaranteed repeated dungeon clear rewards.	Clearing dungeons or missions multiple times will have guaranteed rewards. You can obtain these rewards in the Dungeon Guide UI.	Each dungeon or mission can only be repeated 10 times per account per real life day. The repeat timer resets at 12 AM server time.	The Dungeon Guide UI will also show recommended dungeons based on your physical or magical damage output.	Completing certain dungeons will yield you Support Boxes that will aid your character in getting stronger.	There is a new shop that you can access via Eavan in Dunbarton.	To purchase items in this shop, you will need Vouchers.	Vouchers can be obtained by registering a main character at Eavan and completing dungeons/missions.	You are able to change your registered character once per day after registering.	There are 4 different types of Vouchers that you can obtain in different dungeons and missions.		

Permanent Changes:

Dungeon Changes
The 8-Player Dungeon event will be turned on permanently with the Dungeon Guide update.You are now able to enter any of the following dungeons with 8 players on any difficulty:		Alby	Ciar	Rabbie	Math	Fiodh	Barri	Coill	Rundal	Peaca	

Chapter 7: Apocalypse Changes
The required level to start Chapter 7: Apocalypse has been reduced from level 5,000 to level 3,000.All enemy stats and skill ranks have been nerfed.

G22: Apocalypse Changes
The following changes have been made to the G22 mission, "Chance and Destiny":		In the last phase of the mission, the amount of time that you need to survive the wave of enemies is now displayed on screen.	The mission will not fail if the player is knocked out. You are able to revive and continue the mission.	The following changes have been made to the G22 mission, "Wheel of Misfortune":		During the last phase of the mission, the target submerges into the water, but does not move too far.	An issue where Dorcha Snatch was not counted as a hit to the target has been fixed.	When using certain Chain Blades skills that cannot hit the target, a message containing instructions will appear.	The following change has been made to the G22 mission, "Holy Barrier":		Picking an incorrect answer will no longer cause the mission to fail.	The following changes have been made to the G22 quests, "In Search of Clues 1-7" and "Collect Clues 1-4":		The amount of glowing spots that you needs to find during "In Search of Clues 1" and "Collect Clues 1" has been reduced.	The instruction text that guides you throughout "In Search of Clues 1" and "Collect Clues 1" has been improved.	Directional markings have been added to lead you to the destination in the quests "In Search of Clues 2" and "Collect Clues 2".	A location marker has been added to the NPC that needs to be found in the quest "In Search of Clues 3".	The mission guide dialogue has been improved in the quest "In Search of Clues 3".	The cooking difficulty for the quest "In Search of Clues 5" has been drastically reduced.	The following change has been made to the G22 quests, "Seven Eyelids", "Phantoms Among the Snow", "A Memory of Emain Macha", "Seeking the Last Symbols", and "A Missing Memory":		If you type in an incorrect answer, a more obvious hint will be given to you.	The following change has been made to the G22 quest, "The Broken Prison Gate":		You are now able to proceed with the quest, even if you do not have the skill, Life Drain.	The following change has been made to the G22 quest, "Seeking the Last Symbols":		The instruction text that appears during the quest has been improved.	The following change has been made to the G22 mission, "Executive Discretion":		The amount of time you need to survive the wave of enemies will now be displayed on screen.	The following change has been made to the G22 mission, "Castling":		A message to better understand the mission progress has been added.	The following changes have been made to the G22 mission, "A False Promise":		The damaging field left by Salamanders and the damage from the Salamanders has been reduced.	The duration of the summoned Fire Pillars and the damaging fields that appear have been reduced.	The overall damage from the boss enemy has been reduced.	

G23: Tempest Changes
The following changes have been made to the G23 quest, "Winter Festival":		The hints provided for the Quiz Contest will be more direct.	You are now able to skip the sliding Picture Puzzle mini-game.	The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Preparing for the Plague":		The number of quest items needed to proceed with the quest has been reduced from 5 of each item, to 1 of each item.	The following changes have been made to the G23 quest, "Scattered by the Winds":		If you lose the Topaz Arrow that Hagel gives you to enter the dungeon, you can request another one from him.	No matter which Topaz Arrow you use to enter the dungeon (either the one given before the update or the one given after the update), the quest item, a Fresh Water Bottle, will now be given 100% of the time.	The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Scattered Omens":		If you type in an incorrect answer, a more obvious hint will be given to you.	The following changes have been made to the G23 quest, "Jarlath's Trail":		The required quest item can now be obtained 4 at a time.	The drop chance of the quest item is now set to 100%, regardless of the difficulty of the Shadow Mission.	The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Rain and Fire:"		Enemy stats in the quest mission have been nerfed.	The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Eye Spy":		You can now locate the target on the mini-map.	The following changes have been made to the G23 quest, "New Path in an Old Land":		The number of sketches that need to be checked has been lowered.	You can now locate all of the targets needed on the mini-map.	The following changes have been made to the G23 mission, "Nightmare's Embrace":		Enemy stats in the mission have been nerfed.	The chance of the enemy using Thunder has been drastically decreased.	You are now able to revive in the mission using Nao Stones.	The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Generations":		The drop chance of the quest item is now set to 100%.	The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "On the Brink":		The warp device's recovery rate has been increased by 1.5x.	The following changes have been made to the G23 mission, "Who Rules the Sea":		Some skill damage from enemies has been nerfed.	The amount of summoned enemies that you need to defeat has been decreased.	The amount of summoned enemies appearing at the same time has been decreased.	The chance of an enemy using Thunder has been drastically decreased.	The following changes have been made to the G23 mission, "Failed Hypothesis":		While possessed by the enemy, the debuff effect has been decreased.	When the enemy is enraged, the attack damage increase rate has been nerfed.	The damage needed to cancel the enraged effect has been decreased.	

G24: Ascension Changes
The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Blue and White":		The mission will no longer fail if you are knocked out. You are able to revive and continue the mission.	The skill damage of the enemy has been nerfed.	The following change has been made to the G24 mission, "The Secret in the Swamp":		The number of summoned enemies has been decreased.	The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Deep Sea Clues":		You no longer need to play the sliding puzzle mini-game.	The number of summoned enemies has been decreased.	The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Undertow":			The number of summoned enemies has been decreased.	The mission will no longer fail if you are knocked out. You are able to revive and continue the mission.	The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Gaze of the Blood Moon":		You are now able to clear Phase 2 of the mission when the enemy's HP drops below 50%.	The damaging field and the damage the enemy can deal have been decreased.	The duration of the Fire Pillar and the damaging field have been decreased.	The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "A Lonely Obsession":		The skill damage of the enemy has been decreased.	The close combat damage of the enemy has been decreased.	The number and range of the bombs dropped by the enemy has been decreased.	You will no longer get knocked out when hit by a bomb.	The number of summoned orbs has been decreased.	The time limit that you have to defeat the summoned orbs has been increased.	The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Lullaby of the Abyss": 		The skill damage of the enemy has been decreased.	The duration of the bleed effect from the enemy has been decreased.	The following change has been made to the G24 mission, "At the End of the Road":		Since the enemies have been nerfed, the RP character has also been nerfed.	The following changes have been made to the G24 quest, "Moonlight of Death":		The amount of HP the enemy has, based on the number of party members you bring into the mission, has been decreased.	The skill damage of the enemy has been decreased.	You will no longer get stunned or knocked out when attacked by the enemy.	

Technique Changes
The cooldown time of the Techniques, Iron Will, Relentless Assault, and Exploit Weakness, has been changed to 10 minutes.The cooldown time of the Technique, Time Shift, has been changed to 15 minutes.

Tory Ravine Changes
Poison Alligator, Doubcha Saturos, and Doubcha Floating Stone will no longer attack on sight.You will no longer be invincible when talking to a G24 NPC.
	

The following bug fixes and changes have been made to the game:

Pets

The Current and Cumulative levels of a pet can now be viewed in the Pet/Partner Window when you hover over a pet's name.
The Hotkey Settings button has been added to the Pet/Partner Info window.
You can now delete expired items in your pet's inventory by using the Expired Items function signified by the 'Hourglass' icon.

Auction House

Added the "Equip Restrictions" search filter when searching in the "Armor" category of the Auction House.

Additionally, the following searchable keywords have been added:

Human
Elf
Giant
Male
Female


When searching for specific options in the Auction House using the "Advanced Search Filter", the search filter is maintained even when refreshing the search.
When listing an item in the Auction House, it has been changed so that you can modify the price amount after highlighting any area with the mouse.
Added the "Yearly" market price range option when viewing an Item's Market Price Data in the Auction House.
The speed of searching for item names in the Auction House has been improved.
You can now list Pet Adoption Medals with stored pets on the Auction House.
The following categories have been added to the Misc section of the Auction House:

Beauty Coupon
Adoption Medal

The following advanced search filters have been added for Adoption Medals:

Price
Remaining number of adoptions
Pet race name
Pet cumulative level
Pet points
Pet type



You can now preview the following items in the Auction House:

Shamala's Transformation Medals
Beauty Coupon
Appearance Scrolls
Homestead Props
Outfit animations


Additionally, the issue of seeing abnormal animation when previewing a weapon with unique animation in the Auction House has been fixed.

The average price of Sewing Patterns, Blacksmith Manuals, and Shamala's Transformation Medal are now individually calculated according to the individual kind of Sewing Pattern, Blacksmith Manual, or Shamala's Transformation Medal item.

With the above change, the average selling price of Sewing Patterns, Blacksmith Manuals, and Shamala's Transformation Medal has been reset.


Shadow Missions

When receiving an Elite Shadow Mission, a menu will show a list of all Elite Pass items available for use in the inventory.

Items with an expiration timer will be listed first, depending on which pass expires first.
The number of passes owned won't matter.

Daily Shadow Missions now start at the same time when you first log in.

The day will reset at 7:00 AM server time.

Any daily Shadow Missions from the previous day are now automatically cancelled if you did not complete them before the reset.
The time requirement for when these Daily Shadow Missions can be completed has been removed.
A change has been made to prevent Daily Shadow Missions from being forfeited.
You cannot start the Daily Shadow Mission of that day if you have a previous quest that can be completed.

You must complete the quest and log in again or change channels to start the quest of that day.


Dressing Room

You can now preview items that are not collected in the Dressing Room. These items will be previewed in random colors each time you preview them.

Some wings are not currently available for preview, including some dyeable wings.

There is now a feature in the Dressing Room that shows if you currently have the needed Beauty Coupon in your inventory for Hair, Eyes, Face, and Mouth styles when hovering over a style.

UI Improvements

Favorite 1st and 2nd Titles can be added/removed by right-clicking the title in the Title menu. Favorites are signified by a star icon.
The "Keep Equipped Equipment" option is checked by default during rebirth. Additionally, any titles that were equipped before rebirthing are retained if you rebirth using this option.
When attempting to enter a Homestead shortly after combat, a pop-up window will now display the amount of time you must wait before entering.
The max auto-craft quantity for items created with the following Production skills have been increased to 100. Please note that special items that can only be crafted 1 at a time has not been increased.

Weaving
Handicraft
Refining
Potion Making
Carpentry
Hillwen Engineering
Magic Crafting
Fynn Crafting
Milling
Theatre Mission Pass Crafting

There is now a "Status List" menu to view all active status effects for the character.

This menu can be opened by clicking on "Details" in the Character Info menu.
The remaining duration for any status effect with a time limit can also be viewed in the Status List.

Improvements have been made to the recipe search function in the Production skill menu.

Party Board

The party board now displays the party's name..
A party created for the Mini-game Mafia can now be registered to the Party Board.
You can now sort the party list by clicking on the Party Name, Party Leader, Party Goal, Detailed Items, Restrictions, Members, or Features tab of the Party Board.
The Party Board tooltip will now display if a member of the party has a title with a Party EXP increase effect.

The tooltip will also display if the Grandmaster Cleric Unique Effect is activated.


Options Improvement

There is now an on/off option for game sounds to play even when the game screen is not active.

You can toggle this option by going to Options -> System -> Sound.

There is now a "Borderless Full Screen" mode.

You can set this mode by going to Options -> System -> Screen.

The "Full Screen" button has been removed from the System menu.

Pressing the Left Alt + Enter buttons in windowed mode will now switch to borderless full screen mode.


Bank

The Bank inventory window will now display above your inventory when you access the Bank.
Bank items can now be freely moved, similar to bags, as long as there is space available.

NPC Shops

You can now select the quantity of individual items in a NPC shop.
There is now a "Repurchase" tab in all NPC Shops. Items sold to a NPC shop can be repurchased for the price it was sold at.

Only up to 10 items, starting from the ones you sold recently, can be repurchased.
When you log out or move channels, the list of repurchasable items is reset.
You cannot repurchase items that have a Shop Sales Bonus or Exploration EXP.
You cannot repurchase items that are exempt from Bank fees.

Items with the enchants that give you extra gold when selling, cannot be repurchased.

Traveler's Guide

The Traveler's Guide search function has been improved with the following changes:

You can now search without needing to add a space.
You can now search by typing a single letter.


Friend's List

New options have been added to the Friend's list for notifications:

You can now set the use of Offline Groups for your friend's list via Friend's List -> Options.
You can now toggle guild member login notifications on/off via Friend's List -> Options.
You can now set an alert for unread notes when logging in via Friend's List -> Options.


Graphics

Characters will no longer appear semi-transparent while in Screenshot Mode.
Resolution settings are now based on the monitor in use.

4K and Ultrawide (21:9) resolution is now supported.
The "Widescreen support" option has been removed.


Other

In-game video clips now sync with your BGM volume option.
Screenshot filenames will now be saved with the year, month, day, hour, and minutes.

Hours are displayed in the 24-hour format.

After assisting the Friends with their Starter Quests, each of them will have new daily quests for you starting on the following day! Completing their Starter Quests and daily quests provides you with EXP and Japari Coins.Completing any of the Friends' daily quests 16 times will provide you with a special title from each of them. Collect all 4 titles!The day after completing any one of the four starting quests for the Friends, you can return to the Lucky Beast by the Bell Tower in Dunbarton on the following day to pick up the Defense Mission Daily Quest.You'll play as the character Kyururu to stave off wave-after-wave of Slime Cellien monsters!Receive EXP and Japari Coins for completing at least one of the 15 waves of enemies.You'll earn a special title for completing the quest to finish all 15 waves!You can use the Japari Coins from different missions at Caravan Friend Joe's Shop! notes.title: Memento Update
notes.notes:
The bards encamped by Abb Neagh Lake have stumbled across something: music, an unfamiliar sound from an unfamiliar instrument, drifting over the water, stirring their curiosity. Help them meet a strange young girl in the surreal new adventure in the land of Erinn: Memento!


http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-00c9cee9-d5c1-4be8-862b-11a9af7b5017.jpg

New Storyline: Memento

The music drifts over the lake at night. Those that have gone to look have found no one behind the enchanting bells, ringing and ringing as midnight passes by. The bard Yvona, out of curiosity, or perhaps just a desire to have her rest go undisturbed, seeks out help to find out what is behind the strange sounds in the night sky...

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-b843a58c-0b8c-4842-a506-beec554be663.jpg

Characters with a cumulative level of 500 or higher will be given a quest to meet with Yvona on the banks of Abb Neagh Lake, to begin the Memento storyline. 

New Dungeons: Sidhe Finnachaid

The Memento Update brings us a new dungeon, Sidhe Finnachaid, sitting beneath the waters of Abb Neagh Lake. This dungeon has a special twist: Every time you enter the dungeon, your party leader will be able to select a version of the dungeon to battle in: Sorrow, Fear and Curiosity, each with a different Water Level, different foes to defeat and different rewards to claim.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-8de88326-c67b-48e3-a356-1e984f2f805f.jpg

Complete the Dungeon and you'll find a special bonus at the end. Sidhe Finnachaid may seem like just an ordinary dungeon (with an extraordinary disregard for the laws of physics), but it's the only place you'll find the brand new Echostones

Echostones

Echostonesare a brand new collection of power-boosting items that you'll only find in Sidhe Finnachaid. Equipped in the new Echostone section of the inventory, each stone will grant a boost to a primary stat or your Heath, Mana and SP pool, even beyond the 1500 point stat cap. But while you can Upgrade your Echostonesat the end of each Sidhe Finnachaid run, there's far more power to unlock here...

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-1ea1b9e4-3320-45e0-b715-8c72839182a2.jpg

At the end of Sidhe Finnachaid, you'll also be able to Awaken an Echostone by spending AP and Awakening materials collected throughout Sidhe Finnachaid. Awaken an Echostone to give it additional effects, including ones that can be found via Reforging and a special set of new abilities to grow your power even further. And if you don't like an existing Echostone's power, you can dismantle Echostones, granting Echostone Catalysts, Magic Powders and random items, including Elite Passes, gems, equipment and more.

New Skill: Dance of Death

Finish the quest, "So That You Are Not a Memory", in the Memento storyline to learn the brand new Dance of Death Skill! This skill allows you to move freely while busting a move, causing damage to enemies around you. If doing Ballet with floating hearts isn't your thing, then you can switch to different moods and themes, which you can obtain in the new Sidhe Finnachaid dungeon, by clicking the Manage Button next to the skill. The harder the difficulty, then there is a higher chance for the different Moods and Themes to drop.

Dance of Death is located under the Music Talent Tab.


Memento Events

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J5H-df3c846d-0dbd-4b16-8744-9cee4b687288.jpg

Memento has arrived, and we're celebrating the update with a slate of bonuses and giveaways to make your experience in Sidhe Finnachaid even better! Earn double EXP this weekend, get through the storyline for a special new title, earn AP potions every day and claim special prizes for the next three weeks.

Check out the full details in the Memento Events post.

Additional Changes
Gold Rewards for the quest "Conflict! An Unexpected Battle" have been greatly reduced:
- Basic: 1,200 Gold (was 4,900 Gold)
- Int.: 1,680 Gold (was 6,860 Gold)
- Adv.: 2,400 Gold (was 9,800 Gold)
- Hard: 3,600 Gold (was 14,700 Gold)
- Elite: 4,800 Gold (was 19,600 Gold)

notes.title: G20 Update Notes
notes.notes:
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00Isi-732ad486-6719-4727-8175-f22c377f9a69.jpg

A new threat awakens and the Alban Knights need your help to safeguard Erinn from this unholy threat. G20 is here with the next part in the story of Mabinogi!

G20: The Gate of Sanctuary
It has been a time of troubles for the Alban Knights. The attacks by the Prophets have taxed their soldiers and shown that Erinn is not as safe as it once seemed... and now something new and terrible has seeped into Tir Chonaill. Human bodies, glowing with a golden energy before rising from the dead. Those that have completed G19's story can speak to Talvash in Tir Chonaill to get started with G20 and discover The Gate of Sanctuary!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00Isi-aff30329-dd0f-4901-b600-473cf3880696.jpg

Squires of Baltane

War has few constants, but two parts remain true: You need soldiers to fight in them, and they won't all return. No matter how well you fight, eventually new soldiers will need to be trained, and the Alban Knights have given you that honor.

For full details, click here!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00Isi-1bf1df26-4df0-4d7b-b63d-33fd5193a8bb.jpg

Divine Skill Changes

G19 saw the addition of the Divine Knights' central abilities, the Divine Skills. With G20, a brand new set of Divine Skills have been added, and a few of the previous set have been improved to grow even stronger.

For full details, click here!

New Items

A new story, new abilities and new students to train not enough? A gross of new items have also made their way to Mabinogi! Grab the following items in your quest to defend Erinn.

For full details, click here!

G20 Registration Rewards

Don't forget: If you Registered for G20, you have until May 11th, 2016 in order to claim your prizes! Simply login with your Level 50 or higher Character and claim all the goodies below!

For full details, click here!

notes.title: February Update
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/fMA6V36.jpg

Lunar Fortune!
2015 is the Year of the Sheep, and this event is one way to see if your luck will be good or baaaaaad. A mysterious Fortune-teller has appeared in Dunbarton, passing out Fortune Boards to all those seeking some sheep thrills. Read More

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IK8-4940e438-fedd-4f8b-97a0-8ec94c775a8d.jpg

The Adorable Sheeptuplets Box
You've never seen sheep like these before. They walk on two legs, wear cute little outfits, lure over other sheep with their amazing personalities, and they don't even need their little wings to fly - they'll lift you off your feet as an epic Cumulosheepus! Adopt your very own Sheeptuplet, just in time for Lunar New Year!  Read More

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IK6-9dbe15f5-3805-482a-8121-e8a2360c501f.jpg

New Gingerbread Truck
It's a bird, it's a plane - no, it's much tastier than that! The sweet soaring Gingerbread Truck is more than just a mobile business, it's a lifelong companion with a sugary constitution. Go where you will and bring your buddies along for the ride, the land of milk and cookies is just beyond the horizon! Read More

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00G2Y-416dd02e-96fe-4459-aa0b-7b654c6b7c51.jpg
Homestead Candy Bonanza Returns
Your Homestead grows and changes with the seasons, and now is the perfect time to indulge in some seasonal Valentine's Day treats. Whether you're a botanist looking to grow a Candy Tree, a fisherman seeking some special goodies or an interior-decorating shopaholic, Candy Bonanza offers something for every homebody. Read More
